Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination VLA

World Action Models rolling imagination manipulation replanning speedup humanoid

简要说明：Rolling-WAM通过滚动噪声调度将视频-动作联合去噪分散到多个重规划周期，在保持操作性能的同时实现了4.5倍的重规划加速。

TLDR: Rolling-WAM distributes joint video-action denoising over replanning cycles with a rolling noise schedule, achieving a 4.5x replanning speedup while retaining manipulation performance on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real Unitree G1 humanoid.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）将动作生成与未来视觉预测相结合，用于机器人操作任务。然而，在每个重新规划周期内完成联合视频-动作去噪过程会带来显著延迟，导致动作更新滞后并限制闭环响应速度。我们提出Rolling-WAM，一种将联合去噪过程分配到连续重新规划周期中的新方法。该方法在交错噪声水平下维护一个滑动窗口的视频-动作块。在每一步中，滚动噪声调度完全去噪即将执行的动作块，同时部分细化更远未来的块。随着窗口随新的相机观测推进，保留的未来块继续其去噪过程。这随时间分散了计算成本，同时跨块边界携带不断演化的视觉-动作上下文。在LIBERO、RoboTwin以及真实世界的Unitree G1人形机器人上的评估表明，Rolling-WAM实现了具有竞争力的操作性能。通过消除从零开始对整个预测范围进行去噪的需求，相较于标准联合WAMs，该方法实现了4.5倍的稳态重新规划加速。

Authors: Yinghua Zhou, Junjie Ye, Yiqi Zhao, Hao Dong, Celina Shiyu Wang, Ruohai Ge, Tingyi Yang, Basile Van Hoorick, Gaurav Sukhatme, Vitor Guizilini, Yue Wang

Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment VLA

self-adaptive policy hardware shifts context encoder adaptive layer normalization bi-manual manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对VLA模型的后训练方法，通过轻量级上下文编码器和自适应层归一化，使策略在部署时能够基于自身轨迹数据自适应硬件变化，在双臂和灵巧操作任务中恢复基策80%以上的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a post-training recipe for VLA models that enables self-adaptation to hardware shifts during deployment by using a plug-in context encoder and adaptive layer normalization, recovering over 80% of base policy performance under hardware shifts in bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks.

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive capabilities in robotic manipulation, their memoryless nature renders them brittle to test-time environment shifts, particularly hardware shifts caused by wear or imperfect calibration. Enabling these models to self-adapt during deployment without requiring continuous on-site recalibration remains a critical bottleneck for real-world scalability. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive VLA, a novel post-training recipe that enables the policy to iteratively adapt to deployment-time hardware shifts leveraging its own rollouts as context. To do so, we first collect policy rollouts under deliberately injected hardware shifts. We then transform the base policy's training data into shift-conditioned expert demonstrations by pre-compensating the expert actions for these known shifts. Next, we introduce a lightweight, plug-in context encoder that compresses the context, including visual observation, proprioception, and actions in the shifted environment, into a latent context token. This token modulates the policy through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN). Furthermore, we find that context tokens can be ensembled, allowing the policy to iteratively self-correct and mitigate failures step by step. Extensive experiments across four precision-critical bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks show that Self-Adaptive VLA recovers over 80% of the base policy's performance under hardware shifts, such as actuation bias and joint encoder offsets. Moreover, Self-Adaptive VLA enables more robust deployment to new workstations compared to the base policy. Our approach provides a pathway for robust large-scale real-world robot deployments and easier maintenance. See videos at https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla.

摘要（中文）：虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但其无记忆的特性使其在面对测试时环境变化时显得脆弱，尤其是由磨损或校准不完善引起的硬件变化。在部署过程中使这些模型能够自我适应，而无需持续进行现场重新校准，仍然是其现实世界可扩展性的关键瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们提出了自适应性VLA（Self-Adaptive VLA），一种新颖的后训练方案，使策略能够利用自身的轨迹数据作为上下文，迭代地适应部署时的硬件变化。为此，我们首先在有意引入的硬件变化下收集策略轨迹。然后，我们通过针对这些已知变化对专家动作进行预补偿，将基础策略的训练数据转化为变化条件下的专家示范。接下来，我们引入一个轻量级、即插即用的上下文编码器，将变化环境中的上下文（包括视觉观察、本体感觉和动作）压缩为潜在上下文标记。该标记通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）对策略进行调制。此外，我们发现上下文标记可以进行集成，使策略能够逐步迭代地自我纠正并缓解失败。在四个精度关键的双臂及灵巧操作任务上的大量实验表明，自适应性VLA在硬件变化（如执行器偏差和关节编码器偏移）下能够恢复基础策略80%以上的性能。此外，与基础策略相比，自适应性VLA在新工作站的部署中表现出更强的鲁棒性。我们的方法为大规模现实世界机器人部署的鲁棒性和更便捷的维护提供了一条可行路径。视频请见 https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla。

Authors: Hongxin Zhang, Chunru Lin, Tsun-Hsuan Wang, Zhenjia Xu, Chuang Gan

GPT-6-Astra Lights Up Embodied Navigation: Evaluation in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments VLN

zero-shot VLN-CE GPT-6-Astra monocular RGB Codex harness foundation model navigation

简要说明：本文评估了通用基础模型GPT-6-Astra在连续环境中的零样本视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）表现，仅使用单目RGB观测即取得了较高的成功率，无需导航微调，同时指出了路径执行和目标验证方面的局限性。

TLDR: This paper evaluates GPT-6-Astra, a general-purpose foundation model, for zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE), achieving strong success rates with only monocular RGB observations and no navigation-specific fine-tuning, while identifying limitations in route execution and goal verification.

Abstract: We investigate whether GPT-6-Astra, a general-purpose foundation model, can navigate unfamiliar environments using its own perception, reasoning, and decision-making capabilities. Our evaluation focues on zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) through a minimal interface in the Codex harness, aiming to unleash GPT-6-Astra's full potential for navigation. Using monocular RGB, GPT-6-Astra decides when to observe, how to move, and when to stop, without navigation-specific fine-tuning, a trained waypoint predictor, or a pre-built scene map. Our evaluation yields four main findings. First, \textbf{\textit{GPT-6-Astra achieves strong zero-shot navigation performance using only monocular RGB observations}}. On the common-adopted zero-shot R2R-CE benchmark, ultra reasoning achieves a success rate of \textbf{\textit{79.0\%}}, exceeding the strongest reported zero-shot and supervised success rates by \textbf{\textit{13.0}} and \textbf{\textit{6.9}} percentage points, respectively. Second, \textbf{\textit{GPT-6-Astra advances multi-stage language instructions into coherent, adaptive navigation}} by grounding spatial relations, tracking task progress, and revising its actions. Third, \textbf{\textit{reliable route execution and goal verification remain challenging, even with ultra reasoning}}. Plausible local landmark matches do not consistently lead to correct task completion. Fourth, \textbf{\textit{these capabilities motivate rethinking the role of embodied learning}}. Future VLN research should build on foundation models to advance generalizable and reliable embodied intelligence.

摘要（中文）：我们探讨GPT-6-Astra，这一通用基础模型，能否凭借自身的感知、推理与决策能力，在未知环境中进行导航。我们的评估聚焦于在连续环境中的零样本视觉-语言导航，通过Codex harness中的极简接口实现，旨在充分释放GPT-6-Astra在导航方面的潜能。仅依赖单目RGB信息，GPT-6-Astra自主决定何时观察、如何移动以及何时停止，而无需针对导航任务的专门微调、训练好的路径点预测器，或预先构建的场景地图。评估得出四项主要发现。第一，**仅凭单目RGB观测，GPT-6-Astra便实现了强大的零样本导航性能**。在广泛采用的零样本R2R-CE基准测试中，其超强推理能力取得了**79.0\%** 的成功率，分别超出已有报告中最优零样本与监督学习方法的成功率**13.0**和**6.9**个百分点。第二，**GPT-6-Astra能够将多阶段语言指令转化为连贯且自适应的导航行为**，通过理解空间关系、跟踪任务进度并实时调整自身行动。第三，**即便具备超强推理能力，可靠的路线执行与目标验证仍是挑战**。局部的可靠地标匹配并不总能引导任务正确完成。第四，**这些能力促使我们重新思考具身学习的角色**。未来的视觉-语言导航研究应依托基础模型，推动构建泛化能力强、可靠稳固的具身智能体系。

Authors: Guangzhao Dai, Qianru Sun, Qi Wu, Bin Zhu

Self-Supervised Anchoring of Fingertip Sensing to Proprioception and Proactive Actions for Robot Imitation Learning Manipulation

imitation learning fingertip sensing tactile sensing proximity sensing proprioception-anchored pretraining

简要说明：该论文提出了 PROPRA，一种以本体感觉为锚定的预训练方法，将指尖接近觉和触觉传感器历史与本体感觉及动作片段对齐，通过利用相位依赖的互补感知，提高了真实世界操作任务中的模仿学习成功率。

TLDR: The paper proposes PROPRA, a proprioception-anchored pretraining method that aligns fingertip proximity and tactile sensor histories with proprioceptive and action segments, improving imitation learning success rates on real-world manipulation tasks by leveraging phase-dependent complementary sensing.

Abstract: Robotic imitation learning often relies on external cameras, yet local interaction cues such as object proximity, contact onset, and grasp state are difficult to observe near the fingertips because of occlusion and limited temporal resolution. We study how to effectively incorporate complementary fingertip sensing into imitation learning using pressure-sensitive tactile and reflective proximity sensors, along with pretrained sensor encoders. The two modalities provide information at different manipulation phases: proximity sensing is informative before contact, whereas tactile sensing becomes informative after contact. However, naively adding these signals to a policy does not consistently improve performance and can even underperform vision-only policies, suggesting that sparse, phase-dependent sensor signals are difficult to exploit from limited demonstrations. We therefore propose a proprioception-anchored pretraining method, PROprioceptive-and-PRoactive Anchoring (PROPRA), which independently aligns each fingertip sensor history with proprioceptive and action segments. This provides a continuously available sensorimotor reference, allowing each sensor to be aligned independently during its informative phases. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks show that our pretraining method improves average success rates over vision-only policies and image-anchored pretraining baselines. Representation analysis further shows that it preserves richer information about pre-contact states, enabling more effective use of complementary fingertip sensing. Please refer to our project page: https://tomohiromotoda.github.io/nia.propra/

摘要（中文）：机器人模仿学习通常依赖外部摄像头，然而诸如物体接近度、接触起始时刻及抓取状态等局部交互线索，在指尖附近因遮挡和时间分辨率限制而难以观测。我们研究如何利用压敏触觉传感器与反射式近距传感器，结合预训练的传感器编码器，将互补的指尖感知有效整合进模仿学习。这两种模态在不同操作阶段提供信息：近距感知在接触前具有信息价值，而触觉感知在接触后发挥信息作用。然而，将这些信号直接加入策略中并不能持续提升性能，甚至可能不如仅依赖视觉的策略，这表明稀疏且依赖阶段变化的传感器信号难以从有限的示范中有效利用。因此，我们提出一种本体感觉锚定的预训练方法——本体与前摄锚定（PROPRA），该方法将每个指尖传感器历史独立地与本体感觉及动作片段对齐。这提供了一个连续可用的感觉运动参考，使每个传感器能够在其信息有效阶段被独立对齐。在真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，我们的预训练方法相较于仅视觉策略和图像锚定预训练基线，显著提高了平均成功率。表征分析进一步显示，该方法保留了关于接触前状态的更丰富信息，从而实现了对互补指尖感知的更有效利用。请参考我们的项目页面：https://tomohiromotoda.github.io/nia.propra/

Authors: Tomohiro Motoda, Masaki Murooka, Keisuke Shirai, Hanbit Oh, Ryoichi Nakajo, Shotaro Miwa, Roman Mykhailyshyn, Hugo Duarte, Yukiyasu Domae

Robo-Harness K1: Harnessing Robot-Use Agents via Perception Augmentation VLA

perception augmentation robot-use agent tool interface sample-efficient policy VLM-based control

简要说明：Robo-Harness K1 将校准深度、视觉锚点和抓取假设作为工具暴露给VLM，在不改变模型结构或进行任务微调的情况下提升了机器人操作的成功率，并通过少量专家示范蒸馏出高效且可泛化的策略。

TLDR: Robo-Harness K1 augments VLMs with calibrated depth, visual anchors, and grasp hypotheses as tools for robot use, improving manipulation accuracy on LIBERO-PRO and RoboTwin tasks and enabling sample-efficient policy distillation without task-specific fine-tuning or model retraining.

Abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) understand objects, instructions, and spatial relations, yet translating this capability into robotic manipulation remains difficult. Vision-language-action (VLA) models require extensive demonstrations and may compromise pretrained understanding, while direct RGB-only VLM control is costly and strongly dependent on model capability. We introduce Robo-Harness K1, a robot-use agent (RUA) framework that exposes perception as tools. The agent queries calibrated depth, persistent visual anchors, spatial measurements, and grasp hypotheses, then selects generic motions from the returned evidence. This interface makes 3D geometry accessible without changing the VLM architecture or training a depth encoder. On matched LIBERO-PRO tasks, Gemini 3.7 Flash with K1 reaches 77.8% accuracy, surpassing GPT-6 Astra's 61.1% with an RGB-only harness; K1 further improves Astra to 88.9%. Without target fine-tuning, Gemini with K1 transfers to three RoboSuite arms and dual-arm RoboTwin tasks. On RoboTwin, it achieves 32.0% on Easy and 28.0% on Hard, showing resilience to visual and environmental perturbations. K1 also produces tool-call traces aligned with next-token training. A Qwen3.5-9B student trained on only 107 teacher episodes reaches 44.2% accuracy on new initial states versus 30.2% for OpenVLA, and 13.9% on held-out task conditions versus 0.0% for OpenVLA. These results suggest that perception-augmented RUAs offer a promising route to sample-efficient, generalizable robotic policies that leverage VLM capabilities through an accessible tool interface.

摘要（中文）：基础视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够理解物体、指令和空间关系，但将这一能力转化为机器人操作仍面临挑战。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要大量示范数据，且可能损害预训练的理解能力，而直接基于纯RGB的VLM控制成本高昂且高度依赖模型能力。我们提出Robo-Harness K1，一种将感知作为工具暴露的机器人使用智能体（RUA）框架。该智能体查询校准深度、持久视觉锚点、空间测量和抓取假设，然后根据返回的证据选择通用动作。这一接口在不改变VLM架构或训练深度编码器的情况下，使三维几何信息变得可访问。在匹配的LIBERO-PRO任务上，配备K1的Gemini 3.7 Flash达到77.8%的准确率，超越使用纯RGB工具包的GPT-6 Astra的61.1%；K1进一步将Astra提升至88.9%。在不进行目标微调的情况下，配备K1的Gemini可迁移至三个RoboSuite机械臂和双臂RoboTwin任务。在RoboTwin上，它在Easy任务上达到32.0%，在Hard任务上达到28.0%，展现出对视觉和环境扰动的鲁棒性。K1还生成与下一词元训练一致的工具调用轨迹。仅使用107个教师轨迹训练的Qwen3.5-9B学生模型在新初始状态下达到44.2%的准确率，而OpenVLA为30.2%；在保留任务条件下达到13.9%，而OpenVLA为0.0%。这些结果表明，感知增强的RUA为样本高效、可泛化的机器人策略提供了一条有前景的路径，通过可访问的工具接口充分利用VLM能力。

Authors: Zexi Li, Yehang Zhang, Wenqian Li, Haojian Huang, Chenxu Wang, Shiyuan Deng, Yangkai Wei, Tianyi Zhang, Binghui Xie, Bohan Zhou, Yifan Chang, Kaiwen Zhou, Ying-Cong Chen, James Cheng, Yinchuan Li

Streaming-WAM: Action-Conditioned World-Action Model for Asynchronous Robot Manipulation Manipulation

world action model asynchronous control action-conditioned prediction robot manipulation future visual prediction

简要说明：Streaming-WAM 提出了一种动作条件世界-动作模型，通过基于已提交动作预测未来视觉来实现异步机器人操作，在 LIBERO 和真实任务中实现了近乎完美的成功率和显著的加速。

TLDR: Streaming-WAM introduces an action-conditioned world-action model that enables asynchronous robot manipulation by predicting future visuals conditioned on committed actions, achieving near-perfect success rates and significant speedups on LIBERO and a real-world task.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) that use future visual prediction at inference time incur substantial generation costs. Asynchronous execution reduces waiting by overlapping inference with robot motion, but visual predictions used for subsequent action generation must anticipate the effects of actions already scheduled for execution during inference. We introduce Streaming-WAM, which couples action-conditioned world modeling with asynchronous robot control to account for committed actions in future visual prediction. At each streaming update, the model conditions future visual prediction on the latest observation and the committed actions, which form the fixed prefix of the next action chunk. The resulting action-conditioned visual features guide generation of the remaining actions within the same joint update, so the continuation is informed by the scene changes expected during execution of the fixed prefix. On LIBERO, Streaming-WAM achieves an average success rate of 98.35\% and reduces mean episode time by a factor of 2.93 relative to Fast-WAM. On the real-world Stamp Paper task, mean episode time falls from 90 s with synchronous Joint-WAM to 38 s with Streaming-WAM. These results show that Streaming-WAM supports efficient asynchronous control while maintaining high task success rates.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）在推理时利用未来视觉预测，会产生大量的生成成本。异步执行通过将推理与机器人运动重叠来减少等待时间，但用于后续动作生成的视觉预测必须预先考虑到推理期间已安排执行的动作的影响。我们提出了Streaming-WAM，它将动作条件的世界建模与异步机器人控制相结合，以在未来视觉预测中考虑已承诺的动作。在每次流式更新中，模型将未来视觉预测的条件建立在最新观测和已承诺动作之上，这些已承诺动作构成下一个动作块（action chunk）的固定前缀。由此产生的动作条件视觉特征在同一联合更新中引导剩余动作的生成，因此连续生成部分会考虑到固定前缀执行期间预期的场景变化。在LIBERO基准上，Streaming-WAM的平均成功率达到98.35%，且相对于Fast-WAM将平均回合时间缩短了2.93倍。在真实世界的Stamp Paper任务中，平均回合时间从同步Joint-WAM的90秒降至Streaming-WAM的38秒。这些结果表明，Streaming-WAM在保持高任务成功率的同时，支持高效的异步控制。

Authors: Xuyao Huang, Yixuan Wang, Zengyao Ye, Boyuan Zhao, Chenyang Yu, Haoran Wen, Zhijie Deng

Direction-Scale Decomposition in Action Representation: Rethinking What to Tokenize for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Direction-Scale Decomposition action representation discrete-token VLA manipulation tokenization

简要说明：本文提出方向-尺度分解（DSD），一种用于离散令牌VLA模型的动作表示方法，将平移和旋转增量分解为方向和尺度分量后再进行分词。DSD在仿真和真实世界操作中提高了成功率，尤其在混合数据集训练下，通过保留几何结构并缓解归一化问题。

TLDR: This paper proposes Direction-Scale Decomposition (DSD), a new action representation for discrete-token VLA models that separates translation and rotation increments into direction and scale components before tokenization. DSD improves success rates in simulation and real-world manipulation, particularly under mixed-dataset training, by preserving geometric structure and mitigating normalization issues.

Abstract: Action representation plays a central role in discrete-token vision-language-action (VLA) learning but remains underexamined. Under conventional pose-increment representations, action tokens are sensitive to execution speed and dataset-specific normalization, potentially obscuring geometric structure shared across demonstrations and datasets. We introduce Direction-Scale Decomposition (DSD), an action representation that decomposes translation and rotation increments into direction and scale components before tokenization. DSD isolates motion direction while retaining magnitudes in separate scale channels. We evaluate DSD with uniform binning (BIN) and BEAST, a B-spline-based tokenizer, in simulation and real-world manipulation under both single-dataset and mixed-dataset training. On LIBERO, DSD improves average success rates with both tokenizers. On SimplerEnv, DSD-BIN outperforms BIN by 10.3 percentage points in overall success rate under mixed-dataset training. Real-robot experiments further show gains both with and without robotics pretraining. These results support DSD as an effective action representation for discrete-token VLA models and suggest its potential to mitigate performance degradation when training on large and diverse dataset mixtures. Our project page with additional resources is available at https://vla-dsd.github.io/

摘要（中文）：动作表征在离散令牌视觉-语言-动作（VLA）学习中扮演核心角色，但尚未得到充分研究。在传统的位姿增量表征下，动作令牌对执行速度和数据集特定的归一化较为敏感，可能掩盖跨示范及跨数据集共享的几何结构。我们提出方向-尺度分解（DSD）动作表征，该方法在令牌化之前将平移和旋转增量分解为方向分量与尺度分量。DSD将运动方向隔离出来，同时将幅度保留在独立的尺度通道中。我们分别在仿真和真实机器人操作中，采用均匀分箱（BIN）和基于B样条的令牌化器BEAST，在单数据集与混合数据集训练条件下对DSD进行了评估。在LIBERO基准上，DSD在两种令牌化器下均提升了平均成功率。在SimplerEnv基准上，混合数据集训练条件下，DSD-BIN的总体成功率较BIN高出10.3个百分点。真实机器人实验进一步表明，无论是否使用机器人预训练，DSD均带来性能提升。这些结果支持DSD作为离散令牌VLA模型的有效动作表征，并表明其在混合大规模多样数据集训练时具有缓解性能下降的潜力。更多资源请访问我们的项目页面：https://vla-dsd.github.io/

Authors: Yufei Duan, Hang Yin, Alberta Longhini, Chao Tang, Danica Kragic

DeltaWAM: Delta World Action Models for Bimanual Manipulation WorldModel

World-action models Visual deltas Bimanual manipulation Streaming Delta Memory Video generation

简要说明：DeltaWAM 通过预测视觉增量而非完整帧，并采用三流架构和流式增量记忆，降低了训练和推理成本，在 RoboTwin 和真实机器人上提升了双臂操作成功率。

TLDR: DeltaWAM improves world-action models for bimanual manipulation by predicting visual deltas instead of full frames, using three stream architectures and a Streaming Delta Memory to cut training and inference costs, boosting success rates on RoboTwin and real robots.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) transfer visual and motion priors from pretrained video generators to robot control by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. Existing WAMs, however, predict dense future frames during training, repeatedly modeling largely unchanged content and coupling action-conditioned dynamics to nuisance appearance variations. At inference, processing each complete observation with the heavy video expert bottlenecks few-step action generation. Accordingly, we propose DeltaWAM, which jointly predicts visual deltas and actions using dense-anchor, sparse-delta, and action streams, with three architectures that differ in representation and computation sharing. We further develop Streaming Delta Memory (SDM), which updates cached anchor context with compact observed deltas, reducing heavy video-expert processing. On RoboTwin, DeltaWAM with SDM improves average success over Fast-WAM from 81.3% to 85.4% in the clean setting and from 75.8% to 83.9% under visual randomization. The three architectures reduce training FLOPs by 17.78-23.77%, while SDM reduces one-step inference latency and FLOPs by 36.57% and 31.55%, respectively; real-world evaluations further show the highest overall success rate and normalized progress among the evaluated policies. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DeltaWAM. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DeltaWAM.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与动作，将预训练视频生成器中的视觉与运动先验迁移至机器人控制。然而，现有WAMs在训练过程中预测密集的未来帧，反复建模大量不变内容，并将动作条件动态耦合至噪声外观变化。在推理阶段，使用重型视频专家处理每个完整观测会制约少步动作生成。为此，我们提出DeltaWAM，通过密集锚点流、稀疏增量流与动作流联合预测视觉增量与动作，并设计三种在表示与计算共享方式上有所区别的架构。我们进一步开发了流式增量记忆（SDM），利用紧凑的观测增量更新缓存的锚点上下文，从而减少重型视频专家的计算负担。在RoboTwin基准上，配备SDM的DeltaWAM在干净设置下将平均成功率从Fast-WAM的81.3%提升至85.4%，在视觉随机化条件下从75.8%提升至83.9%。三种架构将训练计算量（FLOPs）降低17.78%-23.77%，而SDM分别将单步推理延迟与计算量降低36.57%和31.55%；真实世界评估进一步表明，在所有评估策略中，DeltaWAM取得了最高的整体成功率与归一化进度。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DeltaWAM。项目主页：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DeltaWAM。

Authors: Han Yan, Zishang Xiang, Haokai Jiang, Zeyu Zhang, Qilin Wang, Weiyu Guo, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi, Hao Tang

HelloWorld: Towards Practical Applications of Generative Driving World Models AutonomousDriving

generative driving world model control-conditioned generation interactive simulation multi-sensor synthesis efficient inference

简要说明：HelloWorld是一个20亿参数规模的驾驶世界模型系统，支持可扩展的反事实数据生成和交互式仿真，具备控制条件的多传感器生成和高效部署能力。

TLDR: HelloWorld is a 2B generative driving world model system that enables scalable counterfactual data generation and interactive simulation, with capabilities for control-conditioned multi-sensor generation and efficient deployment.

Abstract: Driving world models provide a promising route toward scalable counterfactual data generation and interactive simulation beyond recorded driving logs. Realizing this potential requires a system that can generalize across diverse scenes, respond faithfully to prescribed controls, generate coherent multi-sensor observations, and operate efficiently under repeated inference. We present \textbf{HelloWorld}, a 2B driving world model system designed around these requirements. HelloWorld progressively specializes broad visual and motion priors from heterogeneous video data into controllable driving generation using ego pose, HD maps, and 3D boxes. A block-causal generation interface, together with adaptation to self-generated context, aligns the model with sequential simulation. The system further supports synchronized seven-camera RGB generation and conditional LiDAR synthesis, and is distilled toward few-step inference for efficient deployment. Experiments evaluate visual quality, control fidelity, cross-view consistency, robustness under repeated generation, inference efficiency, and LiDAR synthesis. Together, HelloWorld provides a unified framework for scalable driving data generation and interactive simulation.

摘要（中文）：驾驶世界模型为超越记录驾驶日志的可扩展反事实数据生成与交互式仿真提供了一条前景广阔的路径。实现这一潜力需要系统能够泛化至多样场景、对指定控制指令作出忠实响应、生成连贯的多传感器观测数据，并在重复推理下高效运行。我们提出了\textbf{HelloWorld}——一个围绕上述需求设计的2B参数驾驶世界模型系统。HelloWorld通过利用自车姿态、高精地图和3D边界框，将来自异构视频数据的广泛视觉与运动先验逐步特化为可控驾驶生成。块因果生成接口结合对自生成上下文的适应，使模型与序列化仿真保持对齐。该系统进一步支持同步七相机RGB生成与条件式激光雷达合成，并通过蒸馏实现少步推理以支持高效部署。实验评估涵盖了视觉质量、控制保真度、跨视角一致性、重复生成下的鲁棒性、推理效率以及激光雷达合成性能。综上，HelloWorld为可扩展驾驶数据生成与交互式仿真提供了一个统一框架。

Authors: Fan Lu, Hanshi Wang, Zijing Wang, Quan Feng, Zhi Wang, Shijie Chen, Xianming Zeng, Yujian Zhang, Jiazhe Wang, Xin Zha, Kai Wang, Zhijie Zhao, Lin Zhu, Tianyi Yang, Yucheng Xu, Tao Ji, Haodong Zhang, Zhipeng Zhang, Peixi Peng, Guang Chen, Xingliang Liu, Lei Yang, Jianyun Xu

AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control WorldModel

latent world models model predictive control inverse dynamics action-recovery regularization zero-shot transfer

简要说明：AD-WM提出了一种用于模型预测控制的行为判别潜在世界模型，通过残差动态和动作恢复正则化改进反事实动作选择，在OGBench-Cube和Franka零样本操作中显著提升了成功率。

TLDR: AD-WM proposes an action-discriminative latent world model for model predictive control, using residual dynamics and action-recovery regularization to improve counterfactual action selection, demonstrating significant success gains in OGBench-Cube and zero-shot Franka manipulation.

Abstract: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：摘要：潜在世界模型通常被训练用于预测事实性的状态转移，而模型预测控制（MPC）则必须从同一状态出发对不同候选动作进行比较。因此，一个模型可能具有较低的事实预测误差，却难以有效区分候选动作。我们引入了AD-WM，一种面向反事实MPC的动作判别性联合嵌入世界模型。AD-WM将残差潜在动力学与预测器级别的动作恢复正则化相结合，利用逆动力学以及由条件互信息激发的归一化恢复目标。两种目标均促使规划过程中的状态转移保留动作信息；其辅助头在测试阶段被丢弃，MPC流程保持不变。在OGBench-Cube上，AD-WM相较于匹配的LeWM基线，将困难起始任务的成功率从3.7%提升至52.0%，并在五个仿真环境中的四个环境中提升了相对于复现基线的平均成功率。规划诊断表明，事实预测误差和整体动作排序并不遵循闭环成功率的排序，而与CEM对齐的精英遗憾值则更紧密地跟踪成功率。在冻结V-JEPA 2编码器及匹配DROID后训练的条件下，AD-WM还提升了向我们的Franka平台的零样本迁移效果，将基础抓取-放置任务的成功率从42.2%提升至71.1%，且无需针对实验室特定调整。这些结果表明，用于规划的世界模型应保留反事实选择所需的动作相关差异，而非仅优化事实预测精度。更多视频和代码请访问 https://ad-wm.github.io/。

Authors: Jiabin Qiu, Zixuan Chen, Hongye Cao, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations Manipulation

agentic programming learning from demonstration object-centric representation trajectory optimization real robot manipulation

简要说明：RAPID从单个人类演示中自动生成、验证和优化机器人程序，利用智能体循环和对象中心的关系表示，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中展示了强大的泛化能力。

TLDR: RAPID automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs from a single human demonstration, using an agentic LLM loop and object-centric relational representations, and demonstrates strong generalization across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

摘要（中文）：编程智能体在解决复杂编程问题方面已展现出巨大成功。为将其潜力应用于机器人系统，本研究引入了基于演示的机器人智能体编程方法（RAPID），该方法能够根据单次视觉人类演示自动生成、验证并优化机器人程序。代码优化的迭代式智能体循环需要几个关键要素：（i）可测试的任务规范，（ii）用于机器人执行的动作原语，以及（iii）用于程序执行与验证的交互式环境。RAPID能够从演示中自动推断出这三项要素。为使生成的程序在演示场景之外具备可复用性，RAPID采用了一种以对象为中心的关系型程序表示，该表示聚焦于所演示策略的底层结构而非具体运动本身：它将动作原语表示为实现对象级运动效果的运动轨迹优化程序，并通过在运行时捕捉场景特定几何关系的关系约束来组合这些原语。我们在仿真环境中对RAPID进行了评估，涵盖了LIBERO-Pro基准中的八项具有挑战性的接触丰富非抓取操作任务以及一般抓取操作任务。我们还在真实的Franka机械臂上成功部署了该方法，并对全部八项非抓取任务进行了评估。在所有实验中，RAPID均展现出强劲性能，并能在物体姿态、形状、材质及环境变化下实现泛化。网站：https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid。

Authors: Yuyao Liu, Jiayuan Mao, David Hsu, Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Tomás Lozano-Pérez

Underwater C3-JEPA: An Object-Centric Cross-View World Model for ROV Salvage WorldModel

world model object-centric cross-view underwater ROV model-predictive control

简要说明：本文提出一种以对象为中心的多视角世界模型，用于水下ROV打捞任务，从多视角RGB和控制信号预测任务对象状态演化，支持MPC和行为智能体训练。

TLDR: The paper proposes an object-centric cross-view world model that predicts task-object state evolution for underwater ROV salvage from multi-view RGB and control signals, enabling MPC and behavior-agent training.

Abstract: We present Underwater C$^{3}$-JEPA (cross-view, control-conditioned, context-extended), an object-centric multi-view predictive world model for near-field heavy-load underwater ROV salvage. Without contact sensors, it predicts in latent space how the task-object state evolves through contact interaction and under the hydrodynamic lag of the vehicle, from synchronized multi-view RGB observations and vehicle control signals. C$^{3}$-JEPA encodes multi-camera observations into task-object and context tokens, fuses cross-camera evidence through held-out-view attention, and directly predicts future states conditioned on control. Weak binding anchors the target and gripper at low annotation cost, while SIGReg sharpens the geometric representation. Experiments show that the learned representation transfers substantially more task-relevant information to downstream probes than a reconstruction-free latent baseline, while keeping the predictor lightweight. The resulting predictive interface supports model-predictive-control (MPC) candidate evaluation and imagined-rollout behavior-agent training. Validation on real underwater video shows the same architecture recovering a withheld camera's object state and staying ahead of persistence, so the recipe transfers beyond simulation.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了Underwater C$^{3}$-JEPA（跨视角、控制条件、上下文扩展），一种面向近场重载水下ROV打捞任务的以对象为中心的多视角预测世界模型。在不依赖接触传感器的情况下，该模型在潜空间中预测任务对象状态如何通过接触交互以及车辆流体动力学滞后而演化，输入为同步的多视角RGB观测和车辆控制信号。C$^{3}$-JEPA将多相机观测编码为任务对象和上下文令牌，通过留出视角注意力融合跨相机证据，并直接预测以控制为条件的未来状态。弱绑定机制以较低的标注成本锚定目标和夹持器，而SIGReg则增强了几何表示的锐度。实验表明，与无重建的潜空间基线相比，所学表示向下游探针传输了显著更多的任务相关信息，同时保持了预测器的轻量性。所得到的预测接口支持模型预测控制（MPC）候选评估和想象式滚动行为的智能体训练。在真实水下视频上的验证表明，相同的架构能够恢复被遮挡相机的对象状态并持续领先于持续性预测，表明该方法可超越仿真环境迁移应用。

Authors: Yuncong Yang, Jinlong Li, Yulong Xue, Feng Wu, Chunwen Zhang, Lei Qiao, Xuyang Wang

Contact as a Decision Variable: Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection for Legged Loco-Manipulation Locomotion

legged loco-manipulation contact selection capability tradeoff whole-body optimization quadruped robot

简要说明：本文提出能力权衡接触选择（CTCS）方法，通过平衡残余力旋量、末端可达性和基座移动性与接触获取成本，高效选择腿部操作中的环境支撑接触，在仿真和硬件上相比精确评估获得约3倍加速且性能接近。

TLDR: The paper introduces Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection (CTCS), a method that efficiently selects environmental support contacts for legged loco-manipulation by balancing residual wrench, reach, and mobility capabilities against acquisition cost, achieving a 3x speedup over exact evaluation with comparable performance in simulations and hardware.

Abstract: In this paper, we study the joint selection of an environmental support contact and a whole-body configuration for a prescribed loco-manipulation task. A contact may provide greater physical support while restricting the motion required for the task. We formulate this problem through three capability measures: residual wrench, end-effector reach, and base mobility available after satisfying the task requirements, and we balance them against contact acquisition cost. Evaluating these capabilities for every candidate requires repeated whole-body optimizations. To reduce this computational cost, we propose Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection (CTCS). CTCS screens candidates for contact and task feasibility, groups similar candidates within each surface, and predicts their capabilities from exact anchor evaluations using local sensitivity analysis. It checks these predictions through selective exact evaluations, ranks candidates by capability, and evaluates a shortlist exactly for final selection. We evaluate CTCS in simulations and hardware experiments using a Unitree Go2 quadruped with an AgileX NERO arm across $392$ task conditions with nine available support surfaces. Results show that CTCS outperforms ground-only and fixed-contact support, as it can select support surfaces that provide favorable capability trade-offs for the task. Compared with evaluating every candidate exactly, CTCS achieves approximately $3\times$ speedup while closely matching the resulting mean objective value.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了在规定的移动操作任务中，环境支撑接触点与全身姿态的联合选择问题。接触点可能提供更大的物理支撑，但同时会限制任务所需的运动空间。我们通过三个能力指标来构建该问题：残余扳手、末端执行器可达范围以及满足任务要求后剩余的基础移动能力，并将这些指标与接触获取成本进行权衡。对每个候选接触点评估这些能力需要进行重复的全身优化。为降低计算成本，我们提出了能力权衡接触选择方法（CTCS）。CTCS首先筛选出满足接触与任务可行性的候选点，将每个表面内相似的候选点进行分组，并通过基于局部灵敏度分析的精确锚点评估来预测其能力。该方法通过选择性精确评估来验证这些预测，按能力对候选点进行排序，并对最终候选列表进行精确评估以作出最终选择。我们在仿真和硬件实验中评估了CTCS，采用搭载AgileX NERO机械臂的Unitree Go2四足机器人，覆盖了九个可用支撑表面下的392种任务条件。结果表明，CTCS优于仅地面支撑和固定接触支撑方案，因为它能够选择为任务提供有利能力权衡的支撑表面。与对所有候选点进行精确评估相比，CTCS实现了约3倍的加速，同时最终平均目标值与之高度接近。

Authors: Al Jaber Mahmud, Shuai Li, Xuan Wang

Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think WorldModel

visual world models intermediate targets Anchored Planning frozen model action synthesis

简要说明：本文表明在冻结的世界模型规划器中使用中间目标而非最终目标可提升性能，并提出了锚定规划（Anchored Planning），通过检索观测片段来设置这些目标，在无需额外训练的情况下优于已发布的LeWM规划器。

TLDR: This paper shows that using intermediate targets instead of final goals in frozen world model planners improves performance, and introduces Anchored Planning which retrieves observed segments to set such targets, outperforming the released LeWM planner without additional training.

Abstract: Planners built on visual world models commonly score each predicted outcome by its distance to the encoded goal image. We show that this target can limit control even with exact dynamics and globally optimal short-horizon search: reaching a goal may require actions that initially move away from it. With frozen LeWM models, intermediate targets substantially improve action synthesis and recorded-action ranking on Cube, PushT, Reacher, and TwoRoom. Learned targets and targets drawn from observed experience both produce these gains. We introduce Anchored Planning, which retrieves a recorded segment whose start and end resemble the current and goal observations, then aims at an observation shortly after its start. The frozen model scores actions toward this target from the current state. Without additional training, planning toward observed targets outperforms the released LeWM planner on every task in our long-range evaluation. Additional final-goal search falls short of the same gains. Lower successor-prediction error need not translate into better control. Success also depends on how far ahead the target is placed and on shrinking the retrieval span as execution advances. Changing only the target lets the same frozen model and planner reach goals that final-goal scoring misses.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉世界模型构建的规划器通常会根据每个预测结果与编码后的目标图像之间的距离进行评分。我们证明，即使具备精确的动力学模型和全局最优的短视距搜索，这种目标设定也可能限制控制效果：达到目标有时需要先采取远离目标的动作。在使用冻结的LeWM模型时，中间目标显著改善了Cube、PushT、Reacher和TwoRoom任务上的动作合成效果及记录动作排名。无论是学习得到的目标还是从观测经验中提取的目标，均能带来这些提升。我们提出了“锚定规划”（Anchored Planning）方法，该方法检索一段记录的片段，使其起点和终点分别接近当前观测和目标观测，然后将目标设定为该片段起点稍后的一个观测状态。冻结模型从当前状态出发，对这一目标方向的动作进行评分。无需额外训练，仅通过向观测目标进行规划，即可在长距离评估中的所有任务上超越已发布的LeWM规划器。单纯依赖最终目标搜索则无法达到同样的效果。更低的后续状态预测误差并不必然转化为更优的控制性能。成功与否还取决于目标设置的距离远近，以及随着执行推进而逐步缩小检索范围。仅改变目标设定，便能使相同的冻结模型和规划器达到最终目标评分所无法实现的最终目标。

Authors: Xvyuan Liu, Jianjie Fang, Chen Gao, Yong Li

Body-Grounded Replanning for Physically Adaptive Manipulation Manipulation

body-grounded replanning internal physical state LLM replanning manipulation physical adaptation

简要说明：本文提出一种身体接地重规划框架，利用内部物理状态（关节负载、运动约束）触发基于LLM的策略重规划，在仿真和真实机器人到达任务中提高任务成功率并减少物理消耗。

TLDR: This paper introduces a body-grounded replanning framework that uses internal physical state (joint loads, mobility constraints) to trigger LLM-based strategy replanning during manipulation, improving task success and reducing physical effort in simulated and real-robot reaching tasks.

Abstract: Manipulation requires not only reasoning about the external environment, but also about the robot's physical condition. A strategy may remain geometrically feasible while becoming physically unsuitable due to increased joint load or limited mobility, yet internal physical state is typically used only for low-level control. We propose body-grounded high-level replanning, which uses internal physical state to adapt manipulation strategies during execution. Body-state events trigger strategy replanning, and an LLM interprets the underlying joint-level state, recent execution statistics, and execution history to select a context-dependent alternative, while leaving the task objective and low-level controller unchanged. We evaluate the framework on a reaching task under controlled load and asymmetric mobility constraints in simulation and on a real robot. Our experiments show that body-grounded replanning maintains high task success while reducing physical effort and enabling more efficient strategy adaptation. Additional contact-rich manipulation experiments demonstrate the applicability of the same replanning interface beyond reaching. These results show that internal physical state can inform not only low-level control, but also high-level decisions about how a manipulation task should be performed.

摘要（中文）：操作不仅需要对周围环境进行推理，还需考虑机器人自身的物理状态。一种策略可能在几何上仍然可行，但若因关节负荷增加或运动灵活性受限而变得在物理上不适用，然而，内部物理状态通常仅用于底层控制。为此，我们提出了一种基于身体状态的高层重规划方法，利用内部物理状态在执行过程中调整操作策略。身体状态事件触发策略重规划，大语言模型（LLM）对底层关节状态、近期执行统计以及执行历史进行解读，以选择与情境相关的替代策略，同时保持任务目标与底层控制器不变。我们在仿真环境及真实机器人上，针对受控负荷与不对称运动约束下的到达任务评估了该框架。实验结果表明，基于身体状态的重规划能在保持高任务成功率的同時，降低物理负荷并实现更高效的策略调整。此外，接触丰富的操作实验进一步验证了该重规划接口在到达任务之外的适用性。这些结果表明，内部物理状态不仅能为底层控制提供依据，还能为操作任务应如何执行的高层决策提供参考。

Authors: Namiko Saito, Hiroshi Kera

Res-HIL: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

residual reinforcement learning human-in-the-loop dexterous manipulation imitation learning sample-efficient

简要说明：Res-HIL提出了一种人在环残差强化学习框架，在冻结的模仿策略之上学习修正动作，结合直接残差监督和干预感知奖励塑形，在接触丰富的灵巧操作任务中实现了样本高效的学习。

TLDR: Res-HIL introduces a human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning framework that learns corrective actions on top of a frozen imitation policy, combining direct residual supervision and intervention-aware reward shaping to achieve sample-efficient dexterous manipulation across contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations, but the resulting policies can fail outside the training data, while collecting more demonstrations requires substantial human effort. Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning uses corrective feedback during online training, but typically learns the complete task policy rather than refining a pretrained imitation policy. We introduce Res-HIL, a human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning framework that learns corrective actions on top of a frozen imitation policy. Each human intervention provides two complementary learning signals: direct supervision of the residual policy and reward shaping of preceding autonomous behavior. Res-HIL combines these signals with zero initialization of the residual policy to stabilize and accelerate online learning. We evaluate Res-HIL on five contact-rich manipulation tasks spanning high-precision and long-horizon behaviors. With only 20 initial demonstrations, Res-HIL outperforms state-of-the-art full-policy human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning and residual fine-tuning without human guidance on every task after ten minutes of online training. Res-HIL improves its pretrained base policies and outperforms imitation policies trained with five times more demonstrations. An ablation study shows that direct residual supervision is critical to performance, while intervention-aware reward shaping substantially improves training efficiency.

摘要（中文）：**摘要** 模仿学习使机器人能够从示范中获取操作技能，但由此得到的策略在训练数据之外可能失效，而收集更多示范则需要大量人力。人在回路强化学习在在线训练过程中利用纠正性反馈，但通常学习的是完整任务策略，而非对预训练的模仿策略进行精炼。我们提出了Res-HIL，一种人在回路残差强化学习框架，它在冻结的模仿策略之上学习纠正动作。每次人工干预都提供两种互补的学习信号：对残差策略的直接监督，以及对先前自主行为的奖励塑形。Res-HIL将这些信号与残差策略的零初始化相结合，以稳定并加速在线学习。我们在五个涉及高精度和长时程行为的接触丰富型操作任务上评估了Res-HIL。仅需20次初始示范，经过十分钟在线训练后，Res-HIL在所有任务上均优于最先进的完整策略人在回路强化学习和无人工引导的残差微调方法。Res-HIL提升了其预训练基础策略的性能，并优于使用五倍于其示范数量训练的模仿策略。消融研究表明，直接残差监督对性能至关重要，而干预感知的奖励塑形则显著提高了训练效率。

Authors: Mariia Iavorskaia, Christian Dietz, Sebastian Albrecht, Majid Khadiv

World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal Manipulation

Vision-Language Models Robot Manipulation Action Rehearsal Multi-Agent Harness Skill Evolution

简要说明：世界行动代理（WAA）是一种多智能体框架，通过提供包含接触视图、行动预演和视图内修正的视觉行动工作空间，使VLM能够操控机器人进行操作，在LIBERO-Pro上达到最先进水平，并通过对框架轨迹微调提升领域外成功率。

TLDR: World Action Agent (WAA) is a multi-agent harness that lets VLMs pilot robots for manipulation by providing a visual action workspace with contact views, action rehearsal, and in-view correction, achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Pro and improving OOD success via fine-tuning on harness traces.

Abstract: General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) bring broad knowledge and spatial reasoning to robot manipulation, yet existing systems either use them indirectly, to predict constraints or write programs, or give them a view of the scene rather than a world in which to act. We present World Action Agent (WAA), a multi-agent harness through which VLMs pilot robots with basic tools, making every decision within a visual action workspace. The workspace has three properties. Contact views, selected automatically from the scene geometry, present the scene around the current interaction. Action rehearsal turns each action into an editable proposal that the agent, alone or through an Imagination Agent, previews and revises against planning feedback before execution. In-view correction closes the loop between observation, rehearsal, and low-level execution, letting the agent remove residual offsets in the view where it observes them. Through the same workspace, WAA acquires embodied procedural knowledge in two ways: it evolves multimodal skills from expert videos and human teaching under evidence-based review and consults them through a Skill Agent, and its interaction traces train smaller VLMs to pilot the same harness. On LIBERO-Pro, WAA with skills evolved only from LIBERO-90 reaches a state-of-the-art 75.6% average success, outperforming end-to-end VLAs, code-as-policy agents, and a visual-harness baseline with the same backbone; the same skills remain effective on robosuite without further learning. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on harness traces raises its out-of-domain success from 1.7% to 43.3%.

摘要（中文）：通用型视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为机器人操作带来了广泛的知识与空间推理能力，然而现有系统要么间接使用它们以预测约束或编写程序，要么仅向它们呈现场景视图，而非提供一个可供行动的世界。我们提出世界行动智能体（World Action Agent，WAA），这是一种多智能体框架，通过该框架，VLMs能够借助基本工具操控机器人，并在可视化行动工作区内做出每一项决策。该工作区具有三个特性。接触视图（Contact views）根据场景几何信息自动选择，呈现当前交互周围的场景。行动预演（Action rehearsal）将每个行动转化为可编辑的提议，智能体可单独或通过想象智能体（Imagination Agent）在规划反馈的基础上对其进行预览和修订，然后再执行。视图内修正（In-view correction）闭环连接了观察、预演与低层执行，使智能体能够在观察到残差偏移的视图中直接消除这些偏移。通过同一工作区，WAA以两种方式获取具身程序性知识：它在基于证据的审查下，从专家视频和人类教学中演化出多模态技能，并通过技能智能体（Skill Agent）调用这些技能；同时，其交互轨迹训练较小的VLMs来操作同一框架。在LIBERO-Pro上，仅从LIBERO-90演化技能的WAA达到了75.6%的平均成功率，刷新了当前最优水平，超越了端到端视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）、代码即策略智能体以及具有相同主干网络的可视化框架基线；这些技能在无需进一步学习的情况下，在robosuite中依然保持有效。利用框架轨迹对Qwen3.5-9B进行微调，将其在域外场景中的成功率从1.7%提升至43.3%。

Authors: Yehang Zhang, Haojian Huang, Yifan Chang, Jianchong Su, Bohan Zhou, Yingjie Xu, Wosong Chen, Tianhao Zhou, Chenxu Wang, Tianyi Zhang, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Shiyuan Deng, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen, Zexi Li

Beyond Spatial Benchmarks: From Spatial Reasoning to Navigation VLN

spatial reasoning navigation vision-language-action distillation HM3D

简要说明：本文探讨了空间推理基准与导航性能之间的差距，提出了 Spatial-Nav-100K 数据集和两阶段微调方法以及 Spatial-NPD 蒸馏技术，在推理时无需显式空间推理即可显著提升导航性能，在 HM3D 和 MP3D 基准上取得了优异成绩。

TLDR: This paper investigates the gap between spatial reasoning benchmarks and navigation performance, proposing Spatial-Nav-100K and a two-stage fine-tuning method plus Spatial-NPD distillation to improve navigation without explicit spatial reasoning at inference, achieving strong results on HM3D and MP3D benchmarks.

Abstract: Does progress on spatial reasoning benchmarks translate into better navigation? Existing benchmarks test isolated inferences from images or videos, with little connection to downstream navigation. Our analysis reveals a gap between benchmark-oriented spatial specialization and navigation performance, and shows how aligning spatial supervision with navigation goals, phases, and decision learning improves navigation. Guided by these findings, we build \textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K} and fine-tune in two stages, \textit{i.e.} first learning a shared spatial-navigation foundation, and then specializing each phase with the abilities it relies on. We further introduce Spatial-NPD, where a teacher conditioned on spatial priors produces grounded action preferences and distills them into a student policy, so no explicit spatial reasoning is needed at inference. With 45 A100 GPU-hours of policy training, our 8B model reaches SR/SPL of 77.4/35.4 on HM3D-v0.2, 60.2/30.5 on HM3D-v0.1, and 47.9/20.6 on train-unseen MP3D. It outperforms several systems that rely on closed-source models or thousands of GPU-hours of training, at 148 ms per action step. All code and datasets will be publicly available at https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav.

摘要（中文）：空间推理基准的进展能否转化为更优的导航能力？现有基准主要测试从图像或视频中进行的孤立推理，与下游导航任务关联甚少。我们的分析揭示了以基准为导向的空间专长与导航性能之间存在脱节，并展示了如何将空间监督与导航目标、阶段及决策学习相对齐，从而提升导航表现。基于这些发现，我们构建了\textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K}数据集，并采用两阶段微调策略：首先学习共享的空间-导航基础，然后针对各阶段所依赖的能力进行专门化训练。此外，我们提出了Spatial-NPD方法，其中教师模型基于空间先验生成有依据的动作偏好，并将其蒸馏到学生策略中，从而在推理时无需显式空间推理。仅需45个A100 GPU小时的策略训练，我们的8B模型在HM3D-v0.2上达到SR/SPL为77.4/35.4，在HM3D-v0.1上为60.2/30.5，在未见过的MP3D训练集上为47.9/20.6。该模型在每动作步148毫秒的延迟下，超越了多个依赖闭源模型或数千GPU小时训练的系统。所有代码和数据集将公开于https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav。

Authors: Xun Huang, Shijia Zhao, Rongsheng Qu, Jiayuan Li, Xin Lu, Weixin Li, Chenglu Wen, Cheng Wang

BeyondRetarget: Learning Executable Humanoid Motions Directly from Monocular Video HumanoidEmbodied

end-to-end learning monocular video humanoid robot motion generation contact-aware optimization

简要说明：BeyondRetarget 是一个端到端框架，直接从单目RGB视频映射到可执行的人形机器人动作，绕过了显式的人体运动表示和重定向，以提高物理合理性和执行成功率。

TLDR: BeyondRetarget is an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to executable humanoid robot motions, bypassing explicit human motion representations and retargeting to improve physical plausibility and execution success.

Abstract: Learning executable motions from human videos offers a scalable solution for humanoid robots to acquire demonstration motions. However, existing pipelines typically first construct an explicit human motion representation and then convert it into robot motions via motion retargeting. Although such methods can effectively leverage large volumes of existing human data for training, the substantial differences between humans and humanoid robots in locomotion mechanisms and joint degree-of-freedom configurations make motions generated by this human-representation-centric approach difficult to execute on robots. Furthermore, errors introduced during human motion estimation inevitably propagate to the retargeting stage and cannot be eliminated via joint optimization. We propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to robot motions. Discarding the explicit human representation, this framework learns robot-oriented implicit representations directly from visual observations, enabling the model to capture cross-morphology motion structures. To generate motions more suitable for robot execution, we further design a contact-aware motion optimization mechanism to improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Experiments show that BeyondRetarget significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of generated robot motions, while achieving higher execution success rates and lower latency in both simulation environments and real humanoid robots.

摘要（中文）：从人类视频中学习可执行的运动为仿人机器人获取演示动作提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。然而，现有流程通常首先构建明确的类人运动表示，然后通过运动重定向将其转换为机器人运动。尽管此类方法能够有效利用大量已有的人类数据进行训练，但人类与仿人机器人在运动机制和关节自由度配置上的显著差异，使得这种以类人表示为中心的方法所生成的运动难以在机器人上执行。此外，人类运动估计过程中引入的误差不可避免会传播到重定向阶段，且无法通过联合优化加以消除。我们提出了BeyondRetarget，一种端到端框架，可直接将单目RGB视频映射为机器人运动。该框架摒弃显式类人表示，直接从视觉观察中学习面向机器人的隐式表示，从而使模型能够捕捉跨形态的运动结构。为进一步生成更适于机器人执行的运动，我们设计了一种接触感知的运动优化机制，以提升时间一致性和物理合理性。实验表明，BeyondRetarget显著提高了生成机器人运动的准确性和鲁棒性，同时在仿真环境和真实仿人机器人上实现了更高的执行成功率和更低的延迟。

Authors: Tianyu Xiong, Yi Lu, Jinrui Wang, Ziqi Liang, Dandan Lei, Xiaoyang Zhou, Xiao-xiao Long, Qiu Shen, Xun Cao

PolyUMI: Accessible Visual-Tactile-Audio Data Collection for Object Inference and Manipulation Manipulation

multimodal policy visual-tactile-audio data collection contact-rich manipulation imitation learning

简要说明：PolyUMI 提出了一个开源无线手持夹爪，用于同步采集视觉、触觉、音频和本体感觉演示，并设计了令牌级多模态策略 VisTA 来整合这些传感器信息，在物体推断、滑移控制和接触丰富操作任务上优于仅依靠视觉的策略。

TLDR: PolyUMI introduces an open-source wireless handheld gripper for collecting synchronized visual-tactile-audio-proprioceptive demonstrations, plus a token-level multimodal policy (VisTA) that integrates these sensors for contact-aware robot manipulation, showing improved object inference, slip control, and contact-rich tasks over vision-only baselines.

Abstract: Humans typically rely on vision, touch, hearing, and proprioception to perceive contact and adapt their actions during manipulation. Providing robots with comparable responsiveness therefore requires hardware that can retain and use these complementary sensory signals. Most imitation-learning systems, however, observe demonstrations primarily through vision and proprioception, limiting access to contact information that is difficult to infer visually. We present PolyUMI, an open-source platform for scalable visual--tactile--audio demonstration collection and robot deployment. Its lightweight, wireless handheld gripper records synchronized wrist-camera, optical tactile, contact-audio, and proprioceptive observations without requiring a tethered workstation. The same sensing finger can be transferred to the robot end effector, preserving the sensing geometry between demonstration collection and policy execution. To effectively use these heterogeneous observations, we further introduce VisTA, a token-level multimodal policy that integrates information across sensors and time to predict contact-aware robot actions. Experiments spanning object inference, slip control, and contact-rich manipulation show that touch and audio reveal task-relevant information beyond vision and that VisTA is competitive with or outperforms existing multimodal policies. Together, PolyUMI and VisTA provide an accessible pipeline for collecting multimodal demonstrations and learning policies that perceive physical interaction beyond vision. Project Page: https://polyumi-vista.github.io

摘要（中文）：人类通常依靠视觉、触觉、听觉和本体感觉来感知接触并在操作过程中调整自身动作。因此，若要使机器人具备同等的响应能力，就需要能够保留并利用这些互补感官信号的硬件。然而，大多数模仿学习系统主要通过视觉和本体感觉来观察示范过程，限制了获取难以通过视觉推断的接触信息的能力。我们提出了PolyUMI，一个用于可扩展的视觉-触觉-音频示教采集和机器人部署的开源平台。其轻量级无线手持夹爪能够记录同步的腕部相机、光学触觉、接触音频和本体感觉观测数据，且无需连接有线工作站。同一传感手指可转移至机器人末端执行器，从而在示教采集与策略执行之间保持传感几何结构的一致性。为有效利用这些异构观测数据，我们进一步引入了VisTA，一种令牌级多模态策略，能够在传感器和时间维度上整合信息，以预测具有接触感知能力的机器人动作。涵盖物体推断、滑移控制和接触丰富操作的多项实验表明，触觉和音频能够揭示超出视觉范围的任务相关信息，且VisTA与现有多模态策略相比具有竞争力或更优表现。PolyUMI与VisTA共同提供了一套易于使用的流程，用于采集多模态示教数据并学习超越视觉的物理交互感知策略。项目页面：https://polyumi-vista.github.io

Authors: Conor W. Hayes, Rickmer Krohn, Aravind Ramaswami, Anunth Ramaswami, Nils Dengler, Kevin M. Lynch, J. Edward Colgate, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Matthew L. Elwin

Combining Evasive and Braking Reactions for Safety Reference Models in Automated Vehicles AutonomousDriving

hybrid fuzzy safety model safety reference model evasive steering automated driving collision avoidance

简要说明：本文提出一种混合模糊安全模型，将纵向制动与横向紧急转向相结合，用于自动驾驶安全参考，在切入场景中评估并扩展了可预防范围，同时保持计算可行性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hybrid fuzzy safety model that combines longitudinal braking and lateral evasive steering for automated driving safety reference, evaluated in cut-in scenarios and shown to expand the preventability envelope while remaining computationally tractable.

Abstract: Computational models of careful and competent human drivers are essential for scenario-based evaluation of automated driving systems (ADS). However, most existing safety reference models primarily focus on longitudinal braking, neglecting the role of evasive steering in human collision avoidance. This paper proposes a hybrid Fuzzy-Safety Model (FSM-H) that integrates longitudinal mitigation and lateral avoidance within a unified behavioral framework. The braking component is governed by Proactive Fuzzy Safety (PFS) metrics, representing the erosion of longitudinal safety margins, while the steering component is driven by Criticality Fuzzy Safety for lane-change (CFS-LC), capturing lateral conflict severity and maneuver feasibility. A finite-state architecture models the sequential escalation from nominal driving to braking and, when necessary, to evasive steering, incorporating perception-reaction time and lane-check delays to reflect human decision processes. The model is evaluated in reconstructed high-criticality cut-in scenarios and compared with braking-only and steering-only reference strategies. Results show that the hybrid approach expands the preventability envelope while maintaining behavioral plausibility and computational tractability. The proposed framework provides a transparent and explainable human reference model suitable for simulation-based ADS safety benchmarking and regulatory assessment.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 对于自动驾驶系统（ADS）的基于场景评估而言，具备谨慎且胜任能力的人类驾驶员计算模型至关重要。然而，现有的大多数安全参考模型主要关注纵向制动，忽视了避让转向在人类碰撞避免中的作用。本文提出一种混合模糊安全模型（FSM-H），在统一的行为框架内整合纵向缓解与横向避让。制动部分由主动模糊安全（PFS）指标控制，表征纵向安全裕度的侵蚀；转向部分则由换道临界模糊安全（CFS-LC）驱动，捕捉横向冲突严重程度及 maneuver 可行性。采用有限状态架构对从正常驾驶到制动、必要时再升级至避让转向的序列过程进行建模，并引入感知-反应时间及车道检查延迟以反映人类决策过程。该模型在高临界性切入场景的重构中进行了评估，并与仅制动和仅转向的参考策略进行了对比。结果表明，混合方法在保持行为合理性和计算可行性的同时，扩展了可预防性包络。所提出的框架提供了一种透明且可解释的人类参考模型，适用于基于仿真的ADS安全基准测试及法规评估。

Authors: Riccardo Donà, Konstantinos Mattas, Biagio Ciuffo

Coupled State-Space Modelling, Control, and Policy Distillation for Hybrid Rigid-Pneumatic Manipulators Manipulation

Hybrid rigid-pneumatic manipulators Kresling origami Model predictive control Policy distillation DAgger

简要说明：本文为刚柔混合机械臂建立了耦合模型，量化了解耦控制的代价，并将模型预测控制提炼为可在实时运行的神经策略，成功率很高。

TLDR: The paper derives a coupled model for hybrid rigid-pneumatic manipulators, quantifies the cost of decoupled control, and distills an MPC into a fast neural policy that runs in real time with high success rates.

Abstract: Hybrid manipulators combine motorized rigid joints with pressure-actuated origami segments. Published arms of this kind are controlled with decoupled per-DOF loops, and the cost of this approximation has not been quantified, because the coupled model needed to measure it has not been built. This paper derives such a model for a chain of $N$ alternating revolute joints and Kresling origami segments, including pneumatic chamber dynamics and crease hysteresis. Using the model, we measure the coupling directly and show that its strength varies joint by joint, and that decoupled control loses precisely on the strongly coupled joints while remaining competitive on the one nearly decoupled joint. Coupled model-based controllers track $2.5\times$ tighter than a decoupled PID baseline at lower torque. However, the model predictive controller (MPC) is too slow for real time, and model-free reinforcement learning stalls far below acceptable success rates on a strict settling metric. We therefore distill the MPC into a small neural policy with behavior cloning and DAgger. The distilled policy settles 93-94$\%$ of goals with zero collisions, within a few points of its teacher, and runs inside the 5 ms control step where the MPC does not. Where the teacher itself fails, we trace the failure to a limit cycle with the bellows' lightly damped mode, and we remove it by selecting goal postures holdable at low pressure.

摘要（中文）：混合机械臂将电机驱动的刚性关节与气压驱动的折纸结构段相结合。已发表的此类机械臂采用解耦的逐自由度控制回路进行控制，而这种近似处理所带来的代价尚未被量化，因为用于测量该代价所需的耦合模型尚未建立。本文针对由$N$个交替布置的转动关节与Kresling折纸段组成的链式结构推导了这样一个模型，其中包含气动腔室动力学和折痕迟滞效应。利用该模型，我们直接测量了耦合作用，并表明其强度随关节不同而变化，同时发现解耦控制在强耦合关节上恰好失效，而在近乎解耦的单个关节上仍具竞争力。基于耦合模型的控制器在更低扭矩下实现了比解耦PID基线紧凑$2.5\times$的跟踪精度。然而，模型预测控制器（MPC）因计算速度过慢而无法实时运行，而无模型强化学习在严格的稳定指标下停滞于远低于可接受成功率的水平。为此，我们通过行为克隆和DAgger算法将MPC蒸馏为一个轻量级神经策略。该蒸馏策略在零碰撞条件下完成了93-94$\%$的目标稳定任务，与教师策略仅差几个百分点，并在5 ms控制步长内运行，而MPC无法在该时间内完成计算。针对教师策略本身失败的情况，我们将其归因于波纹管轻阻尼模态引发的极限环，并通过选择可在低压下保持的目标姿态来消除该问题。

Authors: Alan Royce Gabriel Samuel, Pulkit Verma

WRAP: Fixtureless Wrench-aware Multi-Robot Assembly Planning Manipulation

multi-robot assembly planning wrench-aware fixtureless grasp planning assembly sequence

简要说明：WRAP 提出了一种多机器人装配规划方法，通过基于力/力矩感知的线性规划确定有效抓取和支撑力，从而无需夹具即可进行装配，并结合搜索启发式进行序列与运动规划，在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: WRAP presents a multi-robot assembly planning method that eliminates fixtures by using wrench-aware reasoning to determine valid grasps and support forces, leveraging a linear program and search heuristics to plan assembly sequences and motion plans, validated in simulation and on real robots.

Abstract: Assembly using robots often requires specially designed fixtures, or relies on top-down only assembly strategies. Using multiple robots, we can avoid using fixtures and make robotic assembly more flexible. Planning assembly sequences for multiple robots is challenging due to the high number of possible task assignments and orders. In addition, we need to reason over forces that occur during the assembly process, e.g., to decide if multiple robots are required for support, or if external support such as a table should be used. We present Wrap, a multi-robot assembly planner for multi-part assemblies, given the inter-part ordering-dependencies, the part meshes, and their initial state. We formulate a linear program to reason about valid grasps for supporting the forces that occur during assembly. The search leverages the assembly sequence, and greedily finds a feasible solution per assembly step by computing a heuristic via a cheap backwards search, and using the heuristic in the more expensive forward search. We then solve the multi-robot, multi-goal motion planning problem, and for execution, we split the plan into contact-rich assembly skills, and free space motion. We benchmark the planner on a variety of multi-part assemblies, and apply the planner to groups of robots differing in size and kinematics. We validate the work both in a physics simulation, and in real. Videos and code are available at https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap.

摘要（中文）：使用机器人进行装配通常需要专门设计的夹具，或依赖于仅限自上而下的装配策略。通过使用多台机器人，我们可以避免使用夹具，并使机器人装配更加灵活。由于可能存在的任务分配和顺序数量庞大，为多台机器人规划装配序列具有挑战性。此外，我们还需要考虑装配过程中产生的力，例如，判断是否需要多台机器人提供支撑，或者是否应使用如工作台等外部支撑。 我们提出了Wrap，一种针对多部件装配的多机器人装配规划器，其输入包括部件间的顺序依赖关系、部件网格及其初始状态。我们构建了一个线性规划模型，以推理支撑装配过程中所产生力的有效抓取方式。搜索过程利用装配序列，通过廉价的逆向搜索计算启发式信息，并在成本更高的正向搜索中使用该启发式，从而贪婪地为每个装配步骤找到可行解。 随后，我们解决多机器人、多目标运动规划问题，并在执行阶段将规划拆分为接触密集的装配技能和自由空间运动。我们在多种多部件装配任务上对该规划器进行了基准测试，并将其应用于大小和运动学特性不同的机器人组。我们既在物理仿真中验证了该工作，也在真实环境中进行了验证。视频和代码可在 https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap 获取。

Authors: Valentin N. Hartmann, Huang Su, Yijiang Huang, Stelian Coros

RACaP: Agentic Reasoning, Acting, and Coding as Policies for Evolvable Robot Learning Manipulation

Code as Policies ReAct Robot Learning LIBERO Vision-Language-Action

简要说明：RACaP是一种智能体机器人学习框架，将可复用的代码策略转化为离线进化的类型化API，并在部署时使用ReAct循环进行决策，在LIBERO基准上取得高成功率，并可通过蒸馏实现高效部署。

TLDR: RACaP is an agentic framework for robot learning that separates reusable Code as Policies (CaP) into typed APIs evolving offline, while using a ReAct loop for runtime action selection, achieving strong success rates on LIBERO benchmarks and enabling efficient distillation for on-robot deployment.

Abstract: General-purpose robot agents must learn from experience, transfer to new tasks, and act efficiently. Code as Policies (CaP) methods generate and repair programs at runtime, incurring latency and entangling reusable mechanisms with task-specific decisions. We introduce RACaP, an agentic framework that moves coding to evolution and uses a Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) loop to call frozen, typed Policy APIs at deployment. A two-phase strategy combines capability curriculum learning with autonomous self-evolution to improve the APIs, the ReAct harness, and experience memory. The APIs encode reusable physical mechanisms while exposing arguments for runtime adaptation. ReAct combines task-specific working memory, long-term experience memory, and visual feedback to select actions, verify outcomes, and recover from failures without modifying source code. RACaP achieves 54.4% success on LIBERO-90, 45.0% on zero-shot LIBERO-PRO, and 46.0% on LIBERO-Long, compared with at most 4.0% for CaP baselines on long-horizon tasks. On LIBERO-PRO, it achieves 2.5 times the success rate of CaP baselines and a 1.9-fold speedup in median policy time. For efficient on-robot deployment, rejection-sampled fine-tuning distills GPT-5.6 ReAct decisions into Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, yielding a 13.2-fold per-decision inference speedup and reducing repeated physical calls from 16 to 4. These results show that separating reusable code from runtime decisions supports continued evolution, effective transfer, and efficient long-horizon control.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人智能体必须从经验中学习、迁移至新任务并高效执行。代码即策略（CaP）方法在运行时生成并修复程序，导致延迟，并将可复用机制与任务特定决策纠缠在一起。我们提出RACaP，一个将编码移至进化阶段、并在部署时通过推理-行动（ReAct）循环调用冻结的、带类型的策略API的智能体框架。该框架采用两阶段策略，将能力课程学习与自主自我进化相结合，以改进API、ReAct框架及经验记忆。API编码可复用的物理机制，同时暴露参数供运行时自适应调整。ReAct结合任务特定工作记忆、长期经验记忆和视觉反馈来选择动作、验证结果并从失败中恢复，而无需修改源代码。RACaP在LIBERO-90上达到54.4%的成功率，在零样本LIBERO-PRO上达到45.0%，在LIBERO-Long上达到46.0%，而CaP基线在长时程任务上最高仅为4.0%。在LIBERO-PRO上，其成功率是CaP基线的2.5倍，中位策略时间加速1.9倍。为实现在机器人上的高效部署，拒绝采样微调将GPT-5.6的ReAct决策蒸馏至Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，实现每次决策推理加速13.2倍，并将重复物理调用从16次减少至4次。这些结果表明，将可复用代码与运行时决策分离，能够支持持续进化、有效迁移以及高效的长时程控制。

Authors: Zexi Li, Yehang Zhang, Haojian Huang, Bohan Zhou, Wenqian Li, Chenxu Wang, Yifan Chang, Yangkai Wei, Tianyi Zhang, Ying-Cong Chen, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, James Cheng

Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs VLA

early exits flow-matching VLA compute allocation KV cache synthesis task-dependent

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对流匹配VLA模型的框架，通过解耦早期退出和KV缓存合成机制，联合配置骨干网络深度、动作专家深度和去噪步数，在LIBERO和Meta-World上降低延迟和计算量并提升成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework for flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that jointly configures backbone depth, action expert depth, and denoising steps via decoupled early exits and a KV Cache synthesis mechanism, reducing latency and computation while improving success rates on LIBERO and Meta-World.

Abstract: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a potential solution for generalist robot control, designed by combining a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with an action expert that generates continuous robot actions. While these models exhibit impressive capabilities, due to their very high number of parameters, their computational requirements are often prohibitive for robotics control. To mitigate these inefficiencies, existing methods predominantly skip VLM backbone layers with early exits or reduce denoising steps, while leaving action expert depth untouched. We propose a framework that exposes backbone depth $V$, action expert depth $A$, and denoising steps $D$ as three jointly configurable compute axes in a VLA. Starting from a pretrained VLA, we attach lightweight Exit Transformers (ET) at intermediate depths in both the backbone and the action expert, trained to distil the last layer of the policy into each exit. Furthermore, we introduce a KV Cache synthesis mechanism that manages the missing keys and values of the skipped backbone layers, allowing the action expert to exit deeper than the backbone. Finally, we show that the optimal compute budget is task-dependent, with different tasks benefiting from different axes and depths. Notably, our method does not require training the original policy from scratch, and for each exit, it increases the number of parameters by only $2.1\%$ for SmolVLA and $4.1\%$ for $π_{0.5}$. We validate our approach across two flow-matching VLAs (SmolVLA, $π_{0.5}$) and two benchmarks (LIBERO, Meta-World), revealing complementary effects: $V$ and $A$ respectively reduce FLOPs and latency, while $D$ improves both. Our joint configurations $(V,A,D)$ reduce latency by $79.2\%$ and computation (FLOPs) by $31.8\%$, while improving mean success rate by $5.6\%$.

摘要（中文）：流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人控制的一种潜在解决方案，其设计方式是将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）主干网络与生成连续机器人动作的动作专家相结合。尽管这些模型展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但由于其参数量极大，其计算需求往往令机器人控制难以承受。为缓解这些低效问题，现有方法主要采用提前退出方式跳过VLM主干网络层，或减少去噪步数，而动作专家网络的深度则保持不变。我们提出一个框架，将主干网络深度$V$、动作专家深度$A$和去噪步数$D$暴露为VLA中三个可联合配置的计算轴。从预训练的VLA出发，我们在主干网络和动作专家的中间深度处附加轻量级退出Transformer（ET），并训练其将策略的最后一层蒸馏到每个退出点。此外，我们引入一种KV缓存合成机制，用于管理被跳过的主干网络层所缺失的键和值，使动作专家能够比主干网络退出得更深。最后，我们证明最优计算预算取决于任务，不同任务受益于不同的轴和深度。值得注意的是，我们的方法无需从头训练原始策略，且对于每个退出点，SmolVLA的参数仅增加$2.1\%$，$π_{0.5}$的参数仅增加$4.1\%$。我们在两个流匹配VLA（SmolVLA、$π_{0.5}$）和两个基准（LIBERO、Meta-World）上验证了我们的方法，揭示了互补效应：$V$和$A$分别减少FLOPs和延迟，而$D$对两者均有改善。我们的联合配置$(V,A,D)$将延迟降低$79.2\%$，计算量（FLOPs）降低$31.8\%$，同时平均成功率提高$5.6\%$。

Authors: Riccardo Andrea Izzo, Rimvydas Rubavicius, Gianluca Bardaro, Subramanian Ramamoorthy, Matteo Matteucci, Alessandro Suglia

ADM-Planner: LLM-Guided Long-Horizon Planning for Mobile Manipulators with Attention-Enhanced Dynamic Memory Manipulation

LLM-guided planning long-horizon planning dynamic memory mobile manipulator attention-enhanced memory

简要说明：ADM-Planner 利用注意力增强的动态记忆系统和 LLM 引导，为移动操纵器的长时程规划维护选择性状态，在仿真和物理实验中相比静态或未过滤动态记忆提升了成功率并减少了上下文大小。

TLDR: ADM-Planner uses an attention-enhanced dynamic memory system guided by LLMs to maintain selective state for long-horizon mobile manipulation planning, improving success rates and reducing context size over static or unfiltered dynamic memory in simulated and physical experiments.

Abstract: Large language models can decompose mobile-manipulation goals into long action sequences, but the resulting plans remain reliable only while their world context is current. A fixed scene description becomes stale when objects are discovered, moved, or completed while retaining every observation instead produces a growing history with redundant and conflicting state. To resolve this tension, we present an LLM-guided planning framework ADM-Planner with attention-enhanced dynamic memory (ADM). Persistent workspace knowledge is separated from object-centric state, asynchronous observations and action outcomes update that state, and a bounded retriever exposes only the entries that can affect the next decision. The LLM replans when an update invalidates the remaining plan. Across 1,500 task-simulator episodes, the proposed ADM achieved 100% full-task success in the 14-container noisy dynamic setting, compared with 62% for static memory and 97% for unfiltered dynamic memory, while reducing the context-size proxy by 95.8% relative to the latter. In a six-episode live GPT-5 Mini planner, both dynamic memory variants completed every mission, while ADM reduced provider-reported input tokens by 14.4% and mean planner calls from 7.0 to 6.0. A separate 60-trial PyBullet study retained 100% success for ADM, compared with 50% for static memory. Finally, the mobile manipulator with ADM-Planner completed various missions in indoor and outdoor physical experiments while incorporating targets revealed after execution began. The results show that selective state maintenance with ADM, rather than prompt history alone, is a practical basis for long-horizon planning in changing environments. Project page: https://xjp99v5.github.io/ADM-Planner

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型能够将移动操作目标分解为长序列动作，但所生成的计划仅在世界上下文保持最新时才能保持可靠。固定的场景描述在物体被发现、移动或完成时便会过时，而保留所有观察结果则会产生包含冗余和冲突状态的不断增长的历史记录。为解决这一矛盾，我们提出了一种基于LLM引导的规划框架ADM-Planner，其核心是带有注意力增强动态记忆（ADM）的机制。持久的工作空间知识与以对象为中心的状态相分离，异步观察和动作结果持续更新该状态，一个有界检索器仅暴露可能影响下一步决策的条目。当更新使剩余计划失效时，LLM会重新规划。在1，500个任务模拟器场景中，所提出的ADM在包含14个容器的噪声动态环境中实现了100%的全任务成功率，而静态记忆为62%，未过滤的动态记忆为97%，同时相对于后者将上下文大小代理指标降低了95.8%。在六次实况GPT-5 Mini规划器实验中，两种动态记忆变体均完成了所有任务，而ADM将提供商报告的输入令牌数减少了14.4%，平均规划调用次数从7.0次降至6.0次。另一项包含60次试验的PyBullet研究中，ADM保持了100%的成功率，而静态记忆仅为50%。最后，配备ADM-Planner的移动操作机器人在室内和室外物理实验中完成了各种任务，并能够纳入执行开始后才揭示的目标。结果表明，基于ADM的选择性状态维护（而非仅依赖提示历史）是在动态环境中进行长时程规划的实用基础。项目页面：https://xjp99v5.github.io/ADM-Planner

adaptive harness long-horizon tasks multiagent adaptation revision graph vision-language-action models

简要说明：AdaHVLA 提出了一种自适应支架，通过多智能体适配和有状态修订图，迭代优化视觉-语言-动作模型的代码协调策略，显著提升长时程任务在仿真和真实世界中的成功率。

TLDR: AdaHVLA introduces an adaptive harness that iteratively refines code-based coordination policies for vision-language-action models via multiagent adaptation and a stateful revision graph, significantly improving long-horizon task success in simulation and real-world deployment.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer strong local control and instruction following but often struggle with long-horizon tasks requiring persistent memory and planning. Task harnesses provide persistent context for agent reasoning by retaining task history and tracking progress across execution stages. To bring these complementary capabilities together, we introduce AdaHVLA, an adaptive harness that refines code-based coordination policies through robot experience to better align agent reasoning and memory with VLA execution. Its decoupled multiagent adaptation process separates evidence analysis, harness revision, and behavioral assessment into distinct working contexts, using testable coordination hypotheses to guide revisions and subsequent rollouts to assess their predicted effects. A stateful revision graph links execution evidence, hypotheses, revisions, and observed effects, preserving alternative harnesses and adaptation memory to guide refinement across repeated attempts and continued adaptation across tasks and environments. In simulation, AdaHVLA raises mean test success on NaVILA-LH from 22.5\% to as high as 57.5\% and improves manipulation test success across three VLA backbones by up to 30.8 percentage points over the initial harness. Real-world deployment further illustrates how the adapted policies support stable execution across task stages.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在局部控制和指令跟随方面表现出色，但在需要持久记忆和规划的长期任务中往往力不从心。任务框架（Task harness）通过保留任务历史并跟踪各执行阶段的进展，为智能体推理提供持续上下文。为融合这些互补能力，我们提出AdaHVLA——一种自适应框架，通过机器人经验优化基于代码的协调策略，使智能体的推理与记忆更好地与VLA执行对齐。其解耦的多智能体适应过程将证据分析、框架修订和行为评估分离到不同的工作上下文中，利用可测试的协调假设指导修订，并通过后续执行来评估预期效果。一个带状态的修订图将执行证据、假设、修订及观察到的效果关联起来，保留备选框架和适应记忆，以指导多次尝试中的持续优化，并支持跨任务和环境下的持续适应。在仿真实验中，AdaHVLA将NaVILA-LH上的平均测试成功率从22.5%提升至高达57.5%，并在三种VLA主干网络上将操作测试成功率较初始框架最高提升30.8个百分点。真实世界部署进一步验证了适应后的策略如何支持跨任务阶段的稳定执行。

Authors: Junyi Tang, Jie Peng, Zezhen Ding, Yuan Shen, Tianlong Chen

HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI VLA

Physical AI action model code-as-policy program evolution skill distillation

简要说明：HarnessPAI提出了一种模型与形态无关的物理AI框架，将代码视为可执行和可进化的接口，在rollout内以固定程序进行开环执行，在rollout间利用执行反馈闭环进化程序，无需重新训练底层模型即可在多种机器人平台上大幅提升性能。

TLDR: HarnessPAI introduces a model- and embodiment-agnostic harness framework that treats code as an executable interface for physical AI, separating fast open-loop program execution within rollouts from slow closed-loop program evolution across rollouts, significantly improving performance over pure action models and code-as-policy baselines on multiple robot platforms without retraining the underlying model.

Abstract: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks. We introduce HarnessPAI, a model- and embodiment-agnostic Harness framework for Physical AI that treats code as the executable and evolvable interface that organizes the underlying action primitive. The framework separates two timescales: within a rollout, it executes open-loop at the program level, with a fixed program guiding and checking execution; across rollouts, it evolves closed-loop, using execution feedback to revise the program and distill failures into reusable skills. Across desktop robot arms, household robots, a robot vacuum, and a legged walking agent, HarnessPAI improves on both pure action models and code-as-policy baselines without retraining the underlying model: a 61.6-point gain over $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-PRO and a 27.2-point gain over WorldDreamer on RoboCasa atomic tasks. Once a program is selected, rollout execution requires no online high-level LLM deliberation. Beyond execution, the converged program is also a cheap and reliable expert-data collector, and fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ on collected expert data lifts success rate on LIBERO-PRO by 38.8 points. Our results suggest that the frontier of Physical AI depends not only on stronger action models, but also on executable harnesses that integrate perception, task understanding and reasoning, and action execution into a unified, verifiable, and feedback-driven system. Website: https://darwin-agent.github.io/HarnessPAI

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能旨在构建具身智能体，使其能够感知世界、理解并推理世界，进而决定如何行动。然而，该领域主要聚焦于最后一个组成部分：将观测映射为底层控制的动作模型。当前主流的训练范式可能会削弱实现稳健行为所需的感知与推理能力，即便强动作模型也难以应对场景扰动和长时程任务。我们提出HarnessPAI，一种与模型及具身形态无关的物理人工智能Harness框架，将代码视为可执行、可演化的接口，用以组织底层动作原语。该框架区分了两个时间尺度：在一次轨迹展开内，它在程序层面以开环方式执行，由固定程序引导并校验执行过程；在多次轨迹展开之间，它以闭环方式演化，利用执行反馈修正程序，并将失败案例蒸馏为可复用的技能。在桌面机械臂、家庭机器人、扫地机器人和四足行走智能体等场景中，HarnessPAI在不重新训练底层模型的情况下，相较于纯动作模型和以代码为策略的基线均有提升：在LIBERO-PRO上较π₀.₅提升61.6个百分点，在RoboCasa原子任务上较WorldDreamer提升27.2个百分点。一旦程序被选定，轨迹执行无需在线高层大语言模型推理。除执行之外，收敛后的程序还可作为廉价且可靠的数据采集器，基于所采专家数据微调π₀.₅，可使LIBERO-PRO的成功率提升38.8个百分点。我们的结果表明，物理人工智能的前沿不仅取决于更强的动作模型，还取决于将感知、任务理解与推理、动作执行整合为统一、可验证且反馈驱动系统的可执行Harness框架。网站：https://darwin-agent.github.io/HarnessPAI

Authors: Xin Wang, Wenhao Wu, Menghao Zhang, Zhi Wang, Kun Shao, Jian Luan, Yang Li, Qing Li, Shangding Gu, Huichi Zhou, Shuqing Shi, Fei Ni, Shuo Lu, Weicheng Meng, Kang Li, Jin Wu, Kang Zhao, Shangmin Guo, Gen Li, Yongqiang Tang, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie, Heng Qu

DAWN: Noise-Robust Quadruped Parkour via Depth-Denoising World Models Locomotion

depth denoising contrastive learning world model quadruped parkour noise robustness

简要说明：DAWN 提出了一种针对四足机器人跑酷的噪声鲁棒感知框架，通过将深度去噪和对比对齐集成到世界模型中，在真实 Unitree Go1 上实现了无需手动滤波校准的零样本跑酷。

TLDR: DAWN introduces a noise-robust perception framework for quadruped parkour by integrating depth denoising and contrastive alignment into a world model, achieving zero-shot parkour on a real Unitree Go1 without manual filter calibration.

Abstract: Vision-based legged locomotion methods assume clean depth at training time and rely on hand-tuned post-processing filters at deployment. However, filter parameters are rarely disclosed, hindering reproducibility, and performance degrades substantially when depth noise is left unaddressed. Building noise robustness directly into the learning pipeline would eliminate this dependency. While such robustness has been explored for proprioceptive inputs, analogous approaches for depth perception remain largely absent in legged locomotion. We propose DAWN (Denoising and Alignment in World models for Noise-robustness), a noise-robust perception framework for legged locomotion, which builds noise robustness directly into a world model via two modifications: (1) feeding noisy depth to the encoder while keeping clean depth as the reconstruction target, forcing the model to implicitly denoise its input; and (2) applying contrastive learning to align the latent states of noisy and clean depth. Importantly, DAWN is not tied to a specific noise model, requiring no manual tuning to the noise distribution at deployment. Furthermore, it incurs no additional inference cost over existing world model-based methods. Without any manual filter calibration -- relying solely on the learned noise-robust representation -- DAWN achieves zero-shot quadruped parkour on a Unitree Go1: traversing stairs up to 18 cm, clearing gaps up to 70 cm, and mounting steps up to 45 cm from raw depth observations. Ablation studies show that denoising and contrastive alignment contribute at complementary levels -- reconstruction and representation, respectively -- and yield additive gains when combined. Videos and code are available at: https://dawn-parkour.github.io/

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的腿足运动方法在训练时假设深度信息是干净的，并在部署时依赖手工调参的后处理滤波器。然而，滤波器参数很少被公开，阻碍了结果的可复现性，并且在深度噪声未被处理时，性能会显著下降。将噪声鲁棒性直接构建到学习流程中则可以消除这一依赖。尽管此前已有针对本体感知输入的鲁棒性研究，但在腿足运动中，针对深度感知的类似方法仍然缺乏。我们提出DAWN（面向噪声鲁棒性的世界模型去噪与对齐），一种面向腿足运动的噪声鲁棒感知框架，通过两项修改将噪声鲁棒性直接构建到世界模型中：（1）将含噪深度输入编码器，同时以干净深度作为重建目标，迫使模型隐式地对输入进行去噪；（2）应用对比学习对齐含噪和干净深度对应的潜状态。重要的是，DAWN不依赖于特定的噪声模型，在部署时无需针对噪声分布进行任何手动调整。此外，与现有基于世界模型的方法相比，DAWN不增加任何额外推理成本。在完全不进行手动滤波器校准的情况下——仅依靠学习到的噪声鲁棒表示——DAWN在Unitree Go1上实现了零样本四足机器人跑酷：能够跨越高达18厘米的楼梯、越过长达70厘米的间隙，并从原始深度观测中攀上高达45厘米的台阶。消融研究表明，去噪与对比对齐分别在重建和表示两个互补层面发挥作用，二者结合可获得累加性增益。视频和代码见：https://dawn-parkour.github.io/
