Authors: Yohan Choi, Min-Jun Kim, Jin-Sung Kim, Yong-Jae Kim, Youn-Hee Han

CAMP: Cooperative Arm-Hand Motion Planning in Constrained Spaces Manipulation

cooperative arm-hand motion planning constrained spaces feasible hand fibers via-point movement primitives coarse-to-fine optimization

简要说明：CAMP 提出了一种在受限环境下协同臂-手运动规划器，通过可行手部纤维、带臂松弛的分层手部搜索以及端点保持的途径点运动原语进行粗到细优化，在仿真和真实机器人实验中实现了高成功率。

TLDR: CAMP proposes a cooperative arm-hand motion planner for constrained environments, using feasible hand fibers, layered hand search with arm relaxation, and endpoint-preserving via-point movement primitives for coarse-to-fine optimization, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Coordinated arm-hand motion planning is fundamental to dexterous robotic manipulation in complex and constrained environments. A straightforward solution is to decompose the problem into separate arm path planning and hand motion generation; however, this poses a dilemma: decomposition can miss feasible solutions that require coordinated arm-hand adaptation along the path. Alternatively, directly planning in the high-dimensional joint arm-hand configuration space captures such coupling but faces a substantially enlarged search space and nonconvex collision constraints. To characterize this coupling, we formulate feasible hand fibers that capture collision-free hand configurations for each arm configuration. Based on this formulation, we propose CAMP, a high-success and efficient cooperative arm-hand motion planner for constrained environments. CAMP constructs candidate trajectories through layered hand search with local arm relaxation, then compactly represents them using endpoint-preserving via-point movement primitives (VMPs) for coarse-to-fine joint optimization. Across six constrained simulation tasks, CAMP achieves 84.2-98.5% planning success, outperforming alternative planners with competitive efficiency. Ablation studies verify the contributions of arm relaxation, VMP representation, and coarse-to-fine optimization, while real-robot experiments demonstrate CAMP on constrained manipulation tasks. The project website is available at https://camp-armhand.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：协调的臂-手运动规划是在复杂和受限环境中进行灵巧机器人操作的基础。一种直接的解决方案是将问题分解为独立的臂路径规划和手部运动生成；然而，这带来了一个两难问题：分解可能遗漏需要沿路径进行协调的臂-手适应的可行解。另一种方案是直接在高维的臂-手联合配置空间中进行规划，这能够捕捉这种耦合关系，但面临显著扩大的搜索空间和非凸碰撞约束。为了刻画这种耦合关系，我们为每个臂配置构建了可行手部纤维，以捕捉无碰撞的手部配置。基于这一表述，我们提出了CAMP，一种面向受限环境的高成功率和高效的协同臂-手运动规划器。CAMP通过分层手部搜索与局部臂松弛相结合来构建候选轨迹，然后使用保持端点的经由点运动原语（VMPs）对其进行紧凑表示，以实现从粗到细的联合优化。在六个受限仿真任务中，CAMP实现了84.2%–98.5%的规划成功率，在效率上优于其他对比规划器。消融实验验证了臂松弛、VMP表示以及从粗到细优化的贡献，而真实机器人实验则展示了CAMP在受限操作任务中的表现。项目网站见 https://camp-armhand.github.io/。

Authors: Ziyuan Wang, Yunlong Shan, Fei Mo, Sichao Liu, David Navarro-Alarcon, Jia Pan, Kosta Jovanovic, Xin Jiang, Peng Zhou

CrossSafe: Towards Cross-Embodiment Latent Safety Filters VLA

embodiment-conditioned safety filter Hamilton-Jacobi reachability latent space cross-embodiment generalization VLA safety

简要说明：本文提出一种基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析的隐空间跨本体安全过滤方法，通过形态条件化的安全值函数和策略，使单一安全过滤器能够零样本泛化到新机器人本体并降低碰撞率。

TLDR: This paper proposes embodiment-conditioned safety filtering using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis in a latent space shared across robots, enabling a single safety filter to generalize zero-shot to new embodiments and reduce collision rates for VLA manipulation policies.

Abstract: Cross-embodiment learning has shown that a single model, such as a vision-language-action (VLA) model, can learn state representations and manipulation skills that can be applied across heterogeneous robots to accomplish various tasks. We hypothesize that the same holds for safety enforcement. The reasoning required to satisfy a safety constraint, such as detecting an obstacle, recognizing that it should be avoided, and selecting a safe abstract action, is largely shared across robots. What differs across embodiments is how the abstract safe action is realized: morphology, kinematics, and dynamics determine which actions are safe and feasible. Consequently, the same action can be safe for one robot and unsafe for another. This is especially important for generalist manipulation policies that operate in a common end-effector action space without explicitly capturing how safety depends on the robot's morphology and kinematics. We propose embodiment-conditioned safety filtering, in which a Hamilton-Jacobi reachability-based value function and its corresponding safety-maximizing policy are shared across robots. Using a morphology-aware latent representation of the robot and its environment, we perform Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis directly in latent space so that the learned safety concepts can generalize across embodiments while remaining explicitly conditioned on each robot's morphology and kinematics. We evaluate our approach across five bimanual robot embodiments and five manipulation tasks with whole-body collision-avoidance constraints. Our results show that a single policy, jointly trained across five manipulation tasks and four embodiments, exhibits zero-shot generalization to a held-out embodiment, reducing the nominal policy's collision rate. They also show that training using more embodiments improves generalization.

摘要（中文）：跨体现学习已表明，单一模型（如视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型）能够学习可跨异构机器人应用的状態表征与操作技能，从而完成多种任务。我们假设这一结论同样适用于安全约束的执行。满足安全约束所需的推理过程——如检测障碍物、识别其应被避开，以及选择安全的抽象动作——在各类机器人之间高度共享。不同体现之间的差异在于抽象安全动作如何具体实现：形态、运动学与动力学决定了哪些动作是安全且可行的。因此，同一动作对某台机器人可能是安全的，而对另一台则可能不安全。这一点对于在共同末端执行器动作空间中运行、且未显式捕捉安全性如何依赖于机器人形态与运动学的通用操作策略尤为重要。我们提出了基于体现条件的安全过滤方法，其中基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的值函数及其对应的安全最大化策略在机器人之间共享。利用机器人及其环境的形态感知潜在表征，我们直接在潜在空间中进行Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析，从而使学习到的安全概念能够跨体现泛化，同时保持对每台机器人形态与运动学的显式条件依赖。我们在五种双臂机器人体现和五项具有全身避碰约束的操作任务上评估了该方法。结果表明，一个在五项操作任务和四种体现上联合训练的单一策略，能够对留出体现实现零样本泛化，从而降低名义策略的碰撞率。结果还表明，使用更多体现进行训练可提升泛化性能。

Authors: Ihab Tabbara, Yuxuan Yang, Hussein Sibai

Echo in the Steps: Learning Perceptive Humanoid Parkour with Gated Memory Locomotion

humanoid parkour gated memory perceptive locomotion foothold selection alternation loss

简要说明：本文提出了一种感知人形跑酷框架，利用显著性引导的时序感知模块和门控记忆，以及交替损失，使机器人仅依靠机载深度观测即可在稀疏落脚点上稳定穿越，并在仿真和真实世界中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a perceptive humanoid parkour framework using a saliency-guided temporal perception module with gated memory and an alternation loss to enable stable traversal across sparse footholds using onboard depth observations, validated in simulation and real-world.

Abstract: While recent advances in perceptive locomotion have enabled humanoid robots to traverse structured terrains, agile parkour in highly discontinuous environments remains an open challenge. In particular, crossing sparse footholds and narrow support regions requires precise foothold selection, effective use of visual observations, and consistent alternating foot placement during fast transitions. In this paper, we present a perceptive humanoid parkour framework that enables stable traversal across terrains with limited foothold availability using only onboard depth observations. The framework features a saliency-guided temporal perception module that combines a saliency prior with gated memory. It retains informative depth features across frames, enabling reliable foot placement from partial observations. By introducing an alternation loss, our symmetry regularization encourages alternating gait patterns and improves traversal robustness. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly improves success rate and foothold accuracy on challenging terrains in both simulation and the real world.

摘要（中文）：尽管近期感知运动领域的进展已使人形机器人能够穿越结构化地形，但在高度不连续环境中进行敏捷跑酷仍是一个开放性的挑战。特别是，跨越稀疏的落脚点和狭窄的支撑区域需要精确的落脚点选择、视觉观测的有效利用，以及在快速过渡过程中保持一致的交替落脚。本文提出了一种感知型人形机器人跑酷框架，仅利用机载深度观测即可实现在落脚点可用性受限的地形上的稳定穿越。该框架包含一个显著性引导的时间感知模块，该模块将显著性先验与门控记忆相结合，跨帧保留信息丰富的深度特征，从而能够根据部分观测实现可靠的落脚点选择。通过引入交替损失，我们的对称正则化促进了交替步态模式，并增强了穿越的鲁棒性。大量实验表明，我们的方法在仿真和现实世界的挑战性地形上显著提高了成功率和落脚点精度。

Authors: Ming-Ju Lee, Zizhuo Wang, Shaoting Zhu, Haozhe Lou, Hang Zhao, Yiming Li

TactileStep: Sole Tactile Learning for Regulating Foot-Terrain Interaction in Humanoid Locomotion HumanoidEmbodied

sole tactile sensing humanoid locomotion phase-aware rewards foot-terrain interaction Unitree G1

简要说明：TactileStep 将足底触觉感知集成到人形机器人运动控制中，利用触觉和运动线索识别足部接触阶段并应用阶段感知奖励，在 Unitree G1 上多种地形中降低了冲击力和噪声，同时增强了支撑稳定性。

TLDR: TactileStep integrates sole tactile sensing into humanoid locomotion control, using tactile and motion cues to recognize foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards, reducing impact forces and noise while increasing stance stability on the Unitree G1 across diverse terrains.

Abstract: Humanoid parkour policies can traverse various terrains, but task completion may mask challenges of harsh landings, edge contacts, and unstable stance contacts. Humans naturally regulate foot-terrain interaction through tactile feedback, modulating contact compliance according to terrain stiffness. This highlights a key domain gap between humans and humanoid robots: the absence of rich tactile sensing in most humanoid systems. We address this problem with TactileStep, a deployable tactile learning framework that brings sole pressure sensing into humanoid locomotion control for softer touchdowns and more stable support. TactileStep aligns tactile simulation with the real pressure insole, allowing the policy to learn from the same contact features available on hardware. During training, we use tactile and motion cues to recognize different foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards that encourage safer landing and more stable stance. Evaluated in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid across diverse terrains, TactileStep reduces peak touchdown force by up to 48.8% and peak A-weighted impact noise by up to 30.1 dB over a strong perceptive baseline, while increasing stance contact area by up to 23.8%.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人的跑酷策略能够穿越多种地形，然而任务完成可能掩盖了严酷落地、边缘接触以及不稳定站立接触所带来的挑战。人类自然通过触觉反馈来调节脚与地面之间的交互，根据地形刚度调整接触顺应性。这凸显了人类与人形机器人之间的一个关键领域差距：大多数仿人系统中缺乏丰富的触觉感知能力。针对这一问题，我们提出了TactileStep，一种可部署的触觉学习框架，将足底压力传感引入人形机器人运动控制中，实现更柔和的触地以及更稳定的支撑。TactileStep将触觉模拟与真实压力鞋垫对齐，使策略能够从硬件上可用的相同接触特征中学习。在训练过程中，我们利用触觉与运动线索来识别不同的足部接触阶段，并应用与阶段相关的奖励，以鼓励更安全的落地和更稳定的站立。在仿真环境及Unitree G1人形机器人上，跨越多种地形的评估结果表明，与强感知基线相比，TactileStep将峰值触地力降低了高达48.8%，峰值A加权冲击噪声降低了高达30.1分贝，同时将站立接触面积增加了高达23.8%。

Authors: Zizhuo Wang, Ming-ju Lee, Shaoting Zhu, Haozhe Lou, Hang Zhao, Yiming Li

ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action Counterfactual Visual Interventions Action-Grounded Gaze High-Precision Manipulation Visual Attention

简要说明：ActGaze提出了一种通过反事实视觉干预生成动作接地注视监督的方法，引导VLA策略关注任务相关区域，从而提升高精度机器人操作性能，无需外部标签。

TLDR: ActGaze introduces a counterfactual visual intervention method to generate action-grounded gaze supervision for VLA policies, improving high-precision robotic manipulation by focusing attention on task-relevant regions without external labels.

Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often struggle with high-precision robotic manipulation. We attribute this limitation primarily to their visual attention being dispersed across task-irrelevant regions. To address this issue, we propose ActGaze, a training approach that guides VLA policies to gaze on task-relevant regions, much like humans gaze on critical visual cues while executing precise movements. Unlike prior methods that rely on external labels for gaze supervision, ActGaze derives spatial supervision directly from the VLA's own action objective by using counterfactual visual interventions to identify regions that are critical for action prediction. Extensive real-robot experiments on four high-precision robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ActGaze induces more focused visual attention on task-relevant regions and consistently outperforms the base VLA policy and other visual-grounding approaches.

摘要（中文）：当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在高精度机器人操作任务中常常表现不佳。我们将这一局限主要归因于其视觉注意力分散在与任务无关的区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出ActGaze，一种训练方法，引导VLA策略将注意力聚焦于任务相关区域，类似于人类在执行精细动作时注视关键视觉线索的方式。与先前依赖外部标签进行注视监督的方法不同，ActGaze通过反事实视觉干预，直接从VLA自身的动作目标中提取空间监督信号，以识别对动作预测至关重要的区域。在四项高精度机器人操作任务上进行的大量真实机器人实验表明，ActGaze能够使视觉注意力更加集中于任务相关区域，并且始终优于基础VLA策略及其他视觉接地方法。

Authors: Jinxuan Zhu, Jiaheng Wang, Chao Tang, Mengfan Wang, Hao Wei, Shengbao Li, Hong Yin, Yiwen Gao, Chenrui Tie, Tingguang Li

RoboRecover: Benchmarking Robot Policy Recovery under Execution Deviations Manipulation

robot policy recovery execution deviations benchmark closed-loop execution off-nominal states

简要说明：RoboRecover 是一个用于评估机器人策略在执行偏差下恢复能力的基准，包含 RoboTwin 和 LIBERO 上的 2000 个场景，表明恢复性能与初始状态性能不同。

TLDR: RoboRecover is a benchmark for evaluating robot policy recovery from execution-induced intermediate states, containing 2,000 scenarios across RoboTwin and LIBERO, and showing recovery performance is distinct from initial-state performance.

Abstract: Robot-policy benchmarks increasingly cover diverse tasks and preset out-of-distribution conditions, but typically evaluate complete trajectories from predefined initial states. These evaluations often focus on the initialized scene and the final outcome, while paying less attention to the dynamic interaction process. During closed-loop execution, actions and contacts can alter object relations and task progress, producing off-nominal intermediate states that need recovery. Recovery requires a policy to infer how task progress has changed, correct the relevant relations, and continue the original goal. We introduce RoboRecover, a benchmark for robot policy recovery under execution deviations. RoboRecover selects deviation states from trajectories, reconstructs them by replaying action prefixes, and evaluates policies on the original task. RoboRecover contains 2,000 scenarios across RoboTwin and LIBERO, with 1,000 scenarios and a fixed 800/200 train/test split on each platform. Results show that initial-state performance does not determine recovery performance and policies exhibit different recovery strengths across scenarios. Using its training split, RoboRecover further supports study on recovery interventions. RoboRecover establishes recovery from execution-induced intermediate states as a distinct dimension of robot policy evaluation.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略基准测试日益涵盖多样化任务和预设的分布外条件，但通常仅从预定义的初始状态评估完整轨迹。这些评估往往聚焦于初始化场景和最终结果，而对动态交互过程的关注相对不足。在闭环执行过程中，动作和接触可能改变物体关系及任务进度，产生需要恢复的非标称中间状态。恢复要求策略能够推断任务进度发生了何种变化，修正相关关系，并继续执行原始目标。我们提出RoboRecover，一个面向执行偏差下机器人策略恢复的基准测试。RoboRecover从轨迹中选取偏差状态，通过重放动作前缀对其进行重建，并在原始任务上评估策略。RoboRecover包含来自RoboTwin和LIBERO的2,000个场景，每个平台各有1,000个场景，并采用固定的800/200训练/测试划分。结果表明，初始状态下的性能并不能决定恢复性能，且不同策略在不同场景中表现出各异的恢复能力。利用其训练划分，RoboRecover进一步支持恢复干预措施的研究。RoboRecover将执行引发的中间状态下的恢复确立为机器人策略评估的一个独立维度。

Authors: Yang Li, Chen Zhao, Zhuoran Wang, Jiankang Wang, Chao Shao, Yihan Lin, Haitao Shen, Jing Zhang

Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy VLA

VLA online RL fine-tuning task collapse uncertainty-gated exploration noise LIBERO

简要说明：本文研究了在线强化学习微调流匹配VLA策略时出现的任务崩溃现象，并提出一种不确定性门控的探索噪声控制器，在LIBERO-10上相比固定或学习噪声方案更有效地抑制任务崩溃，同时指出了bfloat16训练中潜在的数值精度问题。

TLDR: This paper investigates task collapse during online RL fine-tuning of a flow-matching VLA policy on LIBERO-10, and proposes an uncertainty-gated exploration noise controller that suppresses task collapse better than fixed or learned noise schemes, while also highlighting potential numerical precision issues in bfloat16 training.

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning fine-tuning of pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies promises robots that keep learning after deployment, but continued updates often destroy competence on individual tasks while the aggregate still looks healthy. We study this failure mode, which we call task collapse, under a matched small-compute budget on LIBERO-10 with a 450M-parameter SmolVLA policy trained by PPO with stochastic (SDE) sampling. Three exploration-noise policies differ in one live variable: a fixed noise scale, a ReinFlow-style learned noise network, and an uncertainty-gated controller that redistributes exploration across task streams from task-agnostic novelty and competence signals, without task labels or episode boundaries. Under the pooled definition, fixed noise collapses tasks in two of three seeds and learned noise in every seed measured to iteration 200, while the controller collapses none in any of its three seeds. Measured parameter displacement shows the controller's action expert keeps changing, while its mean applied noise is close to the fixed scale in the available logs. The matched comparison supports the controller's effect on task preservation; the separate contributions of its adaptation across states and over time are not disentangled. A lower fixed scale slows the decline but does not stop it. No arm improves on the behavior-cloning baseline in this budget. Two properties of that regime are measured beside this result, not offered as its cause: following the reference recipe, training runs in bfloat16 with no fp32 master copy, under which 96.02% of the action expert's elements stay bit-identical across three consecutive iterations, and an fp32 master copy at the reference learning rate collapses both arms in a single-seed observation. We release tools measuring per-task collapse under four definitions, rescoring noise and instrument tares.

摘要（中文）：在线强化学习微调预训练的流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略有望让机器人在部署后持续学习，但持续更新往往会在单个任务上破坏能力，而总体指标看起来仍然正常。我们研究了这种被称为“任务崩溃”的失效模式，在LIBERO-10上以匹配的小计算预算进行实验，使用450M参数的SmolVLA策略，通过带有随机（SDE）采样的PPO进行训练。三种探索噪声策略在一个活跃变量上有所不同：固定噪声尺度、ReinFlow风格的学习噪声网络，以及一种基于不确定性门控的控制器，它根据任务无关的新颖性和能力信号在各任务流之间重新分配探索，无需任务标签或回合边界。在汇总定义下，固定噪声在三个种子中的两个中导致任务崩溃，学习噪声在每个种子中均崩溃至迭代200，而控制器在其三个种子中均无崩溃。测得的参数位移显示控制器的动作专家持续变化，而其平均施加噪声在可用日志中接近固定尺度。匹配比较支持控制器对任务保留的效果；其跨状态和跨时间的适应性各自贡献未被分离。较低的固定尺度减缓了衰退但未阻止它。在该预算下，没有任何方案优于行为克隆基线。除了这一结果外，我们还测量了该制度的两个属性，并非将其作为原因提出：按照参考配方，训练以bfloat16运行且无fp32主副本，在此条件下动作专家元素的96.02%在连续三次迭代中保持位相同；而在参考学习率下使用fp32主副本在单种子观察中导致两个方案均崩溃。我们发布了在四种定义下测量每个任务崩溃的工具，以及噪声重评分和仪器校准工具。

Authors: Mehmet Turan Yardımcı, Yunus Emre Çoğurcu

KeyGen: Unsupervised Keypoint based Object-Centric Representations for Category-Level Policy Generalization Manipulation

3D keypoints object-centric representations diffusion policy category-level generalization robotic manipulation

简要说明：KeyGen 从点云中学习规范化语义 3D 关键点，作为结构化对象中心表示用于视觉运动扩散策略，从而提升跨未见对象实例的类别级操作泛化能力，并在仿真和真实世界中均取得良好效果。

TLDR: KeyGen learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds as structured object-centric representations for visuomotor diffusion policies, improving category-level manipulation generalization across unseen object instances in simulation and real world.

Abstract: Generalization in robotic manipulation requires policies to perform tasks across diverse unseen object instances that vary in shape, size, and pose. However, conventional behavior cloning (BC) methods often overfit to instance-specific geometry and appearance, limiting transfer to novel objects. We introduce KeyGen, a framework that learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds and uses them as structured object-centric representations for policy learning. A visuomotor diffusion policy conditions on these keypoints together with object-centric geometry to predict full manipulation trajectories, enabling consistent geometric correspondence across object instances. To evaluate category-level generalization, we construct a photorealistic simulation benchmark with three manipulation tasks and a planning-driven data generation pipeline that produces expert trajectories across diverse object instances. Experiments show that KeyGen significantly outperforms prior methods on both seen and unseen objects under pose variation, scales effectively with additional demonstrations per object, maintains robustness to object rescaling, and achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world manipulation.

摘要（中文）：泛化能力对于机器人操作至关重要，要求策略能够应对形状、尺寸和位姿各异的大量未见物体实例。然而，传统的行为克隆（BC）方法往往过拟合于物体实例特有的几何外观特征，限制了对新物体的迁移能力。为此，我们提出KeyGen框架，该框架从点云中学习规范化的语义3D关键点，并将其作为面向物体的结构化表征用于策略学习。一种视觉运动扩散策略以这些关键点及物体中心几何信息为条件，预测完整的操作轨迹，从而在物体实例间建立一致的几何对应关系。为评估类别级泛化性能，我们构建了一个包含三项操作任务的逼真仿真基准，并设计了一条规划驱动的数据生成流水线，用于生成覆盖多种物体实例的专家轨迹。实验表明，KeyGen在位姿变化条件下的已见与未见物体上均显著优于现有方法，且随着每个物体演示数量的增加表现出良好的扩展性，对物体尺度变化具有鲁棒性，并在仿真及真实世界操作中均取得了优异性能。

Authors: Shuxin Cao, Liquan Wang, Masoud Moghani, Benjamin Joffe, Animesh Garg

FlyCNS: Connectome-Grounded Information Organization for Communication-Constrained Embodied Control Locomotion

embodied control communication constraint connectome reinforcement learning quadruped locomotion

简要说明：FlyCNS 从果蝇连接组中汲取灵感，为通信受限的具身控制设计信息组织框架，利用通路方向性结构复杂度作为选择性通信的先验，并在 Unitree Go1 仿真中展现了优雅的性能退化，以显著降低的通信量维持高跟踪得分。

TLDR: FlyCNS draws inspiration from the Drosophila connectome to design a communication-constrained framework for embodied control, using directional pathway complexity as a prior for selective information routing. It demonstrates graceful performance degradation in Unitree Go1 simulation, maintaining high tracking scores with significantly reduced inter-limb communication.

Abstract: Robotic bodies are inherently distributed in sensing and actuation, yet learning-based control still commonly relies on centralized information processing. This work studies the problem of information organization in communication-constrained embodied control: which computations should remain local, and which information is worth transmitting for whole-body coordination. We propose FlyCNS, an embodied information-organization framework inspired by the Drosophila brain--nerve-cord connectome. FlyCNS preserves local sensorimotor computation within each limb and enables selective long-range communication through separate ascending and descending routing pathways. From a real connectome, FlyCNS extracts the directional structural complexity of these two pathway types and uses it as a weak prior over communication allocation, while message content, transmission timing, and locomotion policies remain task-adaptive and are learned through reinforcement learning. In Unitree Go1 simulation, FlyCNS exhibits more graceful performance degradation as the communication budget is tightened. Under the most restrictive setting, it uses only about 21--22\% of the communication of the full-communication reference, while still maintaining a tracking score of approximately 0.882 under both command protocols, with a gap of no more than 6.1\% from the full-communication reference. These results indicate that real neural connectomes can inform not only the structural design of control networks, but also provide transferable inductive biases for information organization across embodiments, guiding robots in balancing local computation and long-range coordination under limited communication resources.

摘要（中文）：机器人本体的感知与执行在物理上天然是分布式的，然而基于学习的控制方法仍普遍依赖集中式信息处理。本研究关注通信受限的具身控制中的信息组织问题：哪些计算应保留在局部，哪些信息值得为全身协调而传输。我们提出FlyCNS，一种受果蝇脑—神经索连接组启发的具身信息组织框架。FlyCNS在每个肢体内部保留局部感觉运动计算，并通过独立的上升与下降路由通路实现选择性长距离通信。FlyCNS从真实连接组中提取这两类通路的定向结构复杂度，并将其作为通信分配的弱先验，而消息内容、传输时机及运动策略则保持任务自适应，通过强化学习获得。在Unitree Go1仿真中，随着通信预算收紧，FlyCNS表现出更优雅的性能退化。在最严格的设置下，其通信量仅为全通信基准的约21\%—22\%，同时在两种指令协议下仍保持约0.882的跟踪得分，与全通信基准的差距不超过6.1\%。这些结果表明，真实神经连接组不仅可以为控制网络的结构设计提供启示，还能为跨本体的信息组织提供可迁移的归纳偏置，引导机器人在有限通信资源下平衡局部计算与长距离协调。

Authors: Jinchang Zhang, Jiakai Lin, Guoyu Lu

OCC4M: Object-Centric 4D Memory for Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long-Horizon Manipulation Manipulation

object-centric 4D memory long-horizon manipulation vision-language model spatiotemporal reasoning persistent object tracking

简要说明：OCC4M提出了一种以对象为中心的4D记忆，在世界坐标系中维护持久对象轨迹，并由VLM查询以支持长时程操作，在仿真和真实机器人实验中显著优于原始历史基线。

TLDR: OCC4M introduces an object-centric 4D memory that maintains persistent object tracks in a world frame, queried by a VLM for long-horizon manipulation, significantly outperforming raw-history baselines in simulation and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation often requires reasoning about state absent from the current view, such as a vanished object's location, temporal identity, or the contents of a shuffled container. We present OCC4M ("Occam"), an object-centric 4D memory that maintains persistent tracks in a shared world frame and explicitly represents temporal, motion, and containment relations. A vision-language model (VLM) queries this structured memory to select actionable targets for history-free low-level execution. Across seven simulation conditions and 350 episodes, OCC4M achieves 96.6% memory success and 88.9% end-to-end success, versus 54.6% and 57.7% for FrameSamp, a raw-history VLM baseline using Gemini 3.7 Flash with the complete observation history and the same executor. In a controlled viewpoint-transfer test, OCC4M maintains 100% memory and 98% end-to-end success after a viewpoint change, while full-history FrameSamp falls to near-zero success. On 20 fixed-camera Franka episodes, OCC4M reaches 85% joint memory accuracy, versus at most 30% for FrameSamp across context sizes from $K=16$ to the complete history, and completes 45% of full two-stage tasks. These results support explicit object-centric memory for persistent spatiotemporal reasoning in long-horizon manipulation. Qualitative videos are available at https://occ4m-sup.github.io/occ4m-supplementary/.

摘要（中文）：长时程操作任务通常需要对当前视野中缺失的状态进行推理，例如消失物体的位置、时间身份，或被打乱容器中的内容。我们提出OCC4M（“Occam”），一种以对象为中心的4D记忆系统，它在共享世界坐标系中维持持久轨迹，并显式建模时间、运动和包含关系。视觉语言模型（VLM）查询这一结构化记忆，以选择可直接执行的无历史低级动作目标。在七种仿真条件和350个回合中，OCC4M实现了96.6%的记忆成功率和88.9%的端到端成功率，而使用Gemini 3.7 Flash并接收完整观测历史及相同执行器的原始历史VLM基线FrameSamp分别仅为54.6%和57.7%。在受控的视角迁移测试中，OCC4M在视角变化后仍保持100%的记忆成功率和98%的端到端成功率，而使用完整历史的FrameSamp则降至接近零。在20个固定相机Franka回合中，OCC4M达到了85%的联合记忆准确率，而FrameSamp在从上下文大小K=16到完整历史的各种条件下最高仅为30%，并完成了45%的完整两阶段任务。这些结果支持以对象为中心的显式记忆在长时程操作中进行持久时空推理的有效性。定性视频见 https://occ4m-sup.github.io/occ4m-supplementary/。

Authors: Jack B. Jedlicki, Tanguy Dieudonné, Heng Yang

Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy Manipulation

hand-object interaction dexterous manipulation sim-to-real residual reinforcement learning visuomotor policy

简要说明：本文提出形态模仿，一个三阶段框架，通过形态度量和残差强化学习将人类手物交互重定向到不同机器人手，并将示范蒸馏为视觉运动策略，在真实机器人上实现了高零样本成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Morphometric Imitation, a three-stage framework that retargets human hand-object interactions to different robot hands via morphometric optimization and residual RL, then distills the resulting demonstrations into visuomotor policies that achieve high zero-shot sim-to-real success on real robots.

Abstract: Human hand-object interactions (HOIs) provide a rich source of demonstrations for dexterous manipulation, but learning directly from them presents challenges in bridging morphology gaps, ensuring dynamical feasibility, and sim-to-real deployment. We present Morphometric Imitation, a three-stage framework that transforms reconstructed HOIs into zero-shot sim-to-real visuomotor policies. First, morphometric optimization (MMO) kinematically retargets human motion across hand morphologies while preserving demonstrated contacts. Second, residual reinforcement learning (RL) refines the kinematic reference using object pose and contact information from the human motion to produce dynamically feasible robot demonstrations. Third, these demonstrations are distilled into visuomotor policies. Across three robot hands and ten HOIs, MMO improves contact F1 over the strongest of five baselines by at least 8 points for every hand, while also improving the success rate of downstream dynamic retargeting by as much as 35 points. Ablations on the residual RL show complementary benefits from using object pose and contact information. Finally, the visuomotor policies achieve 89.3% zero-shot success in 300 real-world trials on 30 objects. Project page: $\href{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}{\text{this https URL}}$

摘要（中文）：人类手物交互（HOIs）为灵巧操作提供了丰富的演示来源，但直接从中学习面临着跨越形态差异、确保动力学可行性以及模拟到现实部署等挑战。我们提出了形态测量模仿（Morphometric Imitation），这是一个三阶段框架，可将重建的手物交互转化为零样本的模拟到现实视觉运动策略。首先，形态测量优化（MMO）在运动学层面跨手部形态重定向人体动作，同时保留已展示的接触信息。其次，残差强化学习（RL）利用人体动作中的物体位姿和接触信息对运动学参考进行细化，以生成动力学上可行的机器人演示。最后，这些演示被提炼为视觉运动策略。在三种机器人手和十种手物交互中，MMO相较五种基线中最强者，每只手的接触F1分数至少提高8个百分点，同时下游动态重定向的成功率最多提升35个百分点。对残差RL的消融实验表明，利用物体位姿和接触信息具有互补性收益。最终，视觉运动策略在30个物体的300次真实世界试验中实现了89.3%的零样本成功率。项目页面：\href{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}{\text{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}}

Authors: Tara Sadjadpour, Siming He, C. K. Wolfe, Haozhi Qi, Lea Wilken, S. Shankar Sastry, Claire Tomlin, Jitendra Malik

S2Planner: Multi-Scale Semantic Planner for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

multi-scale semantic planner end-to-end autonomous driving DINOv3 backbone trajectory self-attention cross-attention

简要说明：S2Planner 提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的多尺度语义轨迹规划器，采用微调的 DINOv3 骨干网络和空间调优适配器，以及带有轨迹自注意力和相机投影交叉注意力的由粗到精解码器。其贡献在于将自我条件轨迹初始化与多尺度图像特征的迭代、几何引导采样相结合，并在 NAVSIM v1 上进行了评估；然而，报告的 PDMS 分数是探索性的，需要进一步验证。

TLDR: S2Planner presents a multi-scale semantic trajectory planner for end-to-end autonomous driving, using a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone with a Spatial Tuning Adapter and a coarse-to-fine decoder with trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention. It integrates ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, evaluated on NAVSIM v1; however, the reported PDMS score is exploratory and requires further validation.

Abstract: We present S2Planner, a trajectory planner that combines three front-facing cameras with ego-motion history and the current driving command. A fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone and a Spatial Tuning Adapter produce multi-scale image features; a coarse-to-fine decoder then uses trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention to refine candidate waypoints. The contribution is the integration of ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, rather than a new visual backbone or attention operator. On the NAVSIM v1 non-reactive evaluation, the previously reported navtest run obtained 88.03 PDMS. Because that run was selected using navtest performance, this number is exploratory and cannot be interpreted as an unbiased test estimate. Validation-selected evaluation on unexposed data, repeated runs, and computational measurements are needed to establish generalization and efficiency.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了S2Planner，一种结合三个前视摄像头、自车运动历史及当前驾驶指令的轨迹规划器。通过微调的DINOv3骨干网络与空间调谐适配器生成多尺度图像特征；随后，由粗到细的解码器利用轨迹自注意力与相机投影交叉注意力来优化候选路径点。本工作的贡献在于将自车条件化的轨迹初始化与基于几何引导的多尺度图像特征迭代采样相结合，而非提出新的视觉骨干网络或注意力算子。在NAVSIM v1非反应式评估中，先前报告的navtest测试运行获得了88.03 PDMS得分。由于该运行结果基于navtest性能进行选择，因此该数值属于探索性结果，不能解释为无偏的测试估计。需要在未接触过的数据上进行基于验证集选择的评估、重复运行及计算量测量，以确定其泛化能力与效率。

Authors: Zhaowei Lu, Liguo Zhou, Yujie Guo, Lei Yu, Alois Knoll

Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation Manipulation

mixed-quality experience chunk-level critic diffusion actor post-deployment learning robot manipulation

简要说明：PACL 通过训练一个带有未来潜在预测的块级评论家，并利用其 Q 值来条件扩散 actor，从而从混合质量的机器人部署数据中学习，提升预训练操作策略。

TLDR: PACL is a method for learning from mixed-quality robot deployment data by training a chunk-level critic with future latent prediction and using its Q-values to condition a diffusion actor, improving pretrained manipulation policies.

Abstract: Robot policies deployed in real environments naturally accumulate mixed-quality experience, including successful executions, partial progress, and failures. Although these rollouts provide valuable information for further learning, directly incorporating them into imitation learning may reinforce undesirable behaviors, while offline reinforcement learning often suffers from unreliable value estimation under sparse rewards and limited data coverage. We consider a practical post-deployment setting where learning relies only on naturally accumulated autonomous rollouts, without additional human corrections or exploratory interaction. To effectively exploit such experience, we propose Predictive Action Chunk Learning (PACL). PACL first learns a predictive chunk-level critic that evaluates temporally extended action sequences and augments temporal difference learning with future latent prediction, providing richer supervision for long-horizon value estimation. The learned critic then converts chunk-level Q-values into discrete quality conditions, which guide a diffusion actor to learn jointly from these mixed-quality experiences without treating all behaviors as equivalent supervision. At inference, the actor generates multiple action chunks and the critic selects the highest valued candidate. Experiments across simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks show that PACL consistently improves the pretrained policy and outperforms strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在真实环境中部署的机器人策略自然会产生混合质量的体验，包括成功执行、部分进展和失败。尽管这些轨迹数据为进一步学习提供了有价值的信息，但直接将它们纳入模仿学习可能会强化不良行为，而离线强化学习在稀疏奖励和有限数据覆盖下往往面临价值估计不可靠的问题。我们考虑一种实用的部署后场景，其中学习仅依赖于自然积累的自主轨迹数据，无需额外的人工纠正或探索性交互。为了有效利用此类经验，我们提出了预测性动作块学习（PACL）。PACL首先学习一个预测性的块级评论家，用于评估时间上扩展的动作序列，并通过未来潜在状态预测增强时序差分学习，为长视野价值估计提供更丰富的监督信号。随后，学习到的评论家将块级Q值转化为离散的质量条件，引导扩散式动作生成器从这些混合质量的经验中联合学习，而不将所有行为视为等同的监督信号。在推理阶段，动作生成器生成多个动作块，评论家选择价值最高的候选。在模拟和真实机器人操作任务上的实验表明，PACL能够持续改进预训练策略，并超越强模仿学习和离线强化学习基线方法。

Authors: Yangang Ren, Yujie Yan, Zirui Li, Jiaming Guo, Di Zeng, Ji Tao, Lan Yu, Xuesong Tian, Chen Lv

ReVAMP: Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning for Kinematically-Constrained Systems via Reparameterization RLRobot

vectorized motion planning analytic inverse kinematics reparameterization kinematic constraints high-dimensional systems

简要说明：ReVAMP 通过解析逆运动学对配置空间进行重新参数化，加速了运动学约束机器人的向量化运动规划，相比现有技术实现了高达10倍的加速，并为高维系统提供了微秒到毫秒级的规划能力。

TLDR: ReVAMP accelerates vectorized motion planning for kinematically constrained robots by reparameterizing the configuration space through analytic IK, achieving up to 10x speedup over state-of-the-art and enabling microsecond-to-millisecond planning for high-dimensional systems.

Abstract: Robots often must satisfy one or more constraints during motion planning for real-world tasks. When such constraints reduce the valid configuration space to a measure-zero subset, sampling based planning algorithms require modifications to draw feasible samples. For many common end-effector constraints, parameterizations built on inverse kinematics (IK) provide an alternate formulation where the constraints are satisfied by construction, allowing directly sampling the feasible set. Despite their elegant approach, parameterized planners have remained slower than vector-accelerated implementations of projection-based approaches, leaving their performance ceiling an open question. We explore a new axis of vectorization built upon reparameterizing the planning space through analytic IK. This approach addresses existing inefficiencies in vectorized projection-based planners and exposes new opportunities for parallelism within the planner. We show that the planner can synthesize plans in microseconds to milliseconds for high dimensional systems (up to 20 dimensions), with complex constraints, up to 10x faster than the current state-of-the-art. Furthermore, we demonstrate how such planning speeds open up avenues for restructuring sequential manipulation pipelines.

摘要（中文）：机器人通常需要在运动规划过程中满足一个或多个约束条件，以完成实际任务。当这些约束将有效构型空间缩减至零测度子集时，基于采样的规划算法需要进行改进，以生成可行样本。对于许多常见的末端执行器约束，基于逆运动学（IK）构建的参数化方法提供了一种替代表述，使约束在构造过程中即被满足，从而能够直接对可行集进行采样。尽管参数化规划器的方法简洁优雅，但其运行速度仍慢于基于投影方法且采用矢量加速的实现方案，其性能上限仍是一个未解问题。我们探索了一种新的向量化维度，其基础是通过解析逆运动学对规划空间进行重新参数化。该方法解决了现有向量化投影规划器在效率上的不足，并在规划器内部开辟了新的并行化机会。我们证明，该规划器能够在微秒至毫秒级别内为高维系统（最高达20维）在复杂约束条件下合成规划路径，速度比当前最先进方法快达10倍。此外，我们还展示了这种规划速度如何为重构顺序操作流水线提供新的途径。

Authors: Shrutheesh R. Iyer, Thomas Cohn, Zachary Kingston

Training-free Behavior Cloning Manipulation

Training-free Behavior Cloning Retrieval policy Hankel-based prior Residual correction

简要说明：本文提出行为预测控制（BPC），一种无需训练的机器人行为克隆方法，通过融合存储的示范轨迹与闭环残差校正来合成策略，省去了端到端策略训练。在仿真和真实机器人任务中，BPC的性能媲美甚至超越π0.5等学习策略，并支持边缘设备上的实时控制与可追溯的预测。

TLDR: This paper proposes Behavior Predictive Control (BPC), a training-free behavior cloning method that synthesizes robot policies by blending stored demonstrations with a closed-form residual correction, eliminating end-to-end policy training. BPC matches or exceeds learned policies like π0.5 on simulated and real robot tasks while enabling traceable predictions and real-time control on edge hardware.

Abstract: Neural behavior cloning compresses demonstrations into large models, making individual actions difficult to trace and policy updates costly. Retrieval policies retain access to demonstrations but struggle with mismatch between recorded and live behavior. We introduce Behavior Predictive Control (BPC), which synthesizes policies without end-to-end policy training by combining an action-aware retrieval metric, a Hankel-based action-continuation prior, and a closed-form one-step residual correction. Inspired by behavioral systems theory, BPC predicts future actions by blending stored observation-action data that best reconstructs the recent runtime observation--action history. Across simulated benchmarks and real-robot deployments, BPC is competitive with learned policies such as $π_{0.5}$ (surpassing it in some cases), while reducing policy fitting from hours to seconds on consumer GPUs and supporting closed-loop control upwards of 75 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano. The retrieved demonstration windows and their coefficients also provide an intrinsic estimate of task progress. Retaining demonstrations within the deployed policy makes its predictions traceable to supporting trajectories and enables behavior revision through the demonstration bank.

摘要（中文）：神经行为克隆将示范数据压缩进大型模型中，导致单个动作难以追溯，且策略更新成本高昂。检索式策略虽保留了对示范数据的访问权，但在记录行为与实时行为不一致时存在适配问题。我们提出行为预测控制（BPC），该方法无需端到端策略训练即可合成策略，通过结合动作感知检索度量、基于Hankel矩阵的动作延续先验，以及闭式一步残差校正实现。受行为系统理论启发，BPC通过融合最能重建近期运行时观测-动作历史片段的存储观测-动作数据来预测未来动作。在模拟基准测试和真实机器人部署中，BPC与诸如\( \pi_{0.5} \)等学习型策略表现相当（在某些情况下甚至超越），同时将策略拟合时间从数小时缩短至消费级GPU上的数秒，并能在Jetson Orin Nano上支持超过75 Hz的闭环控制。检索到的示范窗口及其系数还可提供任务进展的内在估计。部署策略中保留示范数据使其预测可追溯至支撑轨迹，并支持通过示范库实现行为修订。

Authors: Maximilian Adang, Timothy Chen, Lars Osterberg, Aiden Swann, Mac Schwager

Faster Visuomotor Policy Learning on Action Manifolds via Riemannian MeanFlow Manipulation

Riemannian MeanFlow Policy flow matching action manifold visuomotor policy fast action generation

简要说明：本文提出了黎曼均流策略（RMFP），一种基于流匹配的视觉运动策略，在机器人动作流形上学习一致的流映射，实现仅需一次网络评估即可生成流形上的动作，从而加快控制频率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), a flow-matching-based visuomotor policy that learns a consistent flow map on the robot's action manifold, enabling on-manifold action generation with as few as one network evaluation for fast control rates.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies learn a direct map from raw sensory observations to robot action sequences. Policies based on Diffusion and Flow Matching capture the multimodal distribution over action sequences in an end-to-end manner. This expressivity comes at the cost of multi-step numerical integration of the learned vector field for action generation, which can be expensive and time-consuming, impeding fast control rates required in robotics applications. Furthermore, robot action sequences are usually defined on a smooth, differentiable manifold, requiring that the learned policy respects the intrinsic geometry of the robot's action space. Here, we present Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), which learns the conditioned flow map of the probability path on the robot action manifold. Our formulation employs a flow map consistency objective grounded in the data by a Riemannian Conditional Flow Matching anchor. The flow map consistency condition is stable to train and constrains the learned model to finite-time transport, which yields on-manifold action sequence generation with as few as one network function evaluation. We present results on the spherical LASA and Push-T benchmarks, on the Tool Hang and Transport tasks of the Robomimic suite, and on the Franka Kitchen task with manifold-constrained action generation, and demonstrate that RMFP attains performance competitive with prior work at a lower sampling cost. We also employ RMFP on a real-world robotic manipulation task to demonstrate fast action generation under imperfect sensor measurements in the physical world.

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略学习从原始感官观测到机器人动作序列的直接映射。基于扩散和流匹配的策略以端到端方式捕捉动作序列上的多模态分布。这种表达能力以对学习到的向量场进行多步数值积分以生成动作序列为代价，这一过程可能昂贵且耗时，阻碍了机器人应用中所需的快速控制频率。此外，机器人动作序列通常定义在光滑可微的流形上，要求学习到的策略尊重机器人动作空间的内在几何结构。在此，我们提出黎曼均值流策略（RMFP），该策略学习机器人动作流形上概率路径的条件流映射。我们的公式采用由黎曼条件流匹配锚定在数据上的流映射一致性目标。流映射一致性条件训练稳定，并将学习到的模型约束为有限时间传输，从而仅需一次网络函数评估即可生成流形上的动作序列。我们在球形LASA和Push-T基准测试、Robomimic套件的Tool Hang和Transport任务以及具有流形约束动作生成的Franka Kitchen任务上展示了结果，并证明RMFP以更低的采样成本达到了与先前工作相当的性能。我们还将RMFP应用于真实世界的机器人操作任务，以展示在物理世界中传感器测量不完善的情况下快速动作生成的能力。

Authors: S. Talha Bukhari, Austin Garrett, Yi Wei, Ruiqi Ni, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera

Real-Time Force Regulation for Whole-Hand Dexterous Grasping Manipulation

force regulation whole-hand grasping reactive reaching grasp maintenance arm-hand system

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于全手灵巧抓取实时力调节框架，无需触觉传感即可在扰动下保持抓取稳定性，并在27自由度臂手系统上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a real-time force regulation framework for whole-hand dexterous grasping that maintains grasp stability under disturbances by repeatedly recomputing contact-force distributions without tactile sensing, demonstrated on a 27-DoF arm-hand system.

Abstract: Robust dexterous grasping requires maintaining physical stability despite contacts interactively evolving across the entire hand. A precomputed force distribution can easily fail under object motion, modeling errors, or external disturbances. In this paper, we present a framework for real-time force regulation over dynamically changing whole-hand contacts. Our method geometrically estimates contacts across all hand links using a tracked object model and proprioception, without requiring tactile sensing at those contacts. It repeatedly recomputes the desired contact-force distribution subject to friction constraints, actuator limits, and an actuation-consistency constraint motivated by classical whole-limb force analysis. We integrate this force-regulation controller with reactive reaching, enabling the hand to acquire a grasp, maintain it under disturbances, and regrasp after losing the object. Simulation experiments without gravity demonstrate improved grasp retention over fixed-allocation and fingertip-only execution under controlled perturbations, while real-world experiments on a 27-DoF arm-hand system demonstrate grasp maintenance and recovery under human-applied disturbances as contacts evolve across the whole hand. Project page: https://sangminkim-99.github.io/reactive-grasp-whole-hand/

摘要（中文）：鲁棒灵巧抓取要求在与整个手部接触点动态演变的过程中维持物理稳定性。预计算的力分布容易在物体运动、建模误差或外部扰动下失效。本文提出一种框架，用于在动态变化的整手接触中实现实时力调节。该方法利用跟踪物体模型与本体感觉，几何估计所有手部连杆上的接触，而无需依赖接触处的触觉传感。该方法在摩擦约束、执行器极限以及由经典整肢力分析启发的驱动一致性约束下，反复重新计算期望接触力分布。我们将该力调节控制器与反应式伸手运动相集成，使手部能够获取抓取、在扰动下维持抓取，并在失去物体后重新抓取。无重力仿真实验表明，在受控扰动下，该方法相较于固定分配和仅指尖执行具有更好的抓取保持能力；而在27自由度手臂-手系统上的真实实验中，则展示了在人体施加扰动、接触点遍布整手演变时，系统能够维持抓取并恢复。项目页面：https://sangminkim-99.github.io/reactive-grasp-whole-hand/

Authors: Sang Min Kim, Alexander Alexiev, Tzu-Yuan Lin, Sangbae Kim, Young Min Kim, Yonghyeon Lee

MorphIK: Morphology-Conditioned Neural Inverse Kinematics for Unknown Robots Manipulation

inverse kinematics flow matching robot morphology generalization null space sampling

简要说明：MorphIK 是一种流匹配模型，通过条件化机器人形态来为未见过的机器人求解逆运动学，在未知真实机器人上达到约 5 厘米的精度，并作为优化先验可达到亚毫米精度。

TLDR: MorphIK is a flow-matching model that learns to solve inverse kinematics for unseen robots by conditioning on the robot's morphology, achieving ~5 cm precision on unknown real-world robots and serving as a prior for optimization to reach sub-mm accuracy.

Abstract: Neural models can learn to generate various solutions to the inverse kinematics problem from data, but are usually limited to a single robot. We present MorphIK, a flow-matching model that solves inverse kinematics for revolute-joint-based kinematic chains it has never seen during training. The model uses a transformer architecture to encode the robot's morphology along with the target pose. This encoding then conditions a flow-matching head that generates poses from noise. Trained on purely synthetic data from procedurally generated robots, the model reaches a precision of about 5 cm on unseen real-world robots with 6 to 9 Degrees of Freedom. For higher precision, the model serves as an excellent Prior for further optimization algorithms, reducing error to less than 1 cm after a single step of Damped Least Squares optimization and to sub-1 mm error after 3 steps in most cases. Building on flow matching's generative capabilities to produce highly diverse outputs, our model can efficiently sample the robot's null space, providing a wide variety of configurations for the same pose. Thus, overall, MorphIK allows learning and generalizing neural inverse kinematics for a multitude of known and unknown robots.

摘要（中文）：神经模型可以从数据中学习生成逆运动学问题的多种解决方案，但通常仅限于单一机器人。我们提出了MorphIK，一种流匹配模型，能够为训练期间从未见过的基于旋转关节的运动链求解逆运动学问题。该模型采用Transformer架构来编码机器人的形态结构以及目标位姿。这种编码随后用于条件化一个流匹配头，从噪声中生成关节位姿。该模型仅在程序化生成的机器人的纯合成数据上训练，即可在未见过的真实机器人（具有6至9个自由度）上达到约5厘米的精度。为了获得更高的精度，该模型可作为进一步优化算法的优秀先验，经过一步阻尼最小二乘优化后误差降至不足1厘米，在大多数情况下经过三步优化后误差降至亚毫米级。基于流匹配生成能力产生高度多样化输出的特点，我们的模型能够高效地对机器人的零空间进行采样，为同一目标位姿提供多种多样的构型。因此，总体而言，MorphIK使得神经逆运动学能够学习并泛化适用于多种已知和未知机器人。

Authors: Lennart Clasmeier, Jan Gerrit Habekost, Cornelius Weber, Stefan Wermter

Retrieve-to-Localize: Bridging Large Language Models and LiDAR Geometry for Spatial Grounding AutonomousDriving

spatial grounding LiDAR-language model large language models autonomous driving 3D object localization

简要说明：该论文提出了 SpatialLiDAR-QA 和 SpatialLiDAR-LM，通过将激光雷达点特征与LLM对齐，并利用语言条件化的提案检索和局部细化来在激光雷达几何中定位空间查询的目标，提高了自动驾驶和户外机器人中精确坐标预测的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces SpatialLiDAR-QA and SpatialLiDAR-LM to ground spatial queries in LiDAR geometry by aligning point features with LLMs and using language-conditioned proposal retrieval and local refinement, improving precise coordinate prediction for autonomous driving and outdoor robotics.

Abstract: LiDAR provides precise geometric information for spatial perception tasks such as object detection in autonomous driving and outdoor robotics. However, recognizing and localizing individual objects is not sufficient to answer questions that require composing spatial relations and grounding the intended target. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for autonomous driving, we leverage their language priors to interpret complex spatial questions and ground the referred target in LiDAR geometry. To support this spatial grounding capability, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA, which combines single- and multi-step relational grounding with complementary spatial understanding tasks. We further propose SpatialLiDAR-LM, which aligns LiDAR point features with an LLM and grounds target coordinates through language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement. This design derives target coordinates directly from local LiDAR geometry rather than through textual language decoding. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR--language models and multi-camera VLMs on precise coordinate prediction tasks. Our dataset and model training code will be publicly released.

摘要（中文）：摘要：激光雷达为自动驾驶和户外机器人中的目标检测等空间感知任务提供了精确的几何信息。然而，识别并定位单个目标不足以回答那些需要组合空间关系并确定所指目标的问题。受近期大语言模型（LLM）在自动驾驶领域进展的启发，我们利用其语言先验来解读复杂的空间问题，并在激光雷达几何中确定所指目标。为支持这种空间定位能力，我们引入了SpatialLiDAR-QA，它将单步和多步关系定位与互补的空间理解任务相结合。我们进一步提出了SpatialLiDAR-LM，它将激光雷达点特征与大语言模型对齐，并通过基于语言条件、位置感知的提案检索和局部点细化来确定目标坐标。该设计直接从局部激光雷达几何中导出目标坐标，而非通过文本语言解码。实验表明，在精确坐标预测任务中，我们相较于代表性的激光雷达-语言模型和多摄像头视觉语言模型取得了显著改进。我们的数据集和模型训练代码将公开发布。

Authors: Byounggun Park, Giyong Moon, Jusung Kim, Soonmin Hwang

From Target Selection to Digging: A Learning-Based Framework for Continuous Autonomous Excavation Manipulation

autonomous excavation reinforcement learning imitation learning LiDAR elevation maps continuous operation

简要说明：一个基于学习的连续自主挖掘框架，结合任务条件强化学习控制运动与模仿学习进行视觉挖掘，并在缩比液压挖掘机上部署，通过LiDAR选点提升了有效载荷并实现了连续作业。

TLDR: A learning-based framework for continuous autonomous excavation integrates task-conditioned RL for motion and IL for vision-based digging, deployed on a scaled hydraulic excavator with LiDAR-based target selection, demonstrating improved payload and consecutive operation.

Abstract: Repeated excavation continuously reshapes pile geometry, requiring an autonomous excavator to adapt its digging targets and coordinate motion across successive excavation cycles. We present a learning-based framework for continuous autonomous excavation that integrates terrain-aware target selection with reinforcement- and imitation-learning controllers. The framework separates target-conditioned motion from local digging: a shared task-conditioned RL policy controls waypoint-guided approach and loaded transport, while an IL policy learns vision-based digging and lifting from expert demonstrations. Digging targets are selected from LiDAR elevation maps and converted into bucket-tip waypoints for motion control. The control architecture coordinates the learned policies and deterministic unloading through a shared motion interface. The complete system is deployed on a scaled hydraulic excavator with multimodal sensing and closed-loop actuator control. Offline replay and physical experiments demonstrate more consistent target selection, shorter local motion time, and increased payload compared with the respective baselines. The learned digging policy achieves a mean payload of 6.52 kg per completed cycle, compared with 2.68 kg for Fixed Dig. Three five-scoop runs further demonstrate consecutive autonomous excavation under continuously changing pile geometry.

摘要（中文）：重复性挖掘作业会持续改变料堆几何形态，这就要求自主挖掘机在连续挖掘周期中不断调整挖掘目标并协调运动。本文提出了一种基于学习的连续自主挖掘框架，该框架将地形感知目标选择与强化学习和模仿学习控制器相结合。该框架将目标条件化运动与局部挖掘解耦：共享的任务条件化强化学习策略控制路径点引导的接近和满载运输，而模仿学习策略则从专家示范中学习基于视觉的挖掘和提升动作。挖掘目标从激光雷达高程图中选取，并转换为铲斗齿尖路径点以用于运动控制。控制架构通过共享运动接口协调学习策略与确定性卸载。完整系统部署在一台配备多模态感知和闭环执行器控制的缩比液压挖掘机上。离线回放和物理实验表明，与相应基线相比，该系统在目标选择一致性、局部运动时间缩短和有效载荷提升方面均表现更优。学习得到的挖掘策略平均每完成一个循环可获取6.52公斤有效载荷，而固定挖掘基线仅为2.68公斤。三次连续五铲试验进一步验证了在不断变化的料堆几何条件下系统的连续自主挖掘能力。

Authors: Shuai Zhao, Ji-an Pan, Quantao Yang, Zheng Wang, Chaoyi Chen, Qing Xu, Keqiang Li

UCON: Uncertainty-aware Navigation with Historical Re-association in Dynamic Environments RLRobot

uncertainty-aware navigation dynamic obstacle avoidance Kalman filter trajectory optimization perception stability

简要说明：UCON提出了一种用于动态环境的感知不确定性导航算法，结合点级历史重关联机制以稳定感知，并将卡尔曼滤波的协方差传播作为可微成本项嵌入轨迹优化中。

TLDR: UCON proposes an uncertainty-aware navigation algorithm for dynamic environments, combining a point-level historical re-association mechanism for stable perception with a Kalman-filter-based uncertainty propagation that is embedded into trajectory optimization as differentiable cost terms.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is hindered by two fundamental challenges: perception instability and uncertainty-optimization mismatch. The former leads to identity switches and unreliable motion estimation, while the latter prevents principled incorporation of motion uncertainty into trajectory optimization. To address these challenges, we propose UCON, an uncertainty-aware navigation algorithm in dynamic environments. For perception instability, we present a point-level historical re-association mechanism that leverages historical point cloud fragments to recover lost targets while maintaining identity continuity. Subsequently, a Kalman filter is employed to provide anisotropic motion state estimation and covariance propagation. To resolve the uncertainty-optimization mismatch, we transform predicted states and their covariances into uncertainty sectors, which are embedded as differentiable cost terms within a trajectory optimization framework. This achieves consistent uncertainty-aware dynamic obstacle avoidance while maintaining smoothness and feasibility. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that, while maintaining high computational efficiency, UCON achieves superior perception stability and robust navigation performance in dynamic environments compared to state-of-the-art methods. The code will be open-sourced to facilitate further research.

摘要（中文）：动态环境中的自主导航面临两个基本挑战：感知不稳定性和不确定性-优化不匹配。前者导致身份切换和不可靠的运动估计，而后者阻碍了将运动不确定性以原则性方式纳入轨迹优化中。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了UCON，一种动态环境中不确定性感知的导航算法。针对感知不稳定性，我们提出了一种点级历史重关联机制，利用历史点云片段恢复丢失目标，同时保持身份连续性。随后，采用卡尔曼滤波器提供各向异性的运动状态估计和协方差传播。为解决不确定性-优化不匹配问题，我们将预测状态及其协方差转换为不确定性扇区，并将其作为可微分的成本项嵌入轨迹优化框架中。这在不牺牲平滑性和可行性的前提下，实现了一致的不确定性感知动态障碍物规避。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，在保持高计算效率的同时，UCON在动态环境中相较于现有最先进方法实现了更优的感知稳定性和鲁棒导航性能。相关代码将开源以促进进一步研究。

Authors: Bing Sun, Yue Lin, Yongsheng Yuan, Yang Liu, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu

A Simple Gripper Interface for Simulator-Agnostic Cloth Manipulation Manipulation

cloth manipulation grasping model simulator-agnostic positional constraints sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出一种简单且与模拟器无关的布料抓取模型，基于位置约束和抓取体积，并通过将仿真轨迹迁移到真实机器人展示其实用性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a simple, simulator-agnostic grasping model for cloth manipulation based on positional constraints and grasping volumes, and demonstrates its practicality by transferring a trajectory from simulation to a real robot.

Abstract: This paper presents a grasping model for cloth manipulation specifically tailored to ease the deployment of robotic control methods. The model is robust, fast and easy to implement avoiding at the same time contact and friction considerations between the gripper and the cloth in favor of simple positional constraints. The gripper is described by its pose, jaw state, and an attached grasping volume. Two kinds of grasping volumes are considered: an axis-aligned box to simulate a pinch grasping and a square pyramidal volume to simulate point grasping. When the gripper closes, the discrete cloth positions lying inside this volume are selected, stored in the local gripper frame, and then transported with the gripper motion. A simple squeezing step is also included to progressively move the selected cloth positions toward the center of the grasping region, avoiding an instantaneous displacement at closure. The model can be used in any simulator as it only requires access to discrete cloth positions and a mechanism for imposing target positions as constraints. We implement our grasping model in conjunction with a constraint-based inextensible cloth simulator, where grasping is implemented as moving positional equality constraints coupled with stretch, shear, collision, and table contact projection steps. The same gripper trajectory is applied on a robot arm to fold a real piece of cloth, serving as a simple bridge between simulation and physical cloth manipulation and showcasing the realism and practicality of our idealized grasping model.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种面向布料操作的抓取模型，旨在简化机器人控制方法的部署。该模型鲁棒、快速且易于实现，同时避免了夹爪与布料之间的接触和摩擦考虑，转而采用简单的位置约束。夹爪由其位姿、钳口状态及附着的抓取体积描述。本文考虑了两种抓取体积：用于模拟捏取抓取的轴向对齐盒体，以及用于模拟点抓取的方锥体积。当夹爪闭合时，位于该体积内的离散布料位置被选中，存储于夹爪局部坐标系中，并随夹爪运动而移动。模型还包含一个简单的挤压步骤，以逐步将被选中的布料位置移向抓取区域中心，避免闭合时产生瞬时位移。该模型无需复杂的接触模拟，仅需访问离散布料位置及施加目标位置约束的机制，因此可适用于任何仿真器。我们将该抓取模型与基于约束的不可拉伸布料仿真器结合实现，其中抓取通过移动位置等式约束实现，并与拉伸、剪切、碰撞及桌面接触投影步骤耦合。相同的夹爪轨迹被应用于真实机器人手臂以折叠一块实际布料，从而在仿真与物理布料操作之间架起简单桥梁，展示了所提出的理想化抓取模型的真实性与实用性。

Authors: Abhilash Nayak, Franco Coltraro, Maria Alberich-Carramiñana, Carme Torras

EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies Manipulation

imitation learning human demonstrations manipulation tempo retiming behavior cloning

简要说明：EgoSpeedUp 利用人类演示推断阶段性的操作节奏，并据此重新定时缓慢的机器人演示，从而在真实世界模仿学习中提高成功率和速度。

TLDR: EgoSpeedUp uses human demonstrations to infer phase-wise manipulation tempo and retimes slow robot demonstrations, improving success rate and speed in real-world imitation learning.

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.

摘要（中文）：通过模仿学习训练的机器人操作策略，不仅继承了示范行为，还继承了机器人示范中保守的执行节奏。现有的加速方法能够比原始示范执行得更快，但主要依据机器人侧信息或预定义的节奏因子来确定适当的加速程度，这仍然留下了如何获取任务适宜的、每个操作阶段应推进速度的参考标准的问题。我们引入了EgoSpeedUp框架，该框架利用人类操作作为机器人模仿学习的时间监督信号。我们的关键洞见在于，人类示范自然揭示了任务适宜的分阶段操作节奏。针对同一任务，给定慢速的机器人示范和人类示范，EgoSpeedUp对齐相应的操作阶段，从多个人类示范中估计各阶段的相对执行节奏，并通过重新定时机器人示范来转移所得到的阶段性节奏。随后，重新定时后的示范被用于标准的行为克隆，使机器人能够在保留其可执行操作行为的同时，学习以符合人类节奏的速度执行任务。在两个真实世界的操作任务中，EgoSpeedUp将任务成功率平均提高了25个百分点，同时将成功执行时间减少了36.5%。这些结果表明，人类操作节奏为学习更快、更可靠的机器人策略提供了有效的时间参考。

Authors: Hanbit Oh, Yukiyasu Domae, Takuma Yagi

Continuous Online Fault Detection for Mobile Robots via Adaptive Edge Models RLRobot

Teacher-Student distillation fault detection mobile robots online adaptation active learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于移动机器人连续实时故障检测的师生蒸馏框架，利用离线基础模型训练轻量级学生模型，并支持在线自适应和主动学习。

TLDR: This paper presents a Teacher-Student distillation framework for continuous, real-time onboard fault detection in mobile robots, using an offline foundation model to train a lightweight student model with online adaptation and active learning.

Abstract: Mobile robots require robust, real-time fault detection capable of continuous adaptation on constrained edge hardware. While deep time-series models excel at unsupervised anomaly detection, their computational cost prohibits high-frequency onboard execution. This paper bridges this gap via a Teacher-Student distillation framework. An offline foundation model (TSPulse) generates pseudo-labels from unlabeled time series augmented with fault injections. A lightweight MiniRocket Student, adapted with a Recursive Least Squares estimator, approximates this complex decision boundary to execute real-time inference onboard. Evaluations on the TSB-AD benchmark and a physical mobile robot demonstrate the Student achieves a 4.30 ms CPU inference latency. During real-world domain shifts, online adaptation enables the Student to recover from unseen mechanical degradation, improving VUS-PR scores from 0.26 to 0.75 without catastrophic forgetting. Crucially, an uncertainty-guided active learning strategy minimizes operator cognitive load, requesting sparse interventions only when encountering novel fault distributions. These results validate the deployment of state-of-the-art anomaly detection on resource-constrained robotics through offline-to-online distillation.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人在受限的边缘硬件上运行，需要具备稳健、实时的故障检测能力，并能够持续自适应。尽管深度时间序列模型在无监督异常检测方面表现出色，但其计算成本过高，难以支持高频机载执行。本文通过教师-学生蒸馏框架弥补了这一不足。一个离线基础模型（TSPulse）利用注入故障的无标签时间序列生成伪标签，轻量化的MiniRocket学生模型则通过递归最小二乘估计器进行适配，以近似这一复杂决策边界，从而实现机载实时推理。在TSB-AD基准测试及实体移动机器人上的评估结果表明，该学生模型在CPU上实现了4.30毫秒的推理延迟。在真实世界域偏移场景下，在线自适应使学生模型能够从未见过的机械退化中恢复，并将VUS-PR评分从0.26提升至0.75，同时避免灾难性遗忘。尤为重要的是，一种基于不确定性引导的主动学习策略可最大限度地降低操作员的认知负担，仅在遇到新故障分布时才请求稀疏的人工干预。上述结果验证了通过离线到在线的蒸馏方法，可在资源受限的机器人平台上部署先进的异常检测技术。

Authors: Jordan Levy, Nicolas Verstaevel, Vincent Talon, Benoit Gaudou

Anthropomimetic Soft Robotic Forearm with Independently Articulated Carpal Bones Enabling Human-Like Adaptive Stiffness Modulability HumanoidEmbodied

anthropomimetic soft robot wrist stiffness modulation carpal bone morphology adaptive stiffness humanoid wrist design

简要说明：本文介绍了一种具有独立腕骨的人形柔软机械前臂，能够复现人类腕部刚度调节，证明腕骨形态对自适应刚度至关重要，并为仿人手腕设计提供原则。

TLDR: The paper presents an anthropomimetic soft robotic forearm with independently articulated carpal bones that replicates human wrist stiffness modulation, demonstrating that carpal bone morphology is crucial for adaptive stiffness and providing design principles for humanoid wrists.

Abstract: The human wrist exhibits adaptive stiffness modulability: joint stiffness anisotropy can be actively regulated through muscle co-contraction. This functionality is essential for stable manipulation, yet the underlying morphological factors remain unclear. To identify these factors, we developed an anatomically accurate anthropomimetic soft robotic forearm comprising eight independently movable carpal bones interconnected by ligaments, 22 actuated muscles, and compliant fingertips. We measured wrist joint stiffness under four muscle activation patterns across three skeletal configurations: anatomically normal carpal bones, a fused proximal carpal row, and a geometric ellipsoidal skeleton. The stiffness ellipse exhibited low stiffness along the dart-throwing motion (DTM) direction when finger muscles were activated, but high stiffness along the same direction when wrist and finger muscles were activated simultaneously. These results agree with previously reported human measurements, demonstrating that precise anatomical replication reproduces human-like stiffness modulability. Fusing the proximal carpal row eliminated the low DTM-direction stiffness under finger muscle activation, while the geometric ellipsoidal skeleton showed poor stiffness ellipse reorientation across all conditions. Carpal bone motion analysis revealed significantly opposing coupling patterns between wrist and finger muscles at the proximal carpal row, accompanied by a consistent but non-significant trend at the midcarpal joint, providing a mechanical explanation for this modulation. These findings demonstrate that carpal bone morphology plays a dominant role in human wrist stiffness modulation and provide design principles for humanoid robot wrists.

摘要（中文）：人类腕部具有自适应刚度调节能力：关节刚度的各向异性可通过肌肉协同收缩进行主动调控。这一功能对稳定操作至关重要，但其潜在的形态学因素尚不明确。为识别这些因素，我们开发了一种解剖学精确的仿人软组织机器人前臂，该装置包含八块由韧带连接、可独立运动的腕骨，22块驱动肌肉以及柔性指尖。我们在四种肌肉激活模式下，针对三种骨骼构型测量了腕关节刚度：解剖学正常的腕骨、融合的近排腕骨以及几何椭球形骨骼。结果表明，当仅手指肌肉激活时，刚度椭圆沿投掷样运动（DTM）方向呈现低刚度；而当腕部与手指肌肉同时激活时，沿同一方向则呈现高刚度。这些结果与此前报道的人体测量数据一致，证明精确的解剖复制能够再现类人的刚度调节能力。融合近排腕骨后，手指肌肉激活状态下的DTM方向低刚度特性消失，而几何椭球形骨骼在所有条件下均表现出较差的刚度椭圆重定向能力。腕骨运动分析显示，腕部与手指肌肉在近排腕骨处呈现出显著相反的耦合模式，同时在腕中关节处存在一致但未达显著性的趋势，这为上述调节机制提供了力学解释。这些发现表明，腕骨形态在人类腕部刚度调节中起主导作用，并为仿人机器人腕部设计提供了原则性指导。

Authors: Yoshinobu Obata, Yinlai Jiang, Hiroshi Yokoi, Shunta Togo

Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation WorldModel

Representation World Model inverse dynamics latent path planning continuous control robotic manipulation

简要说明：RWM 是一种在世界模型，直接在表示空间中学习状态和转移，通过构建端点表示之间的潜在路径并利用逆动力学恢复动作来进行规划，无需递归展开。在连续控制基准和机器人操作任务上进行了评估。

TLDR: RWM is a world model that learns state representations and transitions directly in representation space, enabling planning by constructing latent paths between endpoint representations and recovering actions via inverse dynamics, without recursive rollouts. It is evaluated on continuous-control benchmarks and robotic manipulation tasks.

Abstract: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了表示世界模型（RWM），该模型直接在表示空间中学习状态、转换和可执行计划。与现有世界模型通常将潜在表示与显式动力学模型一起学习，并通过搜索、优化或基于策略的预测进行规划不同，RWM直接将规划融入学习到的表示几何结构中。RWM通过在由端点表示构建的潜在路径上局部应用逆动力学监督来学习表示几何结构，要求这些路径保留与任务相关的状态和转换信息。在推理时，规划通过直接在当前表示与目标表示之间构建潜在路径来实现，并利用逆动力学恢复相应的动作，无需递归展开或动作空间搜索。在连续控制基准上的实验证明了RWM在直接规划中的有效性，而机器人操作任务的结果进一步展示了其在更复杂的具身控制任务中的扩展潜力。这些结果表明，直接在表示空间中进行规划为传统世界模型规划提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

Authors: Yijun Yuan, Weicheng Zheng, Weibang Wang, Minghui Qin, Chang Sun, Junhao Huang, Kenan Li, Anmin Liu, Yicheng Yao, Hang Zhao

OREN-X: Octree Residual Network for Real-Time Multi-Modal Mapping Perception3D

octree multi-modal mapping vision-language features online mapping real-time rendering

简要说明：OREN-X提出了一种基于八叉树的多模态建图方法，可同时存储几何、辐射度和视觉语言特征，为机器人实现实时建图并提高精度。

TLDR: OREN-X introduces an octree-based multi-modal mapping method that simultaneously stores geometric, radiance, and vision-language features for robots, achieving real-time performance and improved accuracy.

Abstract: To achieve general-purpose autonomy over long horizons, a robot needs to maintain spatial environment information that supports a variety of tasks: geometry for planning and control, radiance for rendering and relocalization, and vision-language features for open-vocabulary grounding. Existing methods represent and estimate each modality separately, multiplying memory and compute cost while forgoing potential synergy among the representations. We develop OREN-X, an online mapping method that uses an octree in 3D space as a shared data structure for indexing and storing a multi-modal field, capturing geometric, radiance, and vision-language information. OREN-X provides efficient unified storage and retrieval of these data in explicit/implicit and full/compressed form. Our unified representation yields cross-modality synergy: SDF estimates are sharpened by occupancy and radiance, while GPU-based ray-octree traversal and octree query enable real-time rendering. We also use online dictionary learning to compress the vision-language features, shrinking them 3.7x below full per-vertex storage while raising the query accuracy. On Replica, OREN-X maps in real time (80+ fps for SDF and 30+ fps for all four modalities), improves near-surface SDF accuracy by 33% over single-modality baselines, and improves mean open-vocabulary 3D mIoU by 71% and mean accuracy by 61% over the best prior method.

摘要（中文）：为实现长时程的通用自主性，机器人需维护支持多种任务的空间环境信息：用于规划与控制的几何信息、用于渲染与重定位的辐射信息，以及用于开放词汇语义定位的视觉-语言特征。现有方法对各模态分别进行表示与估计，导致内存和计算成本成倍增加，且未能利用各表示之间的潜在协同效应。我们提出了OREN-X，一种在线建图方法，以三维空间中的八叉树作为共享数据结构，用于索引和存储多模态场，涵盖几何、辐射及视觉-语言信息。OREN-X以显式/隐式及完整/压缩形式实现这些数据的高效统一存储与检索。我们的统一表示带来了跨模态协同效应：SDF估计通过占据信息和辐射信息得到锐化，而基于GPU的射线-八叉树遍历和八叉树查询则实现了实时渲染。此外，我们采用在线字典学习对视觉-语言特征进行压缩，相比完全逐顶点存储，压缩幅度达3.7倍，同时查询精度得到提升。在Replica数据集上，OREN-X实现实时建图（SDF达80+帧每秒，四种模态达30+帧每秒），近表面SDF精度相比单模态基线提升33%，开放词汇三维mIoU均值较先前最优方法提升71%，平均精度提升61%。

Authors: Zhirui Dai, Qihao Qian, Dinh Minh Nguyen, Quan-Dung Pham, Kiana Bronder, Carlos Nieto-Granda, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Nikolay Atanasov

A Tendon-Driven Robotic Jellyfish with Constrained Soft Actuation and Depth Control via Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

tendon-driven soft actuation reinforcement learning depth control underwater robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种肌腱驱动的软体机器水母，通过约束软体驱动实现大变形和可重复弯曲，并利用强化学习在仿真和实物中实现闭环深度控制。

TLDR: This paper presents a tendon-driven robotic jellyfish with constrained soft actuators that achieve large, repeatable bending and uses reinforcement learning for closed-loop depth control in simulation and on the physical robot.

Abstract: Jellyfish-inspired robots offer a compliant and efficient approach to underwater locomotion, but achieving large deformation together with repeatable actuation and closed-loop control remains challenging. In this work, we present a tendon-driven robotic jellyfish with constrained soft actuation. Each actuator combines a flexible substrate with discrete constraints, enabling bending up to \(150^\circ\) with an approximately linear tendon displacement-bending relationship. Eight actuators driven by four servos allow the robot to perform stable swimming, attitude adjustment, and self-righting. Based on the linear actuation, a reinforcement-learning controller is further developed, enabling closed-loop depth regulation in both simulation and physical experiments. These results show that mechanical constraints can improve the controllability of soft actuation while preserving compliant jellyfish-like motion, providing a route toward manoeuvrable and autonomous jellyfish robots.

摘要（中文）：摘要：受水母启发的机器人为水下运动提供了一种柔顺且高效的方法，但实现大变形的同时兼顾可重复驱动和闭环控制仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种采用受限软驱动方式的绳驱水母机器人。每个驱动器由柔性基底和离散约束组成，可实现高达150°的弯曲，且肌腱位移与弯曲角度之间近似呈线性关系。由四个舵机驱动的八个驱动器使机器人能够执行稳定游动、姿态调整和自扶正动作。基于该线性驱动特性，进一步开发了强化学习控制器，在仿真和物理实验中均实现了闭环深度调节。结果表明，机械约束能够在不损失水母柔顺运动特性的前提下提升软驱动的可控性，为研制高机动性、自主化的水母机器人提供了一条可行路径。

Authors: Jiarui Peng, Yutong Wu, Zelong Wang, Ping Deng, Xiaotian Zhang, Xian Chen, Kecheng Qin, Zhongyi Li

A Support-Enhanced Granular-Jamming Gripper for RL-based Grasping with Continuum Manipulators Manipulation

granular-jamming gripper continuum manipulator compliance reinforcement learning grasp-and-release

简要说明：本文提出了一种适用于连续体机械臂的支撑增强型颗粒阻塞夹持器，在阻塞前保持柔顺性，阻塞后建立直接负载路径，并通过物理系统上的RL控制验证了模块化抓取与释放任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a support-enhanced granular-jamming gripper for continuum manipulators, designed to combine compliance with a direct load path after jamming, and demonstrates a modular grasp-and-release task using an RL-based reaching controller deployed on a physical system.

Abstract: Continuum manipulators provide dexterous motion in confined spaces, but structural compliance, hysteresis, and load-dependent deformation leave residual position and orientation errors that can undermine reliable contact with rigid grippers. To address this limitation, this paper presents a lightweight support-enhanced granular-jamming gripper tailored to a continuum manipulator. The gripper maintains compliance before jamming while establishing a direct load path to the continuum manipulator tip after jamming. To improve its grasping performance, we systematically designed membrane materials, particles, filling ratios, and the internal support structure, and further identify geometry-dependent grasp boundaries with respect to contact offset and object shape. Building on these results, we construct a physical manipulation system integrating the continuum manipulator, granular-jamming gripper, visual feedback, tendon actuation, and pneumatic control. We then train a reinforcement-learning-based reaching controller in a randomized simulation and deploy it on the physical system, demonstrating how positioning control and contact level mechanical adaptation can complement each other in a modular grasp-and-release task. By introducing an adaptive structure that relaxes the need for highly accurate modeling and positioning control, this work explores a design paradigm that integrates physical and embodied intelligence.

摘要（中文）：连续体机械臂能够在受限空间中实现灵巧运动，但结构柔顺性、迟滞效应及负载相关变形会残留位置与姿态误差，从而削弱刚性夹爪可靠接触的能力。为解决该问题，本文提出了一种面向连续体机械臂的轻量化支撑增强型颗粒阻塞夹爪。该夹爪在阻塞前保持柔顺性，同时在阻塞后建立与连续体机械臂末端的直接载荷传递路径。为提升其抓取性能，我们系统设计了隔膜材料、颗粒、填充率及内部支撑结构，并进一步识别了与接触偏移量和物体形状相关的几何依赖抓取边界。基于上述结果，我们构建了一套物理操控系统，集成连续体机械臂、颗粒阻塞夹爪、视觉反馈、腱驱动及气动控制。随后，我们在随机化仿真中训练了一种基于强化学习的到达控制器，并将其部署于物理系统上，验证了定位控制与接触层面机械自适应在模块化抓取-释放任务中的互补作用。通过引入一种放宽高精度建模与定位控制需求的自适应结构，本研究探索了一种融合物理智能与具身智能的设计范式。

Authors: Danyu Liu, Tianlin Zhang, Wei Chen, Wei Tang, Kecheng Qin, Zhongyu Li

From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments Manipulation

active exploration embodied manipulation partial observability planning module perception-execution interleaving

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于具身操作的智能体主动探索框架，集成了规划、感知和执行模块，并通过细粒度的感知-执行交错策略来处理部分可观测性和干扰物，在真实感的寻找与放置任务中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an agentic active exploration framework for embodied manipulation that integrates planning, perception, and execution modules with a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy to handle partial observability and distractors, validated on a realistic Find-and-Place task.

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic systems have substantially enhanced the long-horizon capability of embodied manipulation. However, many existing frameworks still follow a passive execution paradigm, which limits their applicability to real-world scenarios involving textual semantic cues, distractors, and initially invisible targets. To bridge this gap, we propose an agent-based active exploration framework that enables robots to dynamically interact with the environment rather than merely execute predefined instructions. Specifically, our framework consists of three collaborative modules: a planning module for high-level task reasoning, a perception module for visual scene understanding, and an execution module for low-level manipulation. This design allows the robot to actively acquire task-relevant information, adapt its behavior based on environmental feedback, and complete manipulation tasks under partial observability. Furthermore, we introduce a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy, which tightly couples visual feedback with skill execution to improve exploration robustness. We evaluate our method on a realistic Find-and-Place task, demonstrating its effectiveness in challenging environments where target objects must be actively discovered before manipulation.

摘要（中文）：智能体系统的最新进展显著增强了具身操作的长时程能力。然而，许多现有框架仍遵循被动执行范式，这限制了其在涉及文本语义线索、干扰物及初始不可见目标的真实场景中的适用性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种基于智能体的主动探索框架，使机器人能够动态地与环境交互，而不仅仅执行预定义指令。具体而言，我们的框架由三个协同模块组成：用于高层任务推理的规划模块、用于视觉场景理解的感知模块，以及用于低层操作的执行模块。该设计使机器人能够主动获取任务相关信息，根据环境反馈调整自身行为，并在部分可观测条件下完成操作任务。此外，我们引入了一种细粒度的感知-执行交错策略，将视觉反馈与技能执行紧密结合，以提升探索的鲁棒性。我们在一个真实的“查找-放置”任务上评估了所提方法，验证了其在目标物体需在操作前被主动发现的挑战性环境中的有效性。

Authors: Shilin Ma, Chubin Zhang, Xulong Bai, Zifeng Gao, Shiyi Zhang, Yansong Tang

DA-GRD: Decision-Aware Grasp-Relevant Disambiguation for tactile recovery under perception-to-execution mismatches Manipulation

tactile sensing grasp pose recovery belief disambiguation decision-aware probing perception-to-execution mismatch

简要说明：DA-GRD 提出了一种决策感知的触觉探测策略，在感知-执行不匹配情况下利用稀疏触觉交互恢复任务相关抓取，在仿真和真实实验中显著优于基于过时视觉的基线。

TLDR: DA-GRD proposes a decision-aware tactile probing strategy that recovers task-relevant grasps under perception-to-execution mismatches using sparse tactile interactions, significantly improving physical lift success over stale-visual baselines in both simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Grasping is a fundamental robotic capability that bridges perception and physical task execution. This paper studies grasp pose recovery under a perception-to-execution mismatch, where a grasp generated from visual perception may become spatially stale if the object moves before execution, using only sparse tactile interactions and no further visual observations. We propose DA-GRD, Decision-Aware Grasp-Relevant Disambiguation, which maintains a weighted planar belief over possible object configurations and selects tactile probes according to their ability to eliminate hypotheses and improve agreement among candidate task grasps. Rather than fully relocalizing the object, DA-GRD stops when the remaining hypotheses support a common executable grasp. In MuJoCo experiments on ten rigid objects with translations up to 5~cm and yaw perturbations up to $\pm45^\circ$, DA-GRD achieves an 84.7% physical lift success rate, compared with 9.1% for stale AnyGrasp, 21.2% for the original fix-scan baseline, and 63.7% for fix-scan method adapted with an SE(2) belief. DA-GRD also achieves a 57.3% Task conditioned Success rate. Across objects, it uses a success-average of 4.13 tactile probes over the ten per-object means, corresponding to a 72.5% reduction relative to the fixed 15-probe baselines. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve 71.7% physical lift success and 38.3% task-conditioned success with 4.20 probes on average. These results show that tactile sensing can recover task-relevant grasps under vision-off conditions with limited physical interaction, without requiring complete object localization.

摘要（中文）：抓取是一项基础的机器人能力，它将感知与物理任务执行连接起来。本文研究了在感知-执行不匹配条件下的抓取姿态恢复问题，即当物体在执行前发生移动时，仅依靠稀疏的触觉交互且无进一步视觉观测的情况下，从视觉感知生成的抓取可能变得空间上过时。我们提出DA-GRD（决策感知的抓取相关消歧方法），该方法维护关于可能物体配置的加权平面信念，并根据触觉探测消除假设及提升候选任务抓取间一致性的能力来选择触觉探测点。DA-GRD并不完全重新定位物体，而是在剩余假设支持一个共同的可执行抓取时停止。在以多达5厘米平移和±45°偏航扰动为条件的十个刚性物体的MuJoCo实验中，DA-GRD实现了84.7%的物理提升成功率，而过时的AnyGrasp为9.1%，原始固定扫描基线为21.2%，采用SE(2)信念调整后的固定扫描方法为63.7%。DA-GRD还实现了57.3%的任务条件成功率。在各物体上，它平均使用4.13次触觉探测（基于十个物体各自均值的成功平均值），相对于固定的15次探测基线减少了72.5%。在六个物体上的真实世界实验中，实现了71.7%的物理提升成功率和38.3%的任务条件成功率，平均使用4.20次探测。这些结果表明，在无视觉条件下，触觉感知能够以有限的物理交互恢复任务相关的抓取，而无需完整的物体定位。

Authors: Haoran Wang, Yuteng Sun, Yuanjie Li, Ruofei Bai, Meng Yee, Chuah, Wenyu Liang, Jun Li, Wei-Yun Yau

Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots Manipulation

LLM chaining task planning service robot RoboCup@Home prompt engineering

简要说明：本文针对通用服务机器人任务规划，提出了一种LLM链式架构，减少了约45%的提示长度并提高了规划一致性，在三个语言模型上验证了效果，真实机器人实验表明规划成功并不保证任务完成。

TLDR: This paper proposes an LLM chaining architecture for task planning in general purpose service robots, reducing prompt length and improving planning consistency across three language models, with real-robot execution showing planning success does not guarantee task completion.

Abstract: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.

摘要（中文）：通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务，如RoboCup@Home基准测试中所定义的，要求机器人在真实家庭环境中解读多样化的自然语言指令并生成多步骤动作序列。传统的单一提示（SP）方法面临上下文膨胀及“中间迷失”现象，导致任务规划可靠性不足。我们提出了一种大语言模型（LLM）链式架构，将指令分类与动作生成分离为两个专门阶段，在减少每次推理提示长度约45%的同时提升了规划的一致性。我们使用100条随机生成的GPSR指令，对涵盖本地开源及前沿云端部署场景的三个语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，与SP方法相比，所有模型在规划性能上均获得一致提升，其中本地模型的提升幅度最高达+37个百分点。此外，在丰田人类支持机器人（HSR）上进行的真机执行实验显示，规划成功并不能保证任务完成，10项任务中有6项顺利完成，执行层故障被识别为当前最主要的剩余瓶颈。
