Authors: Lucas Da Mota Bruno, Jiahao Sim, Yoshinobu Hagiwara

Simple Torque-Observation Alignment for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Grasping with a Direct-Drive Gripper Manipulation

sim-to-real transfer torque observation alignment direct-drive gripper teacher-student policy grasping

简要说明：本文提出了一种简单的扭矩观测对齐方法，用于直驱夹爪上抓取策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移，通过测功机标定、增量扭矩观测和注入高斯噪声，在消融实验中实现了100%的抓取成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a simple torque observation alignment method for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of a grasping policy on a direct-drive gripper, using dynamometer calibration, delta torque observations, and injected Gaussian noise, achieving 100% grasp success in ablation.

Abstract: Torque observations in reinforcement learning remain challenging because simulated and measured torque differ in scale, offset, and noise. In this paper, we propose a simple torque observation alignment method for robots with direct-drive (DD) actuators, in which motor current maps linearly to joint torque through a motor-type-specific torque constant K_tau. First, dynamometer calibration identifies K_tau* and corrects the scale mismatch between simulated and real torque. Second, the method uses delta_tau(t) = tau(t) - tau(t-1) as the observation in both domains to eliminate the constant offset instead of using the direct torque tau(t), which carries a domain-dependent bias. Third, Gaussian noise obtained from the dynamometer measurement data is injected during the learning process. To validate the proposed method, we train a teacher-student grasping policy entirely in simulation and deploy the distilled student on a multifingered DD gripper. The deployed policy performs proprioceptive grasping using only joint positions and torque differences. We conduct an ablation study comparing the proposed method with alternative alignment variants on nine in-distribution (ID) objects. The proposed method achieves 100% grasp success. These results demonstrate that the proposed alignment method improves the robustness of zero-shot policy transfer on the DD gripper against real-world torque-observation mismatches.

摘要（中文）：扭矩观测在强化学习中仍然具有挑战性，因为模拟扭矩与实测扭矩在尺度、偏移和噪声方面存在差异。本文提出了一种适用于直驱（DD）执行器机器人的简洁扭矩观测对齐方法，其中电机电流通过电机类型特定的扭矩常数 K_tau 线性映射至关节扭矩。首先，测功机标定确定 K_tau*，并修正模拟扭矩与真实扭矩之间的尺度失配。其次，该方法在两个域中均使用 delta_tau(t) = tau(t) - tau(t-1) 作为观测值，以消除恒定偏移，而非使用携带域相关偏差的直接扭矩 tau(t)。第三，在学习过程中注入从测功机测量数据中获取的高斯噪声。为验证所提方法，我们完全在仿真环境中训练一个教师-学生抓取策略，并将蒸馏后的学生模型部署于多指直驱夹爪上。部署后的策略仅利用关节位置和扭矩差值实现本体感觉抓取。我们进行了消融研究，在九个分布内（ID）物体上比较了所提方法与替代对齐变体的性能。所提方法实现了100%的抓取成功率。这些结果表明，所提出的对齐方法增强了直驱夹爪上零样本策略迁移对真实世界扭矩观测失配的鲁棒性。

Authors: Doyoung Kim, Edgar Lee, Hyeonsun Park, Chunghyeon Lee, Chihyun Han, Uisu Hwang, Seokhwan Jeong

Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search for Impact-Aware Dexterous Catching Manipulation

impact-aware catching imitation learning reinforcement learning motion search outcome-sensitive window

简要说明：本文提出结果敏感运动搜索方法，通过细化成功的教师轨迹并修复失败条件，为冲击感知灵巧接物生成更优的模仿学习演示，使学到的策略在接取成功率和冲击缓解上超越特权强化学习教师。

TLDR: This paper introduces Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search, a method that refines successful teacher rollouts and repairs failing conditions to generate better demonstrations for imitation learning in impact-aware dexterous catching, enabling the learned policy to outperform the privileged RL teacher.

Abstract: Skilled humans can catch fast-moving objects softly by coordinating interception, velocity matching, and follow-through to mitigate impact. Learning such impact-aware catching with reinforcement learning (RL), however, is challenging, as the policy must achieve reliable interception and grasping while regulating the sensitive transition into contact. Moreover, even a capable privileged-state RL teacher may not provide ideal demonstrations for a deployable imitation-learning (IL) student: teacher failures limit task coverage, while small variations in pre-contact motion can produce substantially different impact and grasping outcomes. We characterize this phenomenon through interventional outcome sensitivity and introduce the outcome-sensitive window (OSW) to guide targeted demonstration construction. Building on this formulation, we propose Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search, which learns a task-conditioned manifold of successful OSW motions and performs local geodesic search to refine successful teacher rollouts and repair task conditions where the teacher fails. We then validate candidate motions through complete rollouts under a calibrated IL-student action-error model and retain only successful executions as demonstrations. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that our method effectively repairs task conditions where the teacher fails and enables the resulting IL policy to outperform the privileged RL teacher in both catching success and impact mitigation.

摘要（中文）：熟练的人类能够通过协调拦截、速度匹配和随球动作来柔和地接住快速移动的物体，从而减轻冲击。然而，使用强化学习（RL）来学习这种具有冲击感知能力的接物动作颇具挑战性，因为策略必须在调节接触时敏感过渡的同时，实现可靠的拦截与抓取。此外，即使是一个能力强大的特权状态强化学习教师模型，也可能无法为可部署的模仿学习（IL）学生模型提供理想的示范：教师模型的失败会限制任务覆盖范围，而接触前动作的微小变化可能导致截然不同的冲击与抓取结果。我们通过干预性结果敏感性来刻画这一现象，并引入结果敏感窗口（OSW）以指导有针对性的示范构建。在此基础上，我们提出了结果敏感性动作搜索方法，该方法学习一个以任务为条件的成功OSW动作流形，并执行局部测地线搜索来优化成功的教师模型轨迹，同时修复教师模型失败的任务条件。随后，我们在经过校准的IL学生模型动作误差模型下，通过完整轨迹验证候选动作，并仅保留成功执行的动作作为示范。大量仿真实验表明，我们的方法能够有效修复教师模型失败的任务条件，并使所得的IL策略在接球成功率和冲击减轻两方面均优于特权状态RL教师模型。

Authors: Guorui Pei, Jinsong Wu, Songyuan Su, Jiaming Qi, Sichao Liu, David Navarro-Alarcon, Bin Liu, Peng Zhou

CALM: Current Aligned Link Manipulation for Single Arm Oversized Object Lifting Manipulation

whole-arm manipulation motor current sim-to-real transfer DAgger oversized object lifting

简要说明：CALM 提出了一种利用电机电流作为反馈、在仿真中训练分阶段策略并在真实机器人上通过因果电流映射和 DAgger 迁移的全身操纵框架，用于提升超大物体的顺序抓取与举升成功率。

TLDR: CALM introduces a framework for learning whole-arm manipulation of oversized objects by decomposing the task into stage-specific policies trained in simulation with motor current as feedback, and transfers to a real robot via a causal current mapper and DAgger, achieving high success rates in both simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Most robots manipulate objects solely with their end effectors, whereas humans flexibly leverage different body parts, such as the forearm and elbow, especially when handling oversized objects. Learning such whole-arm manipulation is chal-lenging due to long-horizon sparse rewards, limited contact sens-ing, and the sim-to-real gap in contact and actuator dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Current-Aligned Link Manipulation, a framework for learning long-horizon contact-rich manipulation using motor current as joint load related feedback. Three stage-specific policies first learn repositioning, grasping, and lifting using privileged simulation information, and a stage router sequences them to generate complete task demonstrations. For sim-to-real transfer, a causal current mapper predicts physical motor current from simulated joint histories, aligning the actuator current observation between simulation and hardware. A unified student policy then learns from these demonstrations using only deployable sensor observations and is further refined with DAgger. The task policies are trained entirely in simulation, and the final student is deployed on hardware. Experiments demonstrate 76.2% (762/1000 trials) complete-task success in simulation and 73.3% success (22/30 trials) on the physical robot for sequential oversized-object lifting.

摘要（中文）：绝大多数机器人在操控物体时仅依赖其末端执行器，而人类则能灵活运用前臂、肘部等不同身体部位，尤其在处理超大物体时更为明显。学习这类全身臂部操控面临诸多挑战，包括长期稀疏奖励、有限的接触感知，以及接触与执行器动力学中的仿真到现实差距。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“电流对齐连杆操控”的框架，利用电机电流作为关节负载相关的反馈，来学习长时间跨度的接触丰富型操控任务。三个阶段特定的策略首先利用仿真中的特权信息分别学习重新定位、抓取和提升动作，并通过一个阶段路由器进行排序，生成完整的任务演示。为实现仿真到现实的迁移，我们设计了一个因果电流映射器，从模拟关节历史中预测物理电机电流，使执行器电流观测在仿真与硬件之间保持一致。随后，一个统一的学生策略仅使用可部署的传感器观测从这些演示中学习，并通过DAgger进一步优化。任务策略完全在仿真中训练，最终的学生策略部署于实体硬件。实验结果显示，在仿真中完整任务成功率达到76.2%（762/1000次试验），在实体机器人上顺序提起超大物体的成功率为73.3%（22/30次试验）。

Authors: Jun Hu, Sihan Chen, Kosta Jovanovic, David Navarro-Alarcon, Xueqian Wang, Jia Pan, Peng Zhou

ReVNM: Learning-Based Visual Navigation from a Remote Camera VLN

Visual Navigation Model exocentric-to-egocentric learning-by-synthesis remote camera collision-free navigation

简要说明：ReVNM 提出一种基于合成学习的方案，利用远程监控摄像头作为隐式地图，通过预测自我中心深度来实现无预先建图和无机载视觉处理的机器人导航。

TLDR: ReVNM introduces a learning-by-synthesis approach that enables a remote surveillance camera to act as an implicit map for visual navigation by predicting egocentric depth from exocentric observations, achieving collision-free robot navigation without pre-built maps or onboard vision processing.

Abstract: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) enable robots to navigate from egocentric visual observations without geometric localization and planning, but long-range navigation still requires pre-built maps. This paper presents the Remote Visual Navigation Model (ReVNM), which uses a single remote surveillance camera to serve as both an observation source and an implicit environmental map for visual navigation. While the use of remote cameras could eliminate the need for pre-built maps as well as onboard vision processing, their limited field of view instead of egocentric observations makes it hard to achieve collision-free navigation. The lack of existing data with diverse remote viewpoints, which are crucial for training robust VNMs, further complicates the challenge. In this work, we propose a learning-by-synthesis approach to address this two-fold challenge. Our ReVNM extends a state-of-the-art VNM architecture with an exocentric-to-egocentric (exo2ego) module that predicts an egocentric depth observation from remote-camera observations. This helps the VNM to plan a path while considering obstacles in front of the robot. Trained only on randomly generated worlds with diverse obstacle layouts and camera viewpoints, ReVNM can generalize well to real robot navigation without additional fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

摘要（中文）：视觉导航模型（VNMs）使机器人能够仅凭自我中心的视觉观察进行导航，而无需几何定位与规划，但长距离导航仍依赖于预先构建的地图。本文提出了远程视觉导航模型（ReVNM），该模型利用单一远程监控摄像头，既作为观察来源，又作为视觉导航的隐式环境地图。尽管使用远程摄像头可省去预先构建地图及机载视觉处理的需求，但其有限的视野视角（而非自我中心的观察）使得实现无碰撞导航颇为困难。此外，现有数据中缺乏多样化的远程视角——而这对于训练鲁棒的VNMs至关重要——进一步加剧了这一挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一种通过合成进行学习的方法，以应对这双重挑战。我们的ReVNM在先进VNM架构基础上，扩展了一个从外部视角到自我中心视角（exo2ego）的模块，该模块能从远程摄像头观察中预测自我中心的深度观察，从而帮助VNM在规划路径时考虑机器人前方的障碍物。仅利用随机生成的世界（包含多样化的障碍布局和摄像头视角）进行训练，ReVNM便能很好地泛化到真实机器人导航中，无需额外微调。在仿真及真实环境中的实验均证实了所提方法的有效性。

Authors: Michikuni Eguchi, Kohei Honda, Masafumi Endo, Yasuhiro Yoshimura, Ryo Yonetani

Sim-to-Real Aware End-to-End Learning Environment for Micromobility WorldModel

sim-to-real world model DreamerV3 micromobility differential drive

简要说明：本文提出了一个针对WHILL Model CR的仿真到现实感知的端到端学习环境，利用AWSIM和ROS 2通过贝叶斯优化减小仿真与现实差距。基于世界模型的DreamerV3智能体在仿真中实现任务完成，并直接迁移到实体车辆进行避障。

TLDR: This paper presents a sim-to-real aware, vehicle-specific end-to-end learning environment for the WHILL Model CR, using AWSIM and ROS 2 with Bayesian optimization to reduce the sim-to-real gap. A world model-based agent trained with DreamerV3 achieves task completion in simulation and direct sim-to-real transfer to a physical vehicle for obstacle avoidance.

Abstract: While end-to-end autonomous driving systems show promise, their application to micromobility vehicles is hindered by simulators failing to capture specific kinematics, such as differential drives and omni-wheels. This paper pro- poses a sim-to-real-aware, vehicle-specific end-to-end learning environment for the WHILL Model CR on AWSIM and ROS 2. To minimize the sim-to-real gap, physical parameters are optimized via Bayesian optimization using real-world data, reducing trajectory errors across various driving scenarios. Additionally, this study introduces a synchronized architecture tailored for the stable training of world model-based agents. An end-to-end policy trained with DreamerV3 exhibited learning progress and achieved task completion in a simulated obstacle avoidance setting. Furthermore, this policy demonstrated direct sim-to-real transfer to the physical vehicle, enabling the vehicle to navigate around a cardboard box in a real-world corridor replica without fine-tuning. This paper provides a practical foundation for sim-to-real micromobility policy studies.

摘要（中文）：尽管端到端自动驾驶系统展现出巨大潜力，但其在微型交通工具上的应用受到模拟器无法捕捉特定运动学的制约，例如差速驱动和全向轮。本文提出了一种面向WHILL Model CR的、具备仿真到现实感知能力的、车辆专属的端到端学习环境，该环境基于AWSIM和ROS 2构建。为最小化仿真与现实之间的差距，利用真实世界数据通过贝叶斯优化对物理参数进行优化，从而在多种驾驶场景下减少轨迹误差。此外，本研究引入了一种针对基于世界模型的智能体进行稳定训练的同步架构。使用DreamerV3训练的端到端策略在学习过程中表现出进步，并在模拟避障场景中成功完成任务。更进一步，该策略展示了直接从仿真迁移至实车的能力，使车辆能够在真实走廊复刻环境中绕过纸箱而无需微调。本文为微型交通工具的仿真到现实策略研究提供了实用的基础。

Authors: Shouma Amano, Takuya Azumi

Koopman-Accelerated Model-Based Diffusion for Real-Time Robot Control Manipulation

model-based diffusion Koopman operator real-time control trajectory optimization manipulator

简要说明：BK-MBD通过将状态提升到双线性Koopman空间加速基于模型的扩散控制，从而在物理机械臂上实现实时规划。

TLDR: BK-MBD speeds up model-based diffusion for robot control by lifting states into a bilinear Koopman space, enabling real-time planning on a physical manipulator.

Abstract: Conventional model-based diffusion (MBD) achieves effective trajectory optimization by leveraging noise annealing. However, its high computational cost, primarily arising from repeated rollouts of the plant dynamics, has largely confined its use to offline settings. To address this limitation, this paper proposes bilinear Koopman model-based diffusion (BK-MBD). The proposed method lifts the robot's state into a high-dimensional space only once per control step and propagates all candidates in the lifted space thereafter, so each rollout reduces to a fixed number of matrix-vector multiplications. The lifted dynamics are bilinear, allowing the predicted input gain to vary with the robot's configuration, which a linear lifted model cannot represent. In simulation, BK-MBD completed each planning update in at most 14.7 ms within a 50 ms control period and reached the goal on every trial, whereas a linear lift almost never did. The annealed schedule improves closed-loop accuracy over fixed-noise schedules under the learned rollout. Under the exact rollout, both the annealed and fixed-narrow schedules reach every goal, indicating that annealing reduces sensitivity to surrogate-model error. BK-MBD also threaded a passage that no single convex region covers, whereas a convexified bilinear controller rarely succeeded. On a physical manipulator, BK-MBD tracked an initially unknown moving target within the control period and was the only method that met both the tracking task and the deadline. The project page is available at https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/bkmbd/.

摘要（中文）：摘要：基于模型的传统扩散（MBD）方法通过利用噪声退火实现了有效的轨迹优化。然而，其高昂的计算成本主要源于对系统动力学进行重复推演，这极大地限制了其在离线场景中的应用。为克服此局限，本文提出了一种双线性Koopman模型引导的扩散方法（BK-MBD）。该方法在每个控制步长内仅将机器人状态提升至高维空间一次，并在该提升空间中传播所有候选轨迹，从而将每次推演简化为固定次数的矩阵-向量乘法运算。由于提升后的动力学模型具有双线性特性，预测的输入增益能够随机器人位形变化，这是线性提升模型无法实现的。仿真实验中，BK-MBD在50毫秒控制周期内每次规划更新最多耗时14.7毫秒，且所有试验均成功到达目标点，而线性模型则几乎无法实现。在学得模型推演条件下，退火调度相比固定噪声调度显著提升了闭环精度；在精确推演条件下，退火与固定窄带调度均能到达目标，表明退火有效降低了对代理模型误差的敏感性。此外，BK-MBD成功穿越了一个无单一凸区域覆盖的狭窄通道，而凸化双线性控制器则极少成功。在实体机械臂实验中，BK-MBD在控制周期内成功追踪了初始未知的运动目标，是唯一同时满足追踪任务和时限要求的方法。项目主页：https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/bkmbd/。

Authors: Bohyeong Pak, Kangmin Lee, Sanghyun Kim

Fly, Drive, Reconfigure: A Modular Reconfigurable Aerial-Ground Platform for Field Operations Other

modular reconfigurable robots aerial-ground mobility heterogeneous robot teams energy-aware planning field deployment

简要说明：本文介绍了HARP，一种模块化空地机器人平台，异构模块可物理重构以实现高效的现场作业，并在环境采样和格陵兰冰盖测试中进行了演示。

TLDR: The paper introduces HARP, a modular aerial-ground robot platform where heterogeneous modules physically reconfigure for energy-efficient field operations, demonstrated in environmental sampling and Greenland Ice Sheet tests.

Abstract: Heterogeneous robot teams distribute complementary capabilities across specialized agents, but their physical roles and capacities typically remain fixed throughout a mission. We present HARP, a Heterogeneous Aerial Robotic modules Platform in which independently deployable aerial robots physically reconfigure to compose their capabilities for field operations. HARP comprises sensor-equipped scouts, flydrive rover modules, and task-specific payload modules. Scouts map the environment and inform an energy-aware planner that jointly selects routes and air-ground mobility modes. Rover and payload modules fly independently across terrain that constrains ground travel, then autonomously assemble into a cooperative ground vehicle for energy-efficient payload transport. Motivated by environmental sampling in remote and difficult-to-traverse regions, we evaluate HARP through field experiments spanning sensing, planning, reconfiguration, airground mobility, payload transport, and task execution. We further conduct module-level deployment tests on the Greenland Ice Sheet toward future autonomous missions. HARP demonstrates how heterogeneous robot teams can adapt not only their actions, but also how their physical capabilities are composed during a mission.

摘要（中文）：异构机器人团队将互补能力分布在不同的专用智能体上，但其物理角色和功能通常在任务期间保持固定不变。我们提出了HARP——一种异构空中机器人模块化平台，其中可独立部署的空中机器人能够通过物理重构来组合各自能力，以完成现场作业。HARP由配备传感器的侦察机、飞行-行驶两用漫游车模块以及任务专用载荷模块组成。侦察机负责绘制环境地图，并为一种能量感知规划器提供信息，该规划器联合选择路径及空地移动模式。漫游车和载荷模块可独立飞越限制地面通行的地形，随后自主组装成协同工作的地面车辆，以实现节能的载荷运输。受在偏远且难以穿越地区进行环境采样需求的驱动，我们通过覆盖感知、规划、重构、空地机动、载荷运输和任务执行的现场实验对HARP进行了评估。此外，我们还在格陵兰冰盖上进行了模块级部署测试，以面向未来的自主任务。HARP展示了异构机器人团队不仅能够调整其行动，还能在任务过程中改变其物理能力的组合方式。

Authors: Li-Yu Lo, Yanbaihui Liu, Chengchuan Shu, Tyler Harris, Jonathan Ryan, Boyuan Chen

Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling Locomotion

sim-to-real transfer closed-loop system modeling meta-learning reference adaptation bipedal locomotion

简要说明：OSRAM通过仿真中的元训练和硬件上的快速微调学习机器人-策略系统的闭环动力学模型，然后在线调整参考指令以提高跟踪精度，而无需改变控制策略或识别完整物理动力学。

TLDR: OSRAM learns a closed-loop dynamics model of a robot-policy system via meta-training in simulation and rapid finetuning on hardware, then adapts reference commands online to improve tracking accuracy without changing the control policy or identifying full physical dynamics.

Abstract: Sim-to-real transfer has made substantial progress, but can still produce controllers that remain stable and functional on hardware while suffering from degraded tracking accuracy due to residual dynamics mismatch. Correcting these errors typically requires identifying the underlying system dynamics, adapting the control policy, or returning to simulation for additional training and finetuning, all of which can require substantial data and computation. We propose OSRAM (Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling), a framework that instead adapts the reference commands provided to an existing controller. OSRAM treats the deployed robot and its policy as a unified closed-loop dynamical system and learns its task-level command-response behavior directly from tracking observations. A closed-loop dynamics model is meta-trained across randomized dynamics in simulation and rapidly finetuned after deployment using limited real-world interaction. The adapted model is then used to optimize future reference commands while leaving the underlying control policy unchanged. We evaluate OSRAM on bipedal velocity tracking and loco-manipulation in simulation and on hardware. Results show that closed-loop modeling improves prediction and tracking accuracy under unseen dynamics, while online reference adaptation reduces residual sim-to-real tracking errors across different control objectives and hardware configurations. These results demonstrate that adapting the behavior of the robot-policy closed loop provides a practical alternative to finetuning the policy or identifying the full physical dynamics for sim-to-real transfer. More information can be found at http://generalroboticslab.com/OSRAM.

摘要（中文）：模拟到现实的迁移已取得实质性进展，但仍可能生成在硬件上保持稳定且功能正常的控制器，同时因残余动力学失配而出现跟踪精度下降。纠正这些误差通常需要识别底层系统动力学、调整控制策略，或返回仿真进行额外训练和微调，而这些过程均可能耗费大量数据和计算资源。我们提出OSRAM（基于闭环系统建模的在线模拟到现实自适应）框架，该框架转而调整提供给现有控制器的参考指令。OSRAM将部署的机器人及其策略视为一个统一的闭环动力学系统，并直接从跟踪观测中学习其任务级指令响应行为。该闭环动力学模型在仿真中对随机化动力学进行元训练，并在部署后通过有限的真实世界交互进行快速微调。随后，利用调整后的模型优化未来的参考指令，同时保持底层控制策略不变。我们在仿真和硬件上对双足速度跟踪及移动操作任务评估了OSRAM。结果表明，在未见动力学下，闭环建模提升了预测与跟踪精度，而在线参考指令自适应则在不同控制目标和硬件配置下减少了残余的模拟到现实跟踪误差。这些结果证明，调整机器人-策略闭环行为为微调策略或识别完整物理动力学提供了一种实用的替代方案，适用于模拟到现实的迁移。更多信息请访问 http://generalroboticslab.com/OSRAM。

Authors: Yuhao Huang, Samuel A. Moore, Boyuan Chen

An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics Locomotion

streaming deep reinforcement learning continual learning quadruped locomotion robotic manipulation plasticity loss mitigation

简要说明：本文分析了流式深度强化学习作为机器人持续学习框架的可行性，展示了在预训练后，机器人可以通过流式学习适应自身、环境或目标的意外变化，在四足运动任务上优于批量方法，在操作任务上部分有效。

TLDR: This paper analyzes streaming deep reinforcement learning as a continual learning framework for robots, showing that after pretraining, a robot can adapt to unforeseen changes in its body, environment, or goals via stream learning, outperforming batch-based methods in quadruped locomotion and partially in manipulation.

Abstract: Over the course of a lifetime, robots may encounter novel scenarios unaccounted for in its original training that result in performance degradation. One common approach to mitigating this issue is to further grow the offline training dataset in hopes of producing a policy robust to these changes. In contrast, biological learning occurs moment-to-moment via a stream of experience, unlike the predominantly batch-based and offline nature of deep learning. Although recent works show the feasibility of stream-based deep reinforcement learning, where updates use only the latest experience, none have shown it to be a viable continual learning framework for adapting robotic policies to unseen changes. In this paper, we present the first analysis of streaming deep reinforcement learning for adaptive continual learning in robotics. In particular, we show that, following an initial pretraining phase, streaming deep RL can enable a robot to successfully adapt to unforeseen changes to itself, its environment, or goals. Our primary experiments within quadruped locomotion demonstrate that a deep neural network robotic policy with certain optimizers and plasticity loss mitigation techniques can successfully leverage domain task knowledge from its pretraining to quickly adapt online to diverse changes via stream learning, outperforming batch-based on-policy methods and improving task success rates by up to 90% over the pretrained policy. Furthermore, we perform additional evaluations on robotic manipulation tasks to determine if our previous observations extend to different robotic morphologies and scenarios. Our results show that the successes observed in quadruped locomotion can be partially realized in manipulation with stability and performance limitations. We conclude with a discussion on the limitations of our work and its implications for the future of continual robot learning.

摘要（中文）：在机器人的整个生命周期中，可能会遇到其初始训练中未涵盖的新情境，从而导致性能下降。缓解这一问题的一种常见方法是进一步扩充离线训练数据集，以期生成能够应对这些变化的稳健策略。相比之下，生物学习则是通过连续的经验流即时发生，这与深度学习主要基于批量且离线的方式截然不同。尽管近期研究已表明基于流的深度强化学习（即仅使用最新经验进行更新）具有可行性，但尚无研究证明它能作为一种有效的持续学习框架，用于使机器人策略适应未知变化。本文首次对用于机器人自适应持续学习的流式深度强化学习进行了分析。特别地，我们表明，在初始预训练阶段之后，流式深度强化学习能够使机器人成功适应自身、环境或目标方面的未预见到变化。我们在四足运动方面的主要实验表明，采用特定优化器及可塑性损失缓解技术的深度神经网络机器人策略，能够有效利用预训练中的领域任务知识，通过流式学习快速在线适应多种变化，其表现优于基于批次的同策略方法，并且与预训练策略相比，任务成功率最高可提升90%。此外，我们还在机器人操作任务上进行了额外评估，以检验前述观察结果是否适用于不同的机器人形态和场景。结果表明，在四足运动中观察到的成功效果在操作任务中仅能得到部分体现，并伴随稳定性和性能方面的局限性。最后，我们讨论了本工作的局限性及其对未来机器人持续学习研究的启示。

Authors: Teeratham Vitchutripop, Alyssa Quarles, Wenhe Zhang, Richard Xue, Daniel Rakita

TAPESIM: Efficient Simulation of Adhesive Tape Dispensing for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

adhesive tape simulation robotic manipulation deformable collar releasable bonds physics simulation

简要说明：TapeSim 是一个用于机器人胶带粘贴操作的物理模拟器，通过刚性簇和可变性轴环及可选可释放粘合，高效模拟展开、释放和重新附着，相比全壳基线显著提升速度与精度。

TLDR: TapeSim is a physics simulator for adhesive tape dispensing in robotic manipulation, using a rigid cluster with a deformable collar and optional releasable bonds to efficiently model unwinding, payout, and reattachment while improving speed and accuracy over full-shell baselines.

Abstract: Applying adhesive tape to secure wire harnesses or seal packages requires robots to coordinate a flexible strip, a moving roll, and surfaces that attach and detach. Simulation could make these interactions repeatable for robot development and evaluation, but resolving every adhesive layer is expensive and can suppress roll motion at practical solver tolerances, while a permanently rigid roll cannot release material. We present TapeSim, a tape simulator that concentrates deformation near the unwinding region and along the released strip. We will release the source code. A rigid cluster represents most wound material, while an advancing deformable collar enables payout and leaves released tape flexible and reattachable. Optional releasable bonds simplify adhesive interfaces and reduce mean step times for smaller rolls. Controlled swing tests show improved roll rotation. At 32 turns, clustering gives 3.2-3.4x mean physics-step speedups at a fixed Newton tolerance and 4.5-8.4x for comparable roll motion. Across five real-motion Stick replays, the clustered variants reduce mean image-plane core-landmark error by 23-29% relative to the full-shell cohesive baseline. On 100 paired Peel cases, they improve balanced accuracy from 50% to 72.9-76.3%, with interface rankings varying across tasks. A teleoperated box-sealing sequence demonstrates attachment, dispensing, cutting, and sealing in a continuous workflow.

摘要（中文）：应用胶带固定线束或密封包装时，需要机器人协调柔性条带、移动卷筒以及可附着和分离的表面。仿真可以使这些交互对机器人开发和评估具有可重复性，但解析每一个粘合层成本高昂，并且在实际求解器容差下可能抑制卷筒运动，而永久刚性的卷筒则无法释放材料。我们提出了TapeSim，一种胶带模拟器，将变形集中在退绕区域附近以及已释放条带沿线。我们将发布源代码。一个刚性簇表示大部分卷绕材料，而一个前进的可变形套环实现放卷，并使已释放的胶带保持柔顺且可重新附着。可选的可释放粘接简化了粘合界面，并减少了较小卷筒的平均步进时间。受控摆动测试显示出改进的卷筒旋转性能。在32圈时，聚类处理在固定牛顿容差下实现了3.2-3.4倍的物理平均步进加速，在可比卷筒运动条件下实现了4.5-8.4倍的加速。在五次真实运动Stick重放中，聚类变体相对于全壳内聚基线，将图像平面核心地标误差的平均值降低了23-29%。在100组成对剥离案例中，它们将平衡准确率从50%提高到72.9-76.3%，且不同任务的界面排名各不相同。一个远程操作的封箱序列演示了在连续工作流程中的附着、出带、切割和密封操作。

Authors: Zhaofeng Luo, Xinyu Lu, jaehoon Choi, Zhehuan Chen, Trinity Chung, Xiaowen Qiu, Hugh Nicholas Perkins, Gianna Calderon, Alexis Duburcq, Sanghyun Son, Tsun-Hsuan Wang, Yi-Ling Qiao, Minchen Li

Temporal Learning for End-Effector Position Estimation under Aerodynamic Disturbances in Aerial Continuum Manipulation Manipulation

temporal learning end-effector position estimation aerial continuum manipulation aerodynamic disturbances continuous-time neural network

简要说明：本文提出使用连续时间神经网络（CfC）估计空中连续机械臂在气动扰动下的末端位置，在真实实验数据上取得了比MLP和GRU更低的RMSE。

TLDR: This paper proposes a continuous-time neural network (CfC) to estimate the end-effector position of an aerial continuum manipulator under aerodynamic disturbances, achieving lower RMSE than MLP and GRU baselines on real experimental data.

Abstract: This paper investigates temporal neural networks for \mbox{end-effector} position \mbox{estimation} of an aerial continuum manipulator (ACM) operating under aerodynamic effects induced by the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). An experimental dataset is collected under stationary (\mbox{rotor-off}) and \mbox{free-hovering} conditions across continuum robot (CR) configurations and UAV altitudes, providing \mbox{end-effector} position measurements with and without aerodynamic residuals. To establish a nominal framework, \mbox{strain-parameterized} kinematic models with progressively richer strain bases are evaluated to balance model complexity and prediction accuracy. The selected nominal model then serves as the baseline for 3D position residual estimation using a \mbox{closed-form} \mbox{continuous-time} (CfC) neural network, with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a gated recurrent unit (GRU) used for comparison. On unseen test experiments, the CfC achieves an RMSE of \(22.00\pm1.70~\mathrm{mm}\) over five random seeds, compared with \(36.38\pm3.58~\mathrm{mm}\) for the MLP and \(27.72\pm2.92~\mathrm{mm}\) for the GRU, corresponding to reductions of \(39.52\%\) and \(20.62\%\), respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of \mbox{continuous-time} learning for \mbox{end-effector} position estimation under aerodynamic disturbances relative to static and \mbox{discrete-time} learning methods.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了在空中无人机（UAV）引发的空气动力学效应作用下，用于空中连续操作臂（ACM）末端执行器位置估计的时间神经网络。在连续机器人（CR）构型和无人机高度下，分别于静止（旋翼关闭）和自由悬停条件下采集实验数据集，提供含空气动力学残差及无空气动力学残差的末端执行器位置测量。为建立标称框架，评估了应变参数化运动学模型，该模型采用逐步丰富的应变基，以平衡模型复杂度与预测精度。所选定的标称模型随后作为三维位置残差估计的基线，采用闭式连续时间（CfC）神经网络实现，并与多层感知器（MLP）和门控循环单元（GRU）进行对比。在未见测试实验中，CfC在五个随机种子上的均方根误差（RMSE）为\(22.00\pm1.70~\mathrm{mm}\)，而MLP为\(36.38\pm3.58~\mathrm{mm}\)，GRU为\(27.72\pm2.92~\mathrm{mm}\)，分别降低了\(39.52\%\)和\(20.62\%\)。这些结果表明，与静态和离散时间学习方法相比，连续时间学习在空气动力学扰动下的末端执行器位置估计中具有有效性。

Authors: Niloufar Amiri, Houman Masnavi, Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi

SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection AutonomousDriving

robust 3D object detection camera-LiDAR fusion scene-aware routing query-wise branch routing autonomous driving

简要说明：SARFusion提出了一种场景感知的路由融合机制，用于鲁棒的相机-激光雷达三维目标检测，将目标查询解码解耦为相机、激光雷达和融合三个并行分支，并根据全局场景可靠性和对象级证据为每个查询路由到最合适的分支，从而在传感器损坏等条件下减轻跨模态干扰。

TLDR: SARFusion proposes a scene-aware branch routing mechanism for robust camera-LiDAR 3D object detection, decoupling object-query decoding into camera, LiDAR, and fusion branches and routing each query based on global scene reliability and object-level evidence to mitigate cross-modal interference under corruptions.

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR fusion has become a prevailing paradigm for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. However, existing fusion detectors often establish strong inter-modality dependencies by decoding object queries from tightly coupled multimodal representations. Under corrupted driving conditions, such dependencies make the detector vulnerable to unreliable modalities, where degraded observations may interfere with reliable modality-specific evidence and lead to suboptimal predictions. Moreover, modality reliability can vary across both global driving scenes and individual object queries, requiring adaptive fusion decisions at a finer granularity. To bridge this gap, we reformulate robust camera-LiDAR fusion as a scene-aware branch routing problem and propose SARFusion, a robust 3D object detector. Instead of producing detections from a single fused representation, SARFusion decouples object-query decoding into three parallel reasoning branches: a camera branch, a LiDAR branch, and a camera-LiDAR fusion branch. Guided by a Scene Reliability Prior estimated from the global driving context, SARFusion further incorporates object-level evidence to route each query to the most suitable branch. This query-wise routing strategy alleviates harmful cross-modal interference while preserving the benefits of multimodal fusion when complementary cues are trustworthy. On the nuScenes test set, SARFusion achieves strong performance with 72.5 mAP and 74.4 NDS. Extensive analyses demonstrate its robustness under challenging conditions, including sensor corruptions and environmental changes.

摘要（中文）：相机-激光雷达融合已成为自动驾驶中三维目标检测的主流范式。然而，现有的融合检测器通常通过从紧密耦合的多模态表示中解码目标查询来建立模态间的强依赖关系。在退化的驾驶条件下，这种依赖关系使检测器容易受到不可靠模态的影响，其中退化的观测可能会干扰可靠的模态特定证据，导致次优的预测结果。此外，模态可靠性可能在全球驾驶场景和单个目标查询之间均存在差异，这要求以更细粒度进行自适应融合决策。为弥合这一差距，我们将鲁棒的相机-激光雷达融合重新构建为场景感知分支路由问题，并提出了SARFusion，一种鲁棒的三维目标检测器。SARFusion并非从单一的融合表示中生成检测结果，而是将目标查询解码解耦为三个并行推理分支：相机分支、激光雷达分支以及相机-激光雷达融合分支。在从全局驾驶上下文估计的场景可靠性先验的引导下，SARFusion进一步结合目标级证据，将每个查询路由到最合适的分支。这种逐查询路由策略减轻了有害的跨模态干扰，同时在互补线索可信时保留了多模态融合的益处。在nuScenes测试集上，SARFusion取得了72.5 mAP和74.4 NDS的强劲性能。大量分析表明，其在传感器损坏和环境变化等挑战性条件下具有良好的鲁棒性。

Authors: Yuting Zhao, Ziyi Zheng, Shuxiao Li

Training Object Permanence in World Models WorldModel

object permanence video generation world model cognitive science Blender dataset

简要说明：本文提出了WROP，一个基于认知科学的大规模Blender生成视频数据集，并训练了16B视频世界模型PWM-WROP，在300题考试中展示了改进的物体持久性推理能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces WROP, a large-scale cognitive-science-inspired dataset with Blender-generated videos, and trains a 16B video world model (PWM-WROP) showing improved object permanence reasoning, evaluated on a 300-question exam.

Abstract: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of 150 hand-designed cognitive science inspired tasks, divided into six cognitive categories. We build Blender generators that randomize speed, lighting, camera angle, and other nuisance parameters while preserving each task's cognitive structure, yielding 10,000+ samples per task. We release a 1.5M-sample training corpus and a 300-question exam. On this exam we evaluate 14 video models: 3 reference-to-video, 7 edit, and 4 continuation, among which PWM-WROP, our 16B world model. In a blind pairwise Elo study, PWM-WROP ranks first among continuation models and third overall, behind only a statistical tie between two reference-to-video models. We release the data, exam, model answers, scores, weights, and PWM, our native-PyTorch training stack on AWS Trainium2.

摘要（中文）：物体恒存性与固态性是人类认知先验的标志性特征。近期研究表明，视频生成模型作为当前世界模型的一类典型代表，已开始展现出涌现性的推理能力，使其成为构建类人物理智能的理想候选。视频模型是否具备涌现的物体恒存性？若不具备，我们能否借助受核心认知启发的数据集对其进行训练？我们提出WROP（基于物体恒存性的世界推理），这是一个包含150项手工设计、受认知科学启发的任务的数据基础设施，分为六个认知类别。我们构建了Blender生成器，在保持每项任务认知结构的同时，对速度、光照、相机角度及其他干扰参数进行随机化处理，每项任务生成10,000个以上样本。我们发布了一个包含150万样本的训练语料库和一套包含300道考题的测试集。在该测试中，我们评估了14个视频模型：3个参考到视频模型、7个编辑模型和4个续写模型，其中包含PWM-WROP——我们16B参数规模的世界模型。在一项盲法配对Elo研究中，PWM-WROP在续写模型中排名第一，整体排名第三，仅次于两个参考到视频模型之间的统计并列。我们发布了数据、测试集、模型答案、得分、权重，以及PWM——我们在AWS Trainium2上基于原生PyTorch的训练栈。

Authors: Haotian Zhang, Fengyuan Yu, Dezhi Luo, Haoran Sun, Zehong Zhao, Qingying Gao, Yihan Li, Siyuan An, Huayi Qin, Yilan Zhang, Zhengze Jiang, Pinyuan Feng, Renrui Zhang, Ziyu Guo, Letian Wang, Mengyue Yang, Kangfu Mei, Maijunxian Wang, Ran Ji, Vikash Kumar, Freda Shi, Chandra Sripada, Vincent C. Muller, Philip Torr, Alan Yuille, Nikolaus Kriegeskorte, Felix Juefei-Xu, Lvmin Zhang, Jieneng Chen, Yilun Du, Hokin Deng

Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems Other

task and motion planning coding agents program synthesis generalization simulator interaction

简要说明：本文评估了编码代理（Claude Code, Codex）在广义任务与运动规划（TAMP）问题上的表现，表明它们能够合成程序，在28个环境中优于手工规划器和基线，以更少的计算保持高成功率。

TLDR: This paper evaluates coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) on generalized task and motion planning (TAMP) problems, showing they can synthesize programs that outperform hand-engineered planners and baselines across 28 environments, maintaining high success with lower computation.

Abstract: Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. Generalized TAMP addresses this difficulty by exploiting regularities across problem instances to reduce planning effort on new instances. However, existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this process by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances. Given a task description and simulator access, each agent chooses how to interact with the environment while developing a program within a fixed synthesis budget. The program is then frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. We evaluate Claude Code (Opus 5) and Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) on 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream, with object counts beyond those evaluated in the original benchmark. Across all program synthesis methods, we evaluate 980 generated programs on 100 held-out instances each, 98,000 evaluation episodes in total. Overall, we find that coding agents are surprisingly effective at generalized TAMP: all three agent configurations outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline in mean success (56% to 95% versus 47% for the planners, on the 16 environments where a planner is available). As object counts grow, the agents' programs maintain higher success than the planner, using an order of magnitude less computation per instance on average. Logs show agents using interaction to calibrate physical models, test edge cases, and refine strategies. We release all code, including the full prompts given to the agents. These findings suggest that coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.

摘要（中文）：任务与运动规划（TAMP）问题即使在完全可观测且以对象为中心的状态下仍然具有较高的难度，这是因为离散决策与几何、运动学和动力学约束紧密耦合。广义TAMP通过利用问题实例之间的规律性来减少新实例上的规划成本，从而应对这一挑战。然而，现有方法需要大量针对TAMP的专门工程实现。本文研究编码智能体是否能够通过合成跨实例泛化的程序来自动化这一过程。在给定任务描述和模拟器访问权限的情况下，每个智能体在固定的合成预算内选择如何与环境交互，同时开发程序。该程序随后被冻结，并在未见过的实例上进行评估。我们在来自KinDER和PDDLStream的28个模拟环境中评估了Claude Code（Opus 5）和Codex（GPT-5.6 Sol和GPT-6 Astra），其中对象数量超出了原始基准测试中的范围。在所有程序合成方法中，我们共评估了980个生成程序，每个程序在100个保留实例上进行测试，总计98,000个评估回合。总体而言，我们发现编码智能体在广义TAMP中表现出令人惊讶的有效性：在可获得规划器的16个环境中，所有三种智能体配置在平均成功率上均优于手工设计的规划器、一次性生成方法以及基于LLM的广义规划基线（智能体为56%至95%，而规划器为47%）。随着对象数量的增加，智能体生成的程序相较于规划器保持了更高的成功率，且每个实例的平均计算量低一个数量级。日志显示，智能体利用交互来校准物理模型、测试边界情况并优化策略。我们发布了所有代码，包括提供给智能体的完整提示词。这些发现表明，编码智能体是广义TAMP的一个强基线方法。

Authors: Matteo Merler, Bowen Li, Josh Roy, Yichao Liang, Qianwei Wang, Yixuan Huang, Tom Silver

M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis Perception3D

novel view synthesis Camera-LiDAR multimodal flow-matching robotic novel view synthesis metric 3D structure

简要说明：M3GD 提出了一种用于生成式新视角合成的相机-激光雷达多模态表示，通过视图对齐的数据包和残差适配器结合冻结的图像与点云基础模型，提升了机器人的 RGB 和深度合成质量。

TLDR: M3GD introduces a multimodal Camera-LiDAR representation for generative novel view synthesis, combining frozen image and point-cloud foundation models via view-aligned packets and a residual adapter, improving RGB and depth synthesis for robotic platforms.

Abstract: Robotic novel view synthesis (NVS) must recover both visual appearance and metric 3D structure, yet most generative NVS methods rely only on images, overlooking LiDAR, a complementary sensor common on robotic platforms. We present M3GD, a Camera--LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS that composes independently pretrained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator. We show that, after camera projection, frozen LiDAR and image features exhibit substantial shared spatial structure, providing a natural cross-modal representation. M3GD conditions generation on LiDAR through this structure: it combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud descriptors into view-aligned packets on the image-latent grid, injected through a lightweight residual adapter into a multi-view flow-matching generator whose latent space, decoders, and training objective remain intact. On the GrandTour dataset, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone. Ablations show that the gains come from pixel-aligned LiDAR content and that target-view LiDAR acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to source observations. Deployment on a ground robot demonstrates practical real-world operation, with a configurable quality--cost trade-off controlled by the number of Euler integration steps.

摘要（中文）：机器人新颖视图合成(NVS)必须同时恢复视觉外观和度量三维结构，然而大多数生成式NVS方法仅依赖图像，忽视了LiDAR——机器人平台上常见的一种互补传感器。我们提出M3GD，一种用于生成式NVS的相机-LiDAR多模态表示方法，该方法组合独立预训练的2D图像和3D点云基础模型，无需单独训练跨模态转换器。我们表明，经过相机投影后，冻结的LiDAR和图像特征展现出显著的共享空间结构，提供了一种天然的跨模态表示。M3GD通过这种结构将LiDAR条件化到生成过程中：它将显式几何统计量与学习的点云描述符组合，形成图像潜在网格上的视图对齐数据包，通过轻量级残差适配器注入多视图流匹配生成器，而该生成器的潜在空间、解码器和训练目标均保持完整。在GrandTour数据集上，M3GD在目标视图RGB和深度合成方面相较于同一骨干网络的仅图像版本有所提升。消融实验表明，性能提升源自像素对齐的LiDAR内容，且目标视图LiDAR作为几何查询，将请求的视图与源观测联系起来。在地面机器人上的部署验证了实际场景中的可操作性，并可通过控制欧拉积分步数实现可配置的质量-成本权衡。

Authors: Yang Zhou, Jiuhong Xiao, Shizhao Ye, Long Quang, Carlos Nieto-Granda, Giuseppe Loianno

Markerless Multi-Modal Autonomous Robotic Inspection of Large Space Structures Manipulation

autonomous inspection markerless 3D reconstruction multimodal sensing neural radiance fields

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于大型空间结构的无标记自主机器人检测流程，集成了Kinova机械臂与多模态传感以及神经辐射场进行3D重建和热感知渲染，并在仿真和初步实验室测试中进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper presents a markerless autonomous robotic inspection pipeline for large space structures, integrating a Kinova arm with multimodal sensing and neural radiance fields for 3D reconstruction and thermal-aware rendering, demonstrated in simulation and preliminary lab tests.

Abstract: Future orbital infrastructures, such as deployable antennas, solar farms, and large orbital platforms will require autonomous inspection systems able to operate with limited prior knowledge and without cooperative markers. Current on-orbit servicing approaches often rely on predefined trajectories, standard interfaces, fiducial markers or accurate target models, which limits scalability for large, heterogeneous or partially unknown structures. This paper presents a markerless autonomous robotic inspection pipeline in which 3D reconstruction is used as an inspection-support representation. The system integrates a Kinova Gen2 manipulator with an end-effector-mounted multimodal sensor head composed of an RGB-D camera, a thermal camera and a 2D LiDAR. The pipeline estimates an approximate inspection volume, generates viewpoints, plans collision-free motions with MoveIt, and synchronously records RGB-D images, thermal data, and robot poses in ROS2. Candidate reconstruction methods were evaluated to select a practical method for this pipeline, with Nerfacto used for geometric reconstruction and Thermal-Nerfacto used to demonstrate thermal-aware rendering for inspection. Validation in a Gazebo-based simulator and preliminary laboratory tests reveal that the proposed system can autonomously acquire spatially coherent inspection data and produce reconstructions suitable for visual and geometric assessment, representing a step towards inspection of large non-cooperative space structures.

摘要（中文）：未来轨道基础设施，如可展开天线、太阳能电站及大型轨道平台，将需要能够在先验知识有限且无合作标志物条件下运行的自主检测系统。当前的在轨服务方法往往依赖于预定义轨迹、标准接口、基准标记或精确的目标模型，这限制了其在大型、异构或部分未知结构上的可扩展性。本文提出了一种无标记自主机器人检测流程，其中三维重建被用作检测支持的表示形式。该系统集成了Kinova Gen2机械臂与安装于末端执行器的多模态传感器头，该传感器头由RGB-D相机、热成像相机和二维激光雷达组成。该流程估算近似检测体积，生成视点，利用MoveIt规划无碰撞运动，并在ROS2中同步记录RGB-D图像、热成像数据及机器人位姿。为选择适用于该流程的实用方法，对候选重建方法进行了评估，其中Nerfacto用于几何重建，Thermal-Nerfacto用于展示面向检测的热感知渲染。基于Gazebo仿真器的验证及初步实验室测试表明，所提系统能够自主获取空间一致的检测数据，并生成适用于视觉与几何评估的重建结果，这标志着向大型非合作空间结构检测迈出了一步。

Authors: Juan De Dios Alfaro, Arturo Ríos, David Rodríguez-Martínez, Carlos Pérez-del-Pulgar

Temperament Engineering: Designing Strategic Behavioural Diversity in Robot Swarms Other

robot swarms behavioral diversity temperament multi-agent reinforcement learning heterogeneity

简要说明：这篇观点论文提出了“气质工程”，一个受生物启发的框架，通过将气质参数的分布作为设计对象来设计机器人群体的行为多样性，适用于去中心化的群体控制。

TLDR: This perspective paper proposes 'temperament engineering', a bio-inspired framework for designing behavioral diversity in robot swarms by treating the distribution of temperament parameters as the design object, with applications in decentralized swarm control.

Abstract: No two robots are truly identical: calibration, battery state, sensor drift and wear give every swarm a distribution of behaviour rather than a single point, usually treated as an imperfection to be minimised. In animal collectives the reverse holds: consistent individual differences in behaviour ('temperament') are shaped by natural selection and often decisive for group performance. This perspective proposes 'temperament engineering', a bio-inspired framework that treats the swarm's distribution of temperaments, rather than the individual controller, as the design object. It borrows five evolutionarily validated axes of animal temperament (shyness-boldness, exploration-avoidance, activity, aggressiveness and sociability) as a design vocabulary, rendering each as a continuous control parameter $τ\in [0,1]$ above the controller, realisable as a module threshold, a policy-conditioning vector in multi-agent reinforcement learning, or a constraint on a foundation-model planner. A three-phase workflow maps mission success criteria onto relevant axes, plans the shape of the $τ$ distribution, and tunes reaction norms governing how temperament responds to environmental cues. The payoff is greatest under decentralisation: where a central planner can reassign behaviour online, a temperament distribution is a planner output, but in a swarm without global knowledge it must be an offline, anticipatory design input. Behavioural and platform heterogeneity are thereby co-design variables, and I sketch tentative robot-native axes (self-model plasticity, forcefulness, initiative and expressiveness) arising from features robots have and animals do not. Engineered heterogeneity has been shown to outperform homogeneous swarms in tasks such as aggregation and exploration; establishing when, and how much, heterogeneity repays its cost is the work the field can now take forward.

摘要（中文）：没有两个机器人是完全相同的：校准误差、电池状态、传感器漂移和磨损使得每个群体都呈现出一系列行为分布，而非单一行为点，这些差异通常被视为需要最小化的缺陷。而在动物群体中，情况恰恰相反：行为上一致的个体差异（即“气质”）是由自然选择塑造的，且常常对群体表现起决定性作用。本文提出“气质工程”这一视角，它是一个受生物启发的框架，将群体的气质分布——而非单个控制器——作为设计对象。该框架借鉴了动物气质的五个经过进化验证的维度（羞怯-大胆、探索-回避、活动性、攻击性和社交性）作为设计词汇，将每个维度表示为控制器之上的连续控制参数 τ∈[0,1]，可通过模块阈值、多智能体强化学习中的策略条件向量，或对基础模型规划器的约束来实现。一个三阶段工作流程将任务成功标准映射到相关维度，规划 τ 分布的形状，并调整控制气质对环境线索响应的反应规范。该框架在去中心化条件下收益最大：当中央规划器可以在线重新分配行为时，气质分布只是规划器的输出；但在缺乏全局知识的群体中，气质分布必须作为离线、预前性的设计输入。由此，行为异构性和平台异构性成为协同设计变量，本文还初步提出了源于机器人独有而动物不具备的特征的机器人本征维度（自我模型可塑性、力度、主动性和表现力）。已有研究表明，在聚集和探索等任务中，工程化异构群体优于同质群体；确定异构性在何种条件下、以何种程度能够收回其成本，是该领域可以进一步推进的工作。

Authors: Edmund R. Hunt

Free-Init: Scan-Free, Motion-Free, and Correspondence-Free Initialization for Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Systems Other

Doppler LiDAR LiDAR-inertial system initialization Doppler-inertial velocimeter FMCW

简要说明：本文提出了Free-Init，一种用于多普勒激光雷达-惯性系统的快速初始化框架，无需扫描去畸变、激励运动和地图对应，即可在多种运动场景中实现高频且鲁棒的初始化。

TLDR: This paper presents Free-Init, a fast initialization framework for Doppler LiDAR-inertial systems that eliminates the need for scan undistortion, excitation motions, and map correspondences, achieving high-frequency and resilient initialization across diverse motion scenarios.

Abstract: Robust initialization is crucial for online systems. In the letter, a high-frequency and resilient initialization framework is designed for LiDAR-inertial systems, leveraging both inertial sensors and Doppler LiDAR. The innovative FMCW Doppler LiDAR opens up a novel avenue for robotic sensing by capturing not only point range but also Doppler velocity via the intrinsic Doppler effect. By fusing point-wise Doppler velocity with inertial measurements under non-inertial kinematics, the proposed framework, Free-Init, eliminates reliance on motion undistortion of LiDAR scans, excitation motions, and map correspondences during the initialization phase. Free-Init is also plug-and-play compatible with typical LiDAR-inertial systems and is versatile to handle a wide range of initial motions when the system starts, including stationary, dynamic, and even violent motions. The embedded Doppler-inertial velocimeter ensures fast convergence and high-frequency performance, delivering outputs exceeding 10 kHz. Comprehensive experiments on diverse platforms and across myriad motion scenes validate the framework's effectiveness. The results demonstrate the superior performance of Free-Init, highlighting the necessity of fast, resilient, and dynamic initialization for online systems.

摘要（中文）：稳健的初始化对于在线系统至关重要。本文针对激光雷达-惯性系统设计了一种高频且具有鲁棒性的初始化框架，该框架同时利用惯性传感器与多普勒激光雷达。创新的FMCW多普勒激光雷达通过内在的多普勒效应，不仅能够获取点的距离信息，还能捕捉多普勒速度，为机器人感知开辟了新途径。通过将逐点多普勒速度与惯性测量在非惯性运动学下进行融合，所提出的Free-Init框架在初始化阶段无需依赖激光雷达扫描的运动畸变校正、激励运动以及地图对应关系。Free-Init同样具备即插即用的特性，兼容典型的激光雷达-惯性系统，并能灵活应对系统启动时的各种初始运动状态，包括静止、动态乃至剧烈运动。内嵌的多普勒-惯性测速仪确保了快速收敛与高频性能，输出频率超过10 kHz。在多种平台及众多运动场景下的综合实验验证了该框架的有效性。结果表明Free-Init性能优越，凸显了在线系统对快速、稳健且动态初始化的迫切需求。

Authors: Mingle Zhao, Jiahao Wang, Tianxiao Gao, Chengzhong Xu, Hui Kong

FMCW-LIO: A Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Odometry Perception3D

FMCW Doppler LiDAR LiDAR-inertial odometry Doppler-aided state estimation motion compensation dynamic point removal

简要说明：FMCW-LIO 利用FMCW激光雷达的多普勒速度测量来提高状态估计、动态点去除和建图鲁棒性，尤其在结构退化环境中。

TLDR: FMCW-LIO is a LiDAR-inertial odometry method that exploits Doppler velocity measurements from FMCW LiDAR to improve state estimation, dynamic point removal, and mapping robustness, especially in structure-degenerated environments.

Abstract: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose FMCW-LIO, a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs. To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations. FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.

摘要（中文）：传统的激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）或同时定位与建图（SLAM）方法严重依赖环境的几何特征，因为激光雷达主要提供距离测量而非运动测量。然而，随着新型调频连续波（FMCW）多普勒激光雷达的出现，这一局面发生了变化。FMCW多普勒激光雷达不仅提供高分辨率的点距离信息，还能通过多普勒效应获取瞬时的点多普勒速度。本文提出FMCW-LIO，一种新颖且鲁棒的LIO方法，利用FMCW多普勒激光雷达固有的多普勒测量。为了正确利用多普勒速度，设计了一种运动补偿方法，并采用多普勒辅助观测模型进行流形上的状态估计。随后，通过多普勒准则有效移除动态点，从而获得更一致的几何观测。即使在结构退化的环境中，FMCW-LIO也能实现精确的状态估计和静态建图。在多种场景下进行了大量实验，FMCW-LIO在精度和鲁棒性方面均优于其他算法。

Authors: Mingle Zhao, Jiahao Wang, Tianxiao Gao, Chengzhong Xu, Hui Kong

Dense-Joint-Based Obstacle-Aided Locomotion with a Joint-Repositionable Snake Robot Locomotion

snake robot obstacle-aided locomotion joint density joint-repositionable propulsion

简要说明：本文利用可重构关节的蛇形机器人，研究了关节密度对障碍辅助运动性能的影响，结果表明高关节密度可抑制反应力突变、降低功耗并实现稳定连续推进。

TLDR: This paper investigates the effect of joint density on obstacle-aided locomotion in snake robots using a joint-repositionable mechanism, showing that higher joint density improves stability, reduces power consumption, and enables continuous propulsion in complex environments.

Abstract: Obstacle-aided locomotion is a fundamental capability for snake robots to traverse complex environments. However, conventional rigid-link snake robots often suffer from stagnation or jamming caused by their low joint density (i.e., the number of joints per unit length). This results in discontinuous contact with obstacles, unlike the continuous adaptation of biological snakes. To investigate the effect of joint density on obstacle-aided locomotion performance, we utilized a joint-repositionable snake robot mechanism that decouples actuators from joints, enabling a high-density architecture. We developed two experimental models with identical total lengths but different joint densities (high-density and low-density) and conducted comparative propulsion experiments in obstacle environments with varying obstacle diameters. The experimental results demonstrate that the high-density model substantially suppresses the abrupt shifts in reaction forces that cause stagnation in the low-density model. By maintaining smooth contact points, the high-density configuration reduces power consumption and achieves stable, continuous propulsion. These results highlight high joint density as a key factor in improving the environmental adaptability of snake robots in complex terrains.

摘要（中文）：障碍辅助 locomotion 是蛇形机器人穿越复杂环境的基本能力。然而，传统刚性连杆蛇形机器人常因关节密度较低（即单位长度内的关节数量较少）而陷入停滞或卡阻。这导致其与障碍物的接触不连续，与生物蛇的连续适应性形成对比。为研究关节密度对障碍辅助运动性能的影响，我们采用了一种关节可重定位的蛇形机器人机构，该机构将驱动器与关节解耦，从而实现高密度架构。我们构建了两个总长度相同但关节密度不同的实验模型（高密度与低密度），并在不同障碍物直径的障碍环境中进行了对比推进实验。实验结果表明，高密度模型显著抑制了低密度模型中导致停滞的反作用力突变。通过维持平滑的接触点，高密度配置降低了功耗，并实现了稳定、连续的推进。这些结果突显了高关节密度是提升蛇形机器人在复杂地形中环境适应性的关键因素。

Authors: Kyosuke Minomo, Ryo Takahashi, Kotaro Yasui, Yasutaka Nakashima, Motoji Yamamoto, Ayato Kanada

UpDown-SC: Gravity-Canonicalized Dual-Envelope Scan Context for Indoor LiDAR Place Recognition Perception3D

LiDAR place recognition polar descriptor gravity canonicalization indoor robot localization loop closure

简要说明：本文提出UpDown-SC，一种无需训练的LiDAR位置识别描述符，通过重力规范化并同时表示上下几何包络，提升室内跨姿态和安装高度变化的检索鲁棒性，支持可靠的闭环和定位。

TLDR: This paper introduces UpDown-SC, a training-free LiDAR place recognition descriptor that canonicalizes gravity and represents both upper and lower geometry envelopes to improve indoor retrieval robustness across attitude and mounting-height changes, demonstrating reliable loop closure and localization support.

Abstract: LiDAR place recognition is a key front end for loop closure and global relocalization, yet indoor retrieval remains difficult when attitude or sensor mounting height changes between mapping and query sessions. Scan Context stores the maximum height in each polar cell; indoors, broad ceilings can suppress the lower and mid-level geometry that distinguishes adjacent rooms and corridors. We present UpDown-SC, a training-free polar descriptor that first canonicalizes gravity and then represents two complementary surfaces: the upper envelope of lower/middle structures and the lower envelope of overhead structures. Their physical split is estimated once from a cell-balanced map height distribution and reused by every query. A mask-aware, non-uniform two-channel distance retains discriminative lower-level evidence while limiting sensitivity to its cross-session variation, without treating unobserved cells as zero-height measurements. Conventional Scan Context shortlisting and circular yaw alignment are retained, so retrieved hypotheses directly initialize geometric verification. Experiments across repeated indoor sessions, mounting-height changes, mixed outdoor-to-indoor trajectories, and an outdoor transfer sequence show more reliable first-choice retrieval on the indoor and mounting-height-varied sessions. A paired test finds a significant gain over Scan Context on the in-house sessions. UpDown-SC also gives the best or second-best F1max and AUPR under threshold-based acceptance while retaining a lightweight CPU front end. Continuous replay confirms that the retrieved hypotheses support metric prior-map localization. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达地点识别是回环检测和全局重定位的关键前端，然而在测绘与查询阶段之间姿态或传感器安装高度发生变化时，室内检索仍然具有较大难度。Scan Context在每个极坐标单元中存储最大高度；在室内，宽阔的天花板可能压制用于区分相邻房间和走廊的低层及中层几何信息。我们提出了UpDown-SC，这是一种无需训练训练的极坐标描述子，首先对重力方向进行归一化，然后表示两个互补的表面：低层/中层结构的上包络和顶部结构的下包络。两者的物理分界通过一次基于单元均衡的地图高度分布估算得到，并被所有查询复用。一种掩码感知的非均匀双通道距离保留判别性的低层证据，同时限制其对跨会话变化的敏感度，而不会将未观测到的单元视为零高度测量值。保留传统的Scan Context候选筛选和圆周偏航对齐，检索到的假设可直接用于几何验证的初始化。在重复室内会话、安装高度变化、室外到室内混合轨迹以及室外迁移序列上的实验表明，在室内和安装高度变化的会话中，首选项检索更为可靠。配对检验显示，在自有数据集会话上相较Scan Context有显著提升。在基于阈值的接受准则下，UpDown-SC同时取得最优或次优的F1最大值和AUPR，同时保持轻量级的CPU前端。连续回放实验证实，检索到的假设能够支持基于度量的先验地图定位。代码与评估材料：https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc。

Authors: Jie Xu, Yongxin Yang, Ziyi Jin, Kangjin Yu, Hongjun Huang, Chao Han, Zhongpu Xia

TRACE: Interactive Bi-Directional Tracing of Monochrome Cables Amid Clutter Perception3D

Deformable Linear Objects cable tracing interactive perception clutter state estimation

简要说明：TRACE提出了一种交互式双向追踪方法，用于杂乱环境中单色线缆的状态估计，结合发散推挤和簇扩张原语，将准确率从约60%提升至约90%，并通过110项物理实验验证。

TLDR: TRACE presents an interactive bi-directional tracing method for monochrome cables in clutter, integrating divergence push and cluster dilation primitives to improve state estimation accuracy from ~60% to ~90% over prior methods, validated with 110 physical experiments.

Abstract: Accurate state estimation (tracing) of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) such as cables is a critical challenge for data centers, manufacturing, construction, homes, and surgery, where precise cable management directly impacts operational safety and efficiency. However, resolving the state of multiple monochrome cables amid foreground and background clutter poses challenges due to occlusions, overlap, and ambiguous crossings. We present Two-way Routing And Cable Estimation (TRACE), which combines bi-directional cable tracing with interactive perception primitives-Divergence Push and Cluster Dilation-to actively resolve ambiguities. Evaluation with 110 physical experiments suggests that TRACE can increase the percentage of cable length correctly traced in complex scenarios (with up to 4 cables and 40 crossings) from ~60% with the strongest prior method, HANDLOOM 2.0, to ~90%, outperforming RT-DLO, Nano Banana Pro, and ChatGPT 5.2 as well. For a trial run on a workstation with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU, the average computation time is 0.4 seconds per cable. Project website: https://trace-paper.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：对可变形线性物体（DLOs）如线缆的精确状态估计（追踪）是数据中心、制造业、建筑业、家庭及外科手术领域面临的关键挑战，在这些场景中，线缆的精准管理直接影响操作安全与效率。然而，在前景和背景杂乱的环境中解析多根单色线缆的状态，因遮挡、重叠及模糊交叉而颇具难度。我们提出了双向路由与线缆估计（TRACE）方法，该方法将双向线缆追踪与交互式感知基元——发散推挤与簇扩张——相结合，以主动消解歧义。基于110次物理实验的评估表明，TRACE能将复杂场景（含多达4根线缆和40个交叉点）中正确追踪的线缆长度比例从最强已有方法HANDLOOM 2.0的约60%提升至约90%，同时亦优于RT-DLO、Nano Banana Pro和ChatGPT 5.2。在配备NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU的工作站上进行试运行时，每根线缆的平均计算时间为0.4秒。项目网站：https://trace-paper.github.io/。

Authors: Nidhya Shivakumar, Ethan Ransing, Josh Zhang, Shamak Gowda, Kevin Yang, Miles Hua, Anika Agrawal, Justin Yu, Ken Goldberg

AquaMend: Minimal Re-probing and Conditional Rollback for Latent-Belief Failures in Embodied Agents Other

latent-belief failures re-probing rollback decision-theoretic troubleshooting embodied agents

简要说明：AquaMend 提出了一种在具身智能体中检测和恢复潜在信念失败的方法，通过比较重新探测、回滚和继续执行策略，在模拟基准测试中相比重启策略提高了恢复率。

TLDR: AquaMend introduces a method for detecting and recovering from latent-belief failures in embodied agents by comparing re-probing, rollback, and continuation strategies using a decision-theoretic framework, demonstrating improved recovery rates over restart in a simulated benchmark.

Abstract: Physical changes or sensing errors can invalidate embodied agents' task-relevant beliefs. AquaMend compares re-probing, rollback, and supported continuation on a probe-belief-action graph under an expected-loss objective covering sensing, physical recovery, and uncorrected failures. A joint posterior guides a one-step policy with conditional detection-power screening. The per-belief three-way optimum requires independence, separability, and fully resolving probes; the general policy has no global optimality guarantee. Across 32 paired scenarios in a self-constructed simulation benchmark, AquaMend recovers in 28/32 cases and reduces mean complete loss by 21.6% versus restart. Its paired loss difference from decision-theoretic troubleshooting (DTT) is not statistically significant after Holm correction. Against the all-candidate ablation, online decision time decreases by 12.3% overall but increases by 3.4% in the uncovered late stage.

摘要（中文）：物理变化或感知误差可能导致具身智能体与任务相关的信念失效。AquaMend在预期损失目标下，对探测-信念-行动图上的重新探测、回滚及受支持的继续执行三种策略进行了比较，该目标涵盖感知、物理恢复及未纠正的失败。联合后验指导单步策略，并辅以条件性检测效能筛选。逐信念的三路最优性要求独立性、可分离性及完全解析探测；一般策略不保证全局最优。在自建仿真基准的32个配对场景中，AquaMend在28/32个案例中实现恢复，并将平均总损失较重启策略降低21.6%。经Holm校正后，其与决策理论故障排除（DTT）在配对损失差异上无统计学显著性。与全候选消融相比，在线决策时间总体减少12.3%，但在未覆盖的后期阶段增加3.4%。

Authors: Yufan Liu, Shang Luo, Yang Liu, Haoxuan Jia, Feiyu Han, Qian Li, Chen Li, Yingguang Yang, Chongyang Zhang, Hao Zheng, Kefu Xu, Bin Chong

Robots That Take Initiative: A Framework for Building and Evaluating Proactive Robots Other

proactive assistance closed-loop evaluation goal anticipation learning from observation human-robot interaction

简要说明：本文提出了主动机器人辅助的统一形式化框架、带自适应人类模型的闭环评估框架，以及一种从被动观察中学习以预测并实现用户目标的方法GAP，在先前方法失败的场景下表现出鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a unified formalism for proactive robot assistance, a closed-loop evaluation framework with an adaptive human model, and a method (GAP) that learns from passive observation to anticipate and act on user goals, demonstrating robustness where prior methods fail.

Abstract: Effective robot assistance beyond narrow roles and repetitive tasks requires robots to be proactive - to decide what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told. While proactivity is increasingly explored, it lacks a unified formulation, and work in the domain is typically evaluated offline against static human models that cannot capture the effect of a robot's actions on the environment and the user's own behavior. We introduce a unified formalism for proactive robot assistance, organize it into three levels, and provide a framework to address the highest level of unprompted proactive assistance. We then show that offline evaluation overstates performance in this setting, and contribute a closed-loop evaluation with a human model that adapts to the robot. Finally, we present a method, GAP, that instantiates our framework, learning from passive observation to anticipate user goals and act. Under closed-loop evaluation, prior state-of-the-art methods collapse, in some cases adding more work than they save, while GAP remains robust and substantially outperforms them.

摘要（中文）：摘要：超越狭窄角色和重复性任务的有效机器人辅助，要求机器人具备主动性——即能够自主决定需要做什么，而非被动等待指令。尽管主动性正受到越来越多的探索，但目前缺乏统一的表述框架，且该领域的研究通常基于静态人类模型进行离线评估，无法捕捉机器人行为对环境及用户自身行为的动态影响。我们提出了一种统一的主动性机器人辅助形式化体系，将其划分为三个层级，并构建了一个针对最高层级——即无提示主动辅助——的解决框架。随后，我们论证了离线评估在该情境下会高估性能，并提出了一种结合自适应人类模型的闭环评估方法。最后，我们介绍了一种名为GAP的方法，该方法实现了我们的框架，通过被动观察学习来预测用户目标并采取行动。在闭环评估下，先前的最先进方法性能崩溃，在某些情况下反而增加了用户负担而非节省工作量，而GAP则保持稳健，并显著超越这些方法。

Authors: Maithili Patel, Sonia Chernova

Human-in-the-Loop Geospatial Annotation for Rapid Dataset Construction in Field-Deployed UAV Systems Perception3D

human-in-the-loop annotation UAV imagery RTK positioning projective geometry sensor design

简要说明：BirdsEye是一种用于无人机现场图像的人机协同地理空间标注系统，通过RTK定位将世界坐标标签投影到图像上，从而在农业机器人应用中快速构建训练感知模型所需的数据集。

TLDR: BirdsEye is a human-in-the-loop geospatial annotation system for UAV field imagery that uses RTK positioning to project world-coordinate labels onto images, enabling rapid dataset construction for training perception models in agricultural robotics applications.

Abstract: Real-world perception systems must adapt to changing environments, but manual image annotation cannot scale to field data volumes. We present BirdsEye, which shifts expert annotation from images to the field: an operator records target locations in world coordinates using RTK positioning and calibrated projective geometry propagates each observation to all frames where the target is visible. To quantify how well physical annotations align with image observations, we derive a first-order mapping from camera-pose uncertainty to pixel uncertainty and validate it against Monte Carlo simulation. This mapping is linear in the six per-axis pose variances, so it inverts into a sensor design tool: we give a sufficient condition converting an annotation tolerance into a convex set of admissible pose-noise budgets, a closed-form largest admissible scaling of a deployed sensor suite, and a unique per-axis pose specification under an equal-budget-share allocation. We also analyze the planar-surface approximation underlying the projection, which holds up to 10 degrees of terrain slope. By direct measurement, we show that system projection accuracy is sub-decimeter (sub-30 pixel) at AGL altitudes of 10-20m under conditions excluding sustained yawing. During an in-field case study across three agricultural sites, two field workers produced 12,524 annotated frames carrying 55,600 labels in roughly 12 hours (25.5x per-worker rate increase over manual labeling). Detectors trained on imagery collected by this workflow recovered 56-89% of in-view surveyed targets at a geographically distinct farm, at pre-registered operating points; human review of the leading configuration estimates detection precision at 83-87%, spanning three tie-break conventions for clusters carrying contradictory human verdicts.

摘要（中文）：真实世界感知系统必须适应不断变化的环境，但手动图像标注无法扩展到实地数据量。我们提出了BirdsEye，它将专家标注从图像转移到实地：操作员使用RTK定位在世界坐标中记录目标位置，并通过校准的投影几何将每次观测传播到目标可见的所有帧中。为了量化物理标注与图像观测之间的对齐程度，我们推导了从相机位姿不确定性到像素不确定性的**一阶映射**，并针对蒙特卡洛模拟进行了验证。该映射在六个逐轴位姿方差上是线性的，因此可以转化为传感器设计工具：我们给出了一个充分条件，将标注公差转化为可接受的位姿噪声预算的凸集；一个闭合形式的、已部署传感器套件最大可接受缩放比例；以及在等预算份额分配下的唯一逐轴位姿规范。我们还分析了投影所依据的平面表面近似，该近似在地形坡度不超过10度时成立。通过直接测量，我们表明在无持续偏航的条件下，系统在AGL高度10-20米时的投影精度为亚分米级（亚30像素）。在三个农业场地的实地案例研究中，两名实地工人在约12小时内产生了12,524个带标注帧，包含55,600个标签（每位工人的标注速率比手动标注提高了25.5倍）。在此工作流程采集的图像上训练的检测器，在地理位置不同的农场中，在预注册操作点上恢复到了视场内调查目标的56-89%；人工审查领先配置的估计检测精度为83-87%，涵盖三种用于处理包含矛盾人工判定聚类的决胜约定。

Authors: Morgan Masters, Nikolaas Bender, T. Luca Altaffer, Colleen Josephson, Steve McGuire

OA-MPPI: Occlusion-Aware Model Predictive Path Integral Control for UAV Flight Other

occlusion-aware Model Predictive Path Integral quadrotor control autonomous UAV occupancy map

简要说明：OA-MPPI 将 MPPI 控制扩展到四旋翼飞行器，通过建模遮挡区域作为隐藏智能体的潜在来源，并惩罚进入这些扩展区域的轨迹，在仿真和机载实时硬件实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: OA-MPPI extends MPPI control for quadrotors by modeling occluded regions as potential sources of hidden agents, penalizing trajectories that enter these expanding zones, and validating the approach in simulation and onboard real-time hardware experiments.

Abstract: Autonomous UAV flight through cluttered and partially unknown environments requires reasoning not only about observed obstacles but also about occluded regions that the sensor cannot observe. We present OA-MPPI, an obstacle- and occlusion-aware extension of Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control for quadrotor flight that accounts for potential moving agents emerging from these regions into the vehicle's path. At every planning step, we extract a 3D occlusion boundary from the online occupancy map and use it to model the regions that hidden agents could reach over the prediction horizon. We penalize trajectories that enter these expanding regions within MPPI rollouts generated using nonlinear quadrotor dynamics and accounting for individual rotor thrust limits. We validate the proposed approach in simulation and hardware flight experiments, with the complete pipeline running onboard the vehicle in real time. Results show increased clearance from occlusion boundaries compared to baseline MPPI in both settings, as well as avoidance of an agent emerging from occlusion in simulation.

摘要（中文）：自主无人机在杂乱且部分未知环境中的飞行，不仅需要对已观测到的障碍物进行推理，还需考虑传感器无法观测到的遮挡区域。我们提出了OA-MPPI，一种面向四旋翼飞行的障碍物与遮挡感知模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制扩展方法，该方法考虑了潜在移动智能体从这些区域进入飞行器路径的可能性。在每个规划步骤中，我们从在线占据地图中提取三维遮挡边界，并利用该边界对预测时域内隐藏智能体可能到达的区域进行建模。在基于非线性四旋翼动力学并考虑单个旋翼推力限制生成的MPPI rollout中，我们对进入这些扩展区域的轨迹施加惩罚。我们在仿真和硬件飞行实验中验证了所提方法，完整流程在飞行器上实时运行。结果表明，与基线MPPI相比，两种场景下与遮挡边界的间距均有增加，同时仿真实验中成功避让了从遮挡区域出现的智能体。
